mcq.q: On a sunny day, the sky is ______ and the clouds are white.
mcq.st: 在晴朗的日子裡，天空是藍色的，雲是白色的。

mcq.q: The road is ______, so it's easy to ride a bike on it.
mcq.st: 這條路很平，所以在上面騎腳踏車很容易。

mcq.q: This cup is dirty. Please give me ______ cup.
mcq.st: 這個杯子髒了，請給我另一個杯子。

mcq.q: I can't sleep because of the summer ______. Please turn on the fan.
mcq.st: 因為夏天的炎熱我睡不著，請打開電風扇。

mcq.q: Our school team needs one more ______ for the soccer game tomorrow.
mcq.st: 我們校隊明天的足球比賽還需要一名球員。

mcq.q: My uncle is a ______ at a famous restaurant. His fried rice is the best.
mcq.st: 我叔叔是一家有名餐廳的廚師，他的炒飯是最好吃的。

mcq.q: In cartoons, pigs are usually ______.
mcq.st: 在卡通裡，豬通常是粉紅色的。

mcq.q: Dad bought me a ______ of colored pencils. There are 24 different colors in it.
mcq.st: 爸爸買了一套色鉛筆給我，裡面有24種不同的顏色。

mcq.q: The temperature will ______ to 35°C this afternoon. It'll be very hot.
mcq.st: 今天下午氣溫會提高到攝氏35度，會非常熱。

mcq.q: I'm not ______ today. I have a headache, so I can't go to school.
mcq.st: 我今天身體不舒服（不健康），我頭痛，所以不能去上學。

mcq.q: I have a math test ______, so I need to study tonight.
mcq.st: 我明天有數學考試，所以今晚需要讀書。

mcq.q: You can take ______ book you like from this shelf.
mcq.st: 你可以從這個書架上拿任何一本你喜歡的書。

mcq.q: Tom sits in the first ______ in class, right in front of the teacher.
mcq.st: 湯姆在班上坐第一排，就在老師正前方。

mcq.q: Dad's black ______ has a jacket and pants. He wears it with a tie to work every day.
mcq.st: 爸爸的黑色西裝有外套和褲子，他每天搭配領帶穿去上班。

mcq.q: Visiting Japan was a great ______. I learned a lot there.
mcq.st: 去日本玩是很棒的經驗，我在那裡學到很多。

mcq.q: This candy has a strange ______. It's both sweet and salty.
mcq.st: 這顆糖果有種奇怪的味道，又甜又鹹。

mcq.q: The sunset over the sea was a beautiful ______.
mcq.st: 海上的夕陽是一幅美麗的景象。

mcq.q: Chocolate ice cream is ______, and vanilla ice cream is white.
mcq.st: 巧克力冰淇淋是棕色的，香草冰淇淋是白色的。

mcq.q: When you mix black and white paint, you get ______ paint.
mcq.st: 當你把黑色和白色的顏料混在一起，你會得到灰色的顏料。

mcq.q: The ______ on the school gate says, "No dogs in the school."
mcq.st: 校門上的告示寫著：「學校內禁止帶狗。」

mcq.q: Grandma always has a big ______ on her face when she sees us.
mcq.st: 奶奶看到我們時，臉上總是帶著大大的微笑。

mcq.q: I read a good ______ of the movie online, so I want to see it.
mcq.st: 我在網路上讀到這部電影的好評，所以我想去看。

mcq.q: Mom used a ______ to put the flower on her dress.
mcq.st: 媽媽用一根別針把花別在她的洋裝上。

mcq.q: After the cold winter, flowers come out in ______.
mcq.st: 寒冷的冬天過後，花朵在春天開放。

mcq.q: The ______ in our class often hits smaller kids and takes their lunch money.
mcq.st: 我們班上的那個惡霸常常打比較小的孩子，還拿走他們的午餐錢。

mcq.q: Amy drew a ______ of her cat with colored pencils.
mcq.st: 艾咪用色鉛筆畫了一幅她的貓的圖畫。

mcq.q: The boy threw a ______ into the river, and it went down to the bottom.
mcq.st: 那個男孩把一顆石頭丟進河裡，它沉到了河底。

mcq.q: Mom was very ______ because I broke her favorite cup again.
mcq.st: 媽媽很生氣，因為我又打破了她最喜歡的杯子。

mcq.q: Do you ______ the answer to this question?
mcq.st: 你知道這個問題的答案嗎？

mcq.q: Don't be a ______! You can't put your hand into the fire!
mcq.st: 別當傻瓜！你不能把手伸進火裡！

mcq.q: Please wait here ______ your mom comes to get you.
mcq.st: 請在這裡等，直到你媽媽來接你。

mcq.q: Dad cleaned the wet floor with a ______.
mcq.st: 爸爸用拖把把濕的地板清乾淨。

mcq.q: The new library is ______ from 9 a.m. to 8 p.m. every day.
mcq.st: 新的圖書館每天早上九點到晚上八點開放。

mcq.q: Jack has lived in Taipei ______ he was five years old.
mcq.st: 傑克從五歲起就一直住在台北。

mcq.q: There are ______ thirty students in my class, maybe twenty-nine or thirty-one.
mcq.st: 我們班上大約有三十個學生，可能是二十九或三十一個。

mcq.q: Our team played badly, so we ______ the game 2 to 5.
mcq.st: 我們隊打得很差，所以我們以二比五輸了比賽。

mcq.q: Sleep is ______ to good health. You can't be healthy without it.
mcq.st: 睡眠是健康的關鍵。沒有它你就無法健康。

mcq.q: I made a ______ with Tom: if I lose the race, I will buy him lunch.
mcq.st: 我和湯姆打了個賭：如果我賽跑輸了，我就請他吃午餐。

mcq.q: After dinner, Dad asked the waiter for the ______ and paid for the meal.
mcq.st: 晚餐後，爸爸向服務生要帳單並付了餐費。

mcq.q: Reading books is good for your ______; it helps you think better.
mcq.st: 讀書對你的心智有益；它幫助你思考得更好。

mcq.q: Close your eyes and make a ______ before you blow out the candles.
mcq.st: 在你吹熄蠟燭之前，閉上眼睛許個願望。

mcq.q: I have two brothers, and ______ brothers are taller than me.
mcq.st: 我有兩個哥哥，兩個哥哥都比我高。

mcq.q: The news of the big earthquake was a ______ to everyone.
mcq.st: 大地震的消息讓每個人都很震驚。

mcq.q: There is black ______ coming out of the kitchen. Is something burning?
mcq.st: 有黑煙從廚房冒出來。是有東西燒焦了嗎？

mcq.q: I waited for the bus for ______ an hour. That's thirty minutes!
mcq.st: 我等公車等了半小時。那可是三十分鐘！

mcq.q: Get off the bus at the next ______; the museum is right there.
mcq.st: 在下一站下公車；博物館就在那裡。

mcq.q: Tina ran very fast and won the 100-meter ______.
mcq.st: 蒂娜跑得非常快，贏得了一百公尺賽跑比賽。

mcq.q: The station is too ______ to walk to. Let's take a bus.
mcq.st: 車站太遠了，走不到。我們搭公車吧。

mcq.q: There isn't a ______ of water in the bottle. It's empty.
mcq.st: 瓶子裡一滴水也沒有。它是空的。

mcq.q: What ______ of music do you like? I like pop music.
mcq.st: 你喜歡哪一種類型的音樂？我喜歡流行音樂。

mcq.q: The teacher made thirty ______ of the test, one for each student.
mcq.st: 老師把考卷印了三十份，每個學生一份。

mcq.q: Your answer is ______. You get ten points!
mcq.st: 你的答案是正確的。你得到十分！

mcq.q: Jeremy is the ______ player on our basketball team; he gets the most points in every game.
mcq.st: 傑瑞米是我們籃球隊的明星球員；他每場比賽都得最多分。

mcq.q: Don't forget to water the ______ by the window, or they will die.
mcq.st: 別忘了給窗邊的植物澆水，不然它們會死掉。

mcq.q: The bookstore is two ______ away from my house, so I can walk there in five minutes.
mcq.st: 書店離我家兩個街區遠，所以我五分鐘就能走到那裡。

mcq.q: Ben didn't do his homework, and his ______ was "My dog ate it."
mcq.st: 班沒有寫作業，而他的藉口是「我的狗把它吃掉了。」

mcq.q: Mr. Lee is always kind ______ his students.
mcq.st: 李老師對他的學生總是很親切。

mcq.q: Please stand ______ and don't move while I take your picture.
mcq.st: 我幫你拍照時，請站著別動。

mcq.q: My aunt exercises every day, so she has a nice ______.
mcq.st: 我阿姨每天運動，所以她身材很好。

mcq.q: Grandpa likes to smoke a ______ after dinner.
mcq.st: 爺爺喜歡在晚餐後抽菸斗。

mcq.q: In Taiwan, children start elementary school at the ______ of six.
mcq.st: 在台灣，孩子在六歲的年齡開始上小學。

mcq.q: We ate the chips with a cheese ______.
mcq.st: 我們用起司沾醬配洋芋片吃。

mcq.q: Mom washed my white shirt, so it is ______ now.
mcq.st: 媽媽洗了我的白襯衫，所以它現在是乾淨的。

mcq.q: We watched a magic ______ at the night market last night.
mcq.st: 我們昨晚在夜市看了一場魔術表演。

mcq.q: My brother and I don't share a bedroom; I have my ______ room.
mcq.st: 我和哥哥沒有共用臥室；我有自己的房間。

mcq.q: Tom has a great ______ in baseball, and he watches every game on TV.
mcq.st: 湯姆對棒球很有興趣，他在電視上看每一場比賽。

mcq.q: My sister is wearing a suit because she has a job ______ this afternoon.
mcq.st: 我姊姊穿著西裝，因為她今天下午有一場工作面試。

mcq.q: Dad gave Mom a red ______, and she put the flower in water.
mcq.st: 爸爸送給媽媽一朵紅玫瑰，她把這朵花插在水裡。

mcq.q: Mary wears a gold ______ on her finger.
mcq.st: 瑪莉的手指上戴著一枚金戒指。

mcq.q: We have an English ______ every Monday morning.
mcq.st: 我們每週一早上有一堂英文課。

mcq.q: The tour ______ showed us around the old town.
mcq.st: 導遊帶我們參觀了老城區。

mcq.q: The girl ______ long hair is my cousin.
mcq.st: 那個有長頭髮的女孩是我的表妹。

mcq.q: Amy studied hard and got a good ______ on her math test.
mcq.st: 艾咪努力讀書，數學考試得到好成績。

mcq.q: The ______ of this pencil is very sharp.
mcq.st: 這支鉛筆的尖端（筆尖）很尖。

mcq.q: My cat loves to eat ______.
mcq.st: 我的貓很愛吃魚。

mcq.q: My father works for a computer ______ in Taipei.
mcq.st: 我爸爸在台北的一家電腦公司工作。

mcq.q: This soup is not salty enough, so please add some ______.
mcq.st: 這碗湯不夠鹹，所以請加一些鹽。

mcq.q: March is the ______ month of the year.
mcq.st: 三月是一年中的第三個月。

mcq.q: New York and Los Angeles are two big ______ cities.
mcq.st: 紐約和洛杉磯是兩座美國大城市。

mcq.q: ______ students in my class like P.E., but a few don't.
mcq.st: 我們班大部分的學生喜歡體育課，但有少數人不喜歡。

mcq.q: From the top of Taipei 101, you can enjoy a great ______ of the city.
mcq.st: 從台北101的頂端，你可以欣賞城市的美麗景色。

mcq.q: Mom is cooking beef soup in a big ______.
mcq.st: 媽媽正在用一個大鍋煮牛肉湯。

mcq.q: I bought a train ______ to Kaohsiung at the station.
mcq.st: 我在車站買了一張去高雄的火車票。

mcq.q: It's very ______ today, so put on your coat.
mcq.st: 今天很冷，所以穿上你的外套。

mcq.q: Ben always tells the truth, and he never tells a ______.
mcq.st: 班總是說實話，他從不說謊。

mcq.q: Helping the old man cross the street was a kind ______.
mcq.st: 幫助那位老先生過馬路是一個善良的行為。

mcq.q: It's 6 p.m. now, and the fireworks show will start at 8 ______.
mcq.st: 現在是下午六點，煙火秀將在今晚八點開始。

mcq.q: My hair is messy, so I need a ______.
mcq.st: 我的頭髮很亂，所以我需要一把梳子。

mcq.q: Please ______ carefully before you answer the question.
mcq.st: 回答問題之前請仔細思考。

mcq.q: My little brother has a ______ of dogs, so he never goes near them.
mcq.st: 我弟弟很怕狗，所以他從不靠近牠們。

mcq.q: What is the best ______ to learn English words?
mcq.st: 學英文單字最好的方法是什麼？

mcq.q: Dad is reading in his ______; it has a big desk and many books.
mcq.st: 爸爸正在他的書房看書；書房裡有一張大書桌和很多書。

mcq.q: I was sick yesterday, but I feel much better ______.
mcq.st: 我昨天生病了，但我今天感覺好多了。

mcq.q: This train is very ______; it can go 300 kilometers an hour.
mcq.st: 這班火車非常快；它每小時可以行駛三百公里。

mcq.q: Our school team won the basketball ______ last Saturday.
mcq.st: 我們學校的球隊上週六贏了籃球比賽。

mcq.q: Look at your ______ and tell me what time it is.
mcq.st: 看看你的手錶，告訴我現在幾點。

mcq.q: For homework, please do the ______ on page 25 of your English book.
mcq.st: 回家作業請做英文課本第25頁的習題。

mcq.q: Please ______ the classroom clean.
mcq.st: 請保持教室乾淨。

mcq.q: The students did a beautiful ______ to the music at the school party.
mcq.st: 學生們在學校派對上隨著音樂跳了一支優美的舞。

mcq.q: I haven't finished my homework ______, so I can't go out to play.
mcq.st: 我還沒寫完功課，所以我不能出去玩。

mcq.q: Do you have any ______ for this weekend, like going hiking or seeing a movie?
mcq.st: 你這個週末有什麼計畫嗎，像是去健行或看電影？

mcq.q: The ______ of the trip to Japan is about 30,000 dollars.
mcq.st: 去日本旅行的費用大約三萬元。

mcq.q: Only Tom came to school by bike; all the ______ students took the bus.
mcq.st: 只有湯姆騎腳踏車上學；其他所有的學生都搭公車。

mcq.q: On April Fools' Day, my brother played a ______ on me.
mcq.st: 在愚人節那天，我哥哥對我惡作劇。

mcq.q: My favorite TV ______ is on at eight o'clock every Friday.
mcq.st: 我最喜歡的電視節目每週五晚上八點播出。

mcq.q: My uncle ______ a big house with a beautiful garden.
mcq.st: 我叔叔擁有一棟有漂亮花園的大房子。

mcq.q: I ate only a small ______ of the cake because I was full.
mcq.st: 因為我吃飽了，所以我只吃了蛋糕的一小部分。

mcq.q: The phone rang ______ I was taking a shower.
mcq.st: 當我在淋浴時，電話響了。

mcq.q: The book was 80 dollars. I paid with 100 dollars, so the clerk gave me 20 dollars in ______.
mcq.st: 這本書八十元。我付了一百元，所以店員找我二十元零錢。

mcq.q: I'm thirsty. Can I have a cold ______, please?
mcq.st: 我口渴了。請給我一杯冷飲好嗎？

mcq.q: My father works very hard, so his boss gave him a ______ this year. Now he makes more money.
mcq.st: 我爸爸工作很努力，所以他的老闆今年幫他加薪。現在他賺更多錢了。

mcq.q: The waves are big today, so my brother is going to ______ at the beach.
mcq.st: 今天浪很大，所以我哥哥要去海邊衝浪。

rows.d: explain why something happened
rows.s: Jason could not _____ _____ his late arrival this morning, so the teacher asked him to stay after class and talk with her.
rows.st: 傑森無法【說明】他今天早上為什麼遲到，所以老師要他下課後留下來和她談談。

rows.d: make up a part of a total
rows.s: Girls _____ _____ about half of the students in our school, and many of them join the basketball team every year.
rows.st: 女生大約【占了】我們學校學生的一半，而且每年都有很多人加入籃球隊。

rows.d: behave in the same way as someone
rows.s: Even though Tony is already fourteen, he sometimes _____ _____ a little child when he can't get what he wants.
rows.st: 雖然東尼已經十四歲了，但他得不到想要的東西時，有時會【表現得像】個小孩。

rows.d: change to fit a new place or situation
rows.s: When Amy moved from Canada to Taipei, it took her a few months to _____ _____ the hot weather and the busy streets.
rows.st: 當艾咪從加拿大搬到台北時，她花了幾個月才【適應】炎熱的天氣和繁忙的街道。

rows.d: put something into something else
rows.s: My grandmother always _____ a little sugar _____ her tomato soup because she thinks it makes the taste much better.
rows.st: 我奶奶總是【把】一點糖【加到】她的番茄湯裡，因為她覺得這樣味道會好很多。

rows.d: decide together about a plan
rows.s: After a long talk, my parents finally _____ _____ a place for our summer trip, and we are going to Hualien in July.
rows.st: 經過一番長談，我爸媽終於對暑假旅行的地點【意見一致】，我們七月要去花蓮。

rows.d: say yes to a plan or idea
rows.s: Dad _____ _____ our idea of having a barbecue in the backyard, so we bought meat and corn at the supermarket.
rows.st: 爸爸【同意】我們在後院烤肉的提議，所以我們去超市買了肉和玉米。

rows.d: have the same opinion as someone
rows.s: I _____ _____ Peter that the new science teacher is very funny, because she always tells jokes when we feel sleepy.
rows.st: 我【同意】彼得的看法，新來的自然老師很有趣，因為我們想睡覺時她總是會講笑話。

rows.d: to have the same idea as someone about something
rows.s: My sister and I usually argue, but I _____ _____ her _____ the plan to buy Dad a new watch for his birthday.
rows.st: 我和姊姊常常吵架，但在買新手錶送爸爸當生日禮物這個計畫上，我【同意】她的看法。

rows.d: open the door when someone knocks
rows.s: Someone knocked loudly while Mom was cooking dinner, so she asked me to _____ _____ _____ for her.
rows.st: 媽媽在煮晚餐時有人大聲敲門，所以她叫我幫她去【應門】。

rows.d: pick up a phone call
rows.s: I was taking a shower when the phone rang, so my sister _____ _____ _____ and took a message for me.
rows.st: 電話響的時候我正在洗澡，所以我妹妹幫我【接電話】並記下留言。

rows.d: be interesting or attractive to someone
rows.s: Video games with cute animals often _____ _____ young children, so the toy store puts them near the front door.
rows.st: 有可愛動物的電玩常常【吸引】小孩子，所以玩具店把它們放在靠近前門的地方。

rows.d: strongly ask people to do something
rows.s: The city government _____ _____ people to save water this summer because it has not rained for almost two months.
rows.st: 市政府【呼籲】民眾今年夏天要節約用水，因為已經將近兩個月沒下雨了。

rows.d: ask a higher court to change a decision
rows.s: The man did not think the judge's decision was fair, so he _____ _____ a higher court and asked for a new trial.
rows.st: 那名男子認為法官的判決不公平，所以他向更高一級的法院【上訴】，要求重新審判。

rows.d: ask in writing for a job or place
rows.s: My older brother wants to earn some money this summer, so he will _____ _____ a part-time job at the coffee shop.
rows.st: 我哥哥今年夏天想賺點錢，所以他要去【應徵】咖啡店的兼職工作。

rows.d: say that you believe something is true
rows.s: Some students _____ _____ school should start at nine o'clock because they need more sleep in the morning.
rows.st: 有些學生【主張】學校應該九點才開始上課，因為他們早上需要更多睡眠。

rows.d: reach a place
rows.s: We _____ _____ Tokyo late at night after a long flight, so we took a taxi to the hotel and went straight to bed.

mcq.st: 爺爺在鄉下有一座小農場。他在那裡種菜，過著簡單的生活。

mcq.q: I was all sweaty after the basketball game, so I ______ right away.
mcq.st: 籃球比賽後我全身是汗，所以我馬上去淋浴。

mcq.q: You feel very hot. Let me ______ to see if you have a fever.
mcq.st: 你摸起來很燙。讓我幫你量體溫，看看你是不是發燒了。

mcq.q: We didn't know the new word "cozy," so Ms. Lin ______.
mcq.st: 我們不認識新單字「cozy」，所以林老師把它定義為「溫暖又舒適」。

mcq.q: It's sunny today. Let's ______ in the park and eat sandwiches on the grass.
mcq.st: 今天天氣晴朗。我們去公園野餐，在草地上吃三明治吧。

mcq.q: On New Year's Eve, people ______ fireworks by the river.
mcq.st: 跨年夜時，人們在河邊施放煙火。

mcq.q: After years of hard work, Lisa finally ______. She is a doctor now.
mcq.st: 經過多年的努力，麗莎終於實現了夢想。她現在是一名醫生。

mcq.q: I have to finish this report by Friday, so I'm working hard to ______.
mcq.st: 我必須在星期五前完成這份報告，所以我正努力趕上截止日期。

mcq.q: Everyone in our class ______ because she always helps others.
o: regards Amy as a good friend
mcq.st: 我們班上每個人都把艾咪當作好朋友，因為她總是幫助別人。

mcq.q: Playing with three little kids all day really ______ Grandma.
mcq.st: 和三個小孩玩了一整天，真的把奶奶累壞了。

mcq.q: I was near your house this afternoon, so I ______ to say hi.
mcq.st: 我今天下午在你家附近，所以順道過來打聲招呼。

mcq.q: I ______ late last night to watch the baseball game, so I'm very tired now.
mcq.st: 我昨晚熬夜看棒球比賽，所以現在很累。

mcq.q: Go straight two blocks and ______ at the bookstore. The bank is next to it.
mcq.st: 直走兩個路口，在書店那裡右轉。銀行就在書店旁邊。

mcq.q: My new shoes were on sale. I only ______.
mcq.st: 我的新鞋在特價。我只花了新台幣五百元買它們。

mcq.q: Everyone should ______. For example, never drive after drinking.
mcq.st: 每個人都應該遵守法律。例如，絕對不要酒後開車。

mcq.q: We finished dinner at the restaurant, and Dad ______ with his credit card.
mcq.st: 我們在餐廳吃完晚餐，爸爸用信用卡付了帳。

mcq.q: I want to ______ my bad habit of eating too much candy.
mcq.st: 我想擺脫吃太多糖果的壞習慣。

mcq.q: Our river is getting dirty. We must ______ to clean it before it's too late.
mcq.st: 我們的河川越來越髒了。我們必須在太遲之前採取行動把它清乾淨。

mcq.q: Mom ______ and gave one to each of us.
o: broke the cookie into four pieces
mcq.st: 媽媽把餅乾分成四塊，給我們每人一塊。

mcq.q: In the last second of the game, Kevin ______, and our team won 21 to 20.
mcq.st: 在比賽最後一秒，凱文得了一分，我們隊以21比20獲勝。

mcq.q: When I called her name, Mary ______ and smiled at me.
mcq.st: 我叫瑪莉的名字時，她轉過身來對我微笑。

mcq.q: The soup is cold. Let me ______ the soup for you in the microwave.
mcq.st: 湯冷掉了。讓我用微波爐幫你把湯加熱。

mcq.q: This restaurant changed its menu to ______ young people's tastes.
mcq.st: 這家餐廳改了菜單來迎合年輕人的口味。

mcq.q: Wear a raincoat. It will ______.
mcq.st: 穿上雨衣。它可以防止你被淋濕。

mcq.q: The forest was dark, but we used a map to ______ it.
mcq.st: 森林裡很暗，但我們用地圖找到了穿越森林的路。

mcq.q: I want to be a pilot when I ______.
mcq.st: 我長大後想當飛行員。

mcq.q: I can't watch TV now. I need to ______. Ms. Lin will check our workbooks tomorrow.
mcq.st: 我現在不能看電視。我需要做作業。林老師明天會檢查我們的作業簿。

mcq.q: The sea was so blue and beautiful that we sat on the beach for an hour to ______.
mcq.st: 海又藍又美，所以我們在沙灘上坐了一個小時欣賞風景。

mcq.q: Tim saw a cup of water on the table. He ______ and drank it.
mcq.st: 提姆看到桌上有一杯水。他伸手拿起它並喝掉了。

mcq.q: Mom ______ to make my birthday cake perfect. She worked on it all afternoon.
mcq.st: 媽媽費盡心力把我的生日蛋糕做得很完美。她做了一整個下午。

mcq.q: What ______ your bike? The front wheel is broken.
mcq.st: 你的腳踏車發生了什麼事？前輪壞了。

mcq.q: It's sunny today, so Mom wants to ______ outside to dry.
mcq.st: 今天天氣晴朗，所以媽媽想把衣服掛在外面晾乾。

mcq.q: There are glass cups in this box. Please ______.
mcq.st: 這個箱子裡有玻璃杯。請小心處理。

mcq.q: Bye, Amy! I hope you ______ at the party tonight. There will be lots of games and food!
mcq.st: 再見，艾咪！希望你今晚在派對上玩得愉快。會有很多遊戲和食物！

mcq.q: I didn't want to join the basketball team at first, but my friends ______. Now I play every day.
mcq.st: 我一開始不想加入籃球隊，但我的朋友們說服了我。現在我每天都打球。

mcq.q: My little brother hates carrots, but Mom can always ______. She is really good at it.
mcq.st: 我弟弟討厭紅蘿蔔，但媽媽總是能讓他吃下去。她真的很擅長這件事。

mcq.q: The twin sisters look the same. I can't ______ between them.
mcq.st: 那對雙胞胎姊妹長得一模一樣。我分辨不出她們之間的差異。

mcq.q: The police officer said, "Catching thieves is not easy, but I must ______."
mcq.st: 警察說：「抓小偷並不容易，但我必須盡我的本分。」

mcq.q: Grandpa lives alone in the country, but he can ______ without our help.
mcq.st: 爺爺獨自住在鄉下，但他不需要我們的幫忙也能過得去。

mcq.q: Don't leave yet! ______ for a while, and we can eat some cake together.
mcq.st: 先別走！留下來一會兒，我們可以一起吃點蛋糕。

mcq.q: Can I ______? I need some help with my math homework.
mcq.st: 我可以請你幫個忙嗎？我的數學作業需要一些幫助。

mcq.q: Ben thinks math is not important, so he doesn't ______.
mcq.st: 班認為數學不重要，所以他不認真看待數學。

mcq.q: At first Dad said no to a new phone, but after I asked him ten times, he finally ______.
mcq.st: 一開始爸爸不答應買新手機，但在我問了他十次之後，他終於讓步了。

mcq.q: Before you go to bed, don't forget to ______.
o: order your sister to sit down
mcq.st: 睡覺前，別忘了刷牙。

mcq.q: Thousands of fans came to the stadium to ______. They shouted, "Go, Brothers, go!"
mcq.st: 成千上萬的球迷來到球場為他們的球隊加油。他們大喊：「兄弟，加油！」

mcq.q: I'm sorry I called you stupid. I want to ______.
mcq.st: 對不起我說你很笨。我想收回我的話。

mcq.q: There are so many cakes in the shop, and they all look good. I can't ______.
mcq.st: 店裡有好多蛋糕，而且看起來都很好吃。我沒辦法做選擇。

mcq.q: Our car ______ on the highway, so we had to call for help.
mcq.st: 我們的車在高速公路上故障了，所以我們必須打電話求救。

mcq.q: I forgot to bring my pen to the test, so I ______.
o: took a look at the clock
mcq.st: 我忘了帶筆來考試，所以我向艾咪要了一支。

mcq.q: The little boy ______ and said, "Look! There's a big bird up there!"
mcq.st: 小男孩指著那棵樹說：「看！上面有一隻大鳥！」

mcq.q: Your room is so dirty! Please ______ before dinner.
mcq.st: 你的房間好髒！請在晚餐前把它打掃乾淨。

mcq.q: The heavy rain ______, so we played board games at home all day.
mcq.st: 大雨讓我們無法出門，所以我們整天在家玩桌遊。

mcq.q: Dad is very sleepy this morning, so I'll ______ for him. He likes it with milk.
mcq.st: 爸爸今天早上很睏，所以我會幫他泡咖啡。他喜歡加牛奶。

mcq.q: The bus was late, so I read a comic book to ______.
o: appeal to people to save water
mcq.st: 公車誤點了，所以我看漫畫來消磨時間。

mcq.q: Dad just bought a new car. Let's ______ around the lake this afternoon!
mcq.st: 爸爸剛買了一輛新車。我們今天下午去湖邊兜風吧！

03.title: be動詞+形容詞片語 be + Adjective Phrases

rows.d: can do something
rows.s: After practicing every day for three months, my little brother _____ _____ _____ ride his bike without any help.
rows.st: 每天練習了三個月後，我弟弟終於【能夠】不靠任何幫助自己騎腳踏車了。

rows.d: going to do something very soon
rows.s: We _____ _____ _____ leave for the beach when it suddenly started to rain, so we stayed home and played cards instead.
rows.st: 我們【正要】出發去海邊時，突然開始下雨，所以我們改成待在家裡玩撲克牌。

rows.d: not be at a place like school
rows.s: Kevin _____ _____ _____ class yesterday because he had a high fever, so his friend brought him the homework.
rows.st: 凱文昨天上課【缺席】，因為他發高燒，所以他的朋友把作業帶給他。

rows.d: take part in something with lots of energy
rows.s: Irene _____ very _____ _____ school clubs, and she joins the dance club and the English club every week.
rows.st: 艾琳【很積極參與】學校社團，她每週都參加舞蹈社和英文社。

rows.d: to feel fear about something
rows.s: My little brother _____ _____ _____ big dogs, so he always holds my hand tightly when we walk past our neighbor's house.
rows.st: 我弟弟【害怕】大狗，所以每次我們經過鄰居家時，他總是緊緊牽著我的手。

rows.d: to feel very surprised in a good way
rows.s: When we got to the top of Yushan, we _____ _____ because the sunrise over the clouds was so beautiful.
rows.st: 當我們登上玉山山頂時，我們【感到非常驚奇】，因為雲海上的日出實在太美了。

rows.d: feel mad because of something
rows.s: Mr. Lin _____ _____ _____ the noise in the hallway, so he closed the classroom door and asked us to stop talking.
rows.st: 林老師因為走廊上的噪音【很生氣】，所以他關上教室門，要我們停止講話。

rows.d: to feel mad at someone
rows.s: Mom _____ _____ _____ my little brother because he broke her favorite cup and didn't tell her the truth.
rows.st: 媽媽【生】我弟弟【的氣】，因為他打破了她最喜歡的杯子，而且沒跟她說實話。

rows.d: to exist; to be alive or there
rows.s: Dinosaurs _____ _____ millions of years ago, but now we can only see their bones in museums like the one in Taichung.
rows.st: 恐龍在幾百萬年前就【存在】了，但現在我們只能在像台中那樣的博物館看到牠們的骨頭。

rows.d: know or notice something
rows.s: Many people _____ not _____ _____ how much sugar is in bubble tea, so they drink it every day without worrying.
rows.st: 很多人沒有【意識到】珍珠奶茶裡有多少糖，所以他們每天喝也不擔心。

rows.d: not at home or not here for some time
rows.s: My parents _____ _____ on a business trip this week, so my aunt is cooking dinner for us.
rows.st: 我爸媽這週出差【不在家】，所以阿姨在幫我們煮晚餐。

rows.d: to not be at your house for some time
rows.s: My dad will _____ _____ _____ _____ for two weeks on a business trip, so we will call him every night.
rows.st: 爸爸要出差兩週【不在家】，所以我們每晚都會打電話給他。

rows.d: use something as a starting point
rows.s: The new cartoon movie _____ _____ _____ a famous Japanese story, so my friends and I went to see it on its first day.
rows.st: 這部新的卡通電影是【根據】一個有名的日本故事改編的，所以我和朋友在首映日就去看了。

rows.d: to be very surprised and impressed
rows.s: The first time I saw the Taipei 101 fireworks on New Year's Eve, I _____ _____ _____ because they were so beautiful.
rows.st: 我第一次在跨年夜看到台北101的煙火時，因為實在太美了，我【大為震撼】。

rows.d: to lose interest because something is not fun
rows.s: After two hours at home, the kids _____ _____ _____ their video games, so they went to the park to play basketball.
rows.st: 在家待了兩個小時後，孩子們【對電動遊戲感到厭煩】，所以他們去公園打籃球。

rows.d: having no money at all
rows.s: I _____ _____ this week because I spent all my pocket money on games, so I can't go to the movies.
rows.st: 我這週【身無分文】，因為我把零用錢全花在遊戲上了，所以不能去看電影。

rows.d: spending all your time doing something
rows.s: The students _____ _____ cleaning the classroom when the principal came in, so nobody noticed him at first.
rows.st: 校長進來的時候，學生們正【忙著】打掃教室，所以一開始沒有人注意到他。

rows.d: having a lot to do with something
rows.s: Dad _____ _____ _____ his work this week, so Mom drove us to school every morning and cooked dinner alone.
rows.st: 爸爸這個星期【忙於】工作，所以媽媽每天早上載我們上學，還自己一個人煮晚餐。

rows.d: have a certain name
rows.s: Our new classmate from Canada _____ _____ Ethan, and he can already speak a little Chinese.
rows.st: 我們從加拿大來的新同學【名叫】Ethan，而且他已經會說一點中文。

rows.d: pay attention to avoid problems
rows.s: You should _____ _____ _____ what you eat at the night market in summer, because some food goes bad quickly in hot weather.
rows.st: 夏天在夜市，你應該【小心】自己吃的東西，因為有些食物在炎熱的天氣裡很快就會壞掉。

rows.d: to be near something
rows.s: Our new apartment _____ _____ _____ the MRT station, so it only takes me five minutes to walk there every morning.
rows.st: 我們的新公寓很【接近】捷運站，所以我每天早上走過去只要五分鐘。

rows.d: have something all over the top
rows.s: After the big snowstorm, the mountains _____ _____ _____ white snow, and many tourists came to take pictures.
rows.st: 大雪過後，山上【覆蓋著】白雪，許多遊客前來拍照。

rows.d: like someone or something very, very much
rows.s: My cousin Hao-yu _____ _____ _____ baseball, so he watches every Brothers game on TV with his dad.
rows.st: 我表哥浩宇【超級熱愛】棒球，所以他每場兄弟隊的比賽都和爸爸一起看電視轉播。

rows.d: wanting to know more about something
rows.s: Tim _____ _____ _____ how airplanes fly, so his father took him to an air show at the airport last weekend.
rows.st: 提姆【對】飛機如何飛行【感到好奇】，所以他爸爸上週末帶他去機場看航空展。

rows.d: to be very happy to do something
rows.s: Grandma _____ _____ _____ see all of us at the Lunar New Year dinner, and she cooked many delicious dishes.
rows.st: 奶奶【很高興】在除夕晚餐見到我們大家，她還煮了好多美味的菜。

rows.d: not like someone or something else
rows.s: Although Lisa and her twin sister look alike, Lisa's hobbies _____ _____ _____ her sister's because she loves sports and her sister loves art.
rows.st: 雖然麗莎和她的雙胞胎妹妹長得很像，但麗莎的嗜好【和】妹妹的【不同】，因為她喜歡運動，而妹妹喜歡藝術。

rows.d: to feel sad because something was not as hoped
rows.s: Mr. Chen _____ _____ _____ his test score because he studied hard for weeks, but he still did not pass.
rows.st: 陳先生【對他的考試成績感到失望】，因為他努力讀了好幾個星期，卻還是沒有及格。

rows.d: to feel very unhappy about something bad
rows.s: The visitors _____ _____ _____ the trash on the beach, so they picked it up and put it into bags before they left.
rows.st: 遊客們很【厭惡】海灘上的垃圾，所以他們在離開前把垃圾撿起來裝進袋子。

rows.d: wear clothes of a certain color
rows.s: On sports day, all students from Class 8 _____ _____ _____ red, so we could easily find them.
rows.st: 運動會上，八班所有學生都【穿著】紅色衣服，所以很容易找到他們。

rows.d: to feel shy or silly in front of others
rows.s: Wei-jie _____ _____ when he fell down on the stage, but his classmates clapped and cheered for him.
rows.st: 偉傑在舞台上跌倒時【感到很尷尬】，但同學們都為他鼓掌加油。

rows.d: to feel very happy about something coming
rows.s: The students _____ _____ _____ the school trip to Kenting because they will swim in the sea and see the stars.
rows.st: 學生們【對去墾丁的校外教學感到很興奮】，因為他們可以在海裡游泳、看星星。

rows.d: know something well
rows.s: Grace _____ _____ _____ this neighborhood because she has lived here for ten years, so she showed us the best noodle shop.
rows.st: 葛蕾絲很【熟悉】這一帶，因為她在這裡住了十年，所以她帶我們去最好吃的麵店。

rows.d: well known as a certain kind of person
rows.s: Mr. Lin, our neighbor, _____ _____ _____ a great cook in our town, so many people come to his small restaurant on weekends.
rows.st: 我們的鄰居林先生在鎮上【以】大廚的身分【出名】，所以週末很多人會來他的小餐廳。

rows.d: well known because of something
rows.s: Tainan _____ _____ _____ its delicious traditional snacks, so many visitors go there just to eat during their holidays.
rows.st: 台南【因】美味的傳統小吃【而聞名】，所以很多遊客放假時專程去那裡吃東西。

rows.d: have a lot of something inside
rows.s: The classroom _____ _____ _____ balloons and flowers because the students were planning a surprise party for their teacher's birthday.
rows.st: 教室裡【充滿】了氣球和花，因為學生們正在為老師的生日籌劃一個驚喜派對。

rows.d: to be made to pay money as punishment
rows.s: In Taipei, people may _____ _____ if they throw trash on the street, so most people carry their garbage until they find a trash can.
rows.st: 在台北，如果在街上亂丟垃圾，可能會【被罰款】，所以大部分的人會一直拿著垃圾，直到找到垃圾桶為止。

rows.d: like something very much
rows.s: My grandfather _____ _____ _____ growing vegetables, so he spends every morning working in the small garden behind our house.
rows.st: 我爺爺很【喜愛】種菜，所以他每天早上都在我們家後面的小菜園裡忙。

rows.d: new and strange to someone
rows.s: Snow _____ _____ _____ most children in southern Taiwan, so they got very excited when they saw it in Japan last winter.
rows.st: 雪【對】大多數南台灣的孩子來說很【陌生】，所以去年冬天他們在日本看到雪時非常興奮。

rows.d: not having something bad
rows.s: The air in the mountains _____ _____ _____ pollution, so my family likes to go camping there and breathe the fresh air.
rows.st: 山上的空氣【沒有】污染，所以我們家喜歡去那裡露營，呼吸新鮮空氣。

rows.d: to feel afraid of something
rows.s: Although Emma _____ _____ _____ big dogs, she tried to stay calm when one ran toward her in the park.
rows.st: 雖然艾瑪【害怕】大狗，但當一隻狗在公園裡朝她跑過來時，她還是試著保持冷靜。

rows.d: have a lot of something
rows.s: The MRT station _____ _____ _____ people on Monday morning, so I had to wait for three trains before I could get on.
rows.st: 星期一早上捷運站【擠滿】了人，所以我等了三班車才擠上去。

rows.d: able to do something well
rows.s: Wu Jia-hao _____ _____ _____ drawing cartoons, so his classmates always ask him to design the posters for school events.
rows.st: 吳家豪很【擅長】畫漫畫，所以同學們總是請他設計學校活動的海報。

rows.d: helpful or healthy for someone
rows.s: Eating fruit and vegetables every day _____ _____ _____ your health, and it also helps you stay strong when you play sports.
rows.st: 每天吃蔬菜水果【有益於】你的健康，也能幫助你在運動時保持強壯。

rows.d: to not be allowed to go out as a punishment
rows.c: 被禁足（通常指小孩受罰）
rows.s: Peter came home three hours late without calling his parents, so he _____ _____ for the whole weekend and couldn't see his friends.
rows.st: 彼得晚了三個小時才回家，也沒打電話給爸媽，所以整個週末都【被禁足】，不能和朋友見面。

rows.d: feel pleased because of something

mcq.st: 我哥哥對太空很感興趣，所以他每天晚上都讀有關星星和行星的書。

mcq.st: 學生們為這個週末沒有作業的好消息感到高興。

mcq.q: Grandpa ______ gardening, so he works in his garden every day.
mcq.st: 爺爺很喜愛園藝，所以他每天都在花園裡工作。

mcq.q: Lisa ______ school activities; she joins the music club, the art club, and the basketball team.
mcq.st: Lisa在學校活動中很積極主動；她參加了音樂社、美術社和籃球隊。

mcq.st: 我為了老師在英文上給我的幫助而感謝她。

mcq.q: Kevin played the same video game every day for months, and finally he ______ it and stopped playing.
mcq.st: Kevin好幾個月每天都玩同一款電玩，最後他對它感到厭倦，不再玩了。

mcq.q: Ms. Wang ______ a doctor, and they have two children.
mcq.st: 王小姐嫁給了一位醫生，他們有兩個孩子。

mcq.q: Ben had a bad cold, so he ______ school yesterday.
mcq.st: Ben得了重感冒，所以他昨天沒去上學（缺席）。

mcq.q: My new backpack ______ yours, so I put my name on it to tell them apart.
mcq.st: 我的新背包和你的一樣，所以我在上面寫了名字來區分它們。

mcq.q: The waiter asked us, "Are you ______ order now, or do you need more time?"
mcq.st: 服務生問我們：「你們準備好要點餐了嗎，還是需要多一點時間？」

mcq.q: The judges ______ Amy's beautiful singing and gave her first prize.

mcq.q: Mr. Chen has worked at this school for twenty years, so he ______ most of the other teachers.
mcq.st: 陳老師在這所學校工作了二十年，所以他比大部分其他老師資深。

mcq.q: I have studied every night this week, so I ______ tomorrow's math test.
mcq.st: 我這週每天晚上都在讀書，所以我已經為明天的數學考試準備好了。

mcq.q: This bike ______ Taiwan, and it is sold all over the world.
mcq.st: 這輛腳踏車是在台灣製造的，而且銷售到全世界。

mcq.q: Hot pot ______ my American friend, so I showed him how to cook the meat.
mcq.st: 火鍋對我的美國朋友來說很陌生，所以我教他怎麼煮肉。

mcq.q: Taiwan ______ its bubble tea, and many tourists want to try it.
mcq.st: 台灣因珍珠奶茶而聞名，許多觀光客都想嚐嚐看。

mcq.q: This book ______ the history of Taipei, so it is useful for my report.
mcq.st: 這本書與台北的歷史有關，所以對我的報告很有用。

mcq.q: Michael Jordan ______ one of the best basketball players in the world.
mcq.st: Michael Jordan以世界上最優秀的籃球員之一而聞名。

mcq.q: It's late, so let's brush our teeth and ______ bed.
mcq.st: 很晚了，我們刷牙準備睡覺吧。

mcq.q: All the students ______ planning the school sports day this year.
mcq.st: 今年所有學生都參與了籌劃學校運動會。

mcq.q: Dad ______ my little brother because he broke the window with a ball.
mcq.st: 爸爸對我弟弟生氣，因為他用球打破了窗戶。

mcq.q: This small beach ______ only a few local people, so it is quiet and clean.
mcq.st: 這個小海灘只為少數當地人所熟知，所以它又安靜又乾淨。

mcq.q: My sister ______ K-pop; she has hundreds of posters of her favorite singers.
mcq.st: 我姊姊超級喜愛韓國流行音樂；她有好幾百張她最喜歡的歌手的海報。

mcq.q: I ______ hear that you won first prize in the contest!
mcq.st: 我很高興聽到你在比賽中得了第一名！

mcq.q: Eating vegetables and fruit ______ your health.
mcq.st: 吃蔬菜和水果對你的健康有益。

mcq.q: Mom ______ the mess in my room, so she shouted at me to clean it up right away.
mcq.st: 媽媽為我房間的髒亂生氣，所以她大聲叫我馬上整理乾淨。

mcq.q: The customer ______ the food and service, so she gave the restaurant five stars.
mcq.st: 那位顧客對食物和服務很滿意，所以她給這家餐廳五顆星。

mcq.q: Tainan ______ its delicious traditional snacks, like shrimp rolls and milkfish soup.
mcq.st: 台南因美味的傳統小吃而聞名，像是蝦捲和虱目魚湯。

mcq.q: The big box under the bed ______ old toys and books.
mcq.st: 床底下的大箱子裝滿了舊玩具和書。

mcq.q: I have lived in this neighborhood for ten years, so I ______ every street here.
mcq.st: 我在這個社區住了十年，所以我很熟悉這裡的每一條街。

mcq.q: I ______ money, so can you lend me ten dollars for the bus?
mcq.st: 我缺錢，所以你可以借我十元搭公車嗎？

mcq.q: Our teacher gave Ben a job this year: he ______ the plants in our classroom.
mcq.st: 老師今年給了Ben一個工作：他負責替我們教室裡的植物澆水。

mcq.q: Mr. Wang ______ this week, so a new teacher is teaching our English class.
mcq.st: 王老師這星期不在，所以有一位新老師在教我們的英文課。

mcq.q: Kevin ______ this video game. He has played it every day for two years, and now it isn't fun anymore.
mcq.st: 凱文對這個電玩感到厭煩了。他已經每天玩了兩年，現在它不再好玩了。

mcq.q: At the party, Lisa ______ red. She looked like a beautiful flower.
mcq.st: 在派對上，麗莎穿著紅色的衣服。她看起來像一朵美麗的花。

mcq.q: The weather ______ in the afternoon. It started to rain hard, and the wind was very strong.
mcq.st: 下午天氣變糟了。開始下起大雨，而且風非常強。

mcq.q: Dinosaurs ______ millions of years ago, but today we can only see their bones in museums.
mcq.st: 恐龍存在於數百萬年前，但今天我們只能在博物館裡看到牠們的骨頭。

mcq.q: The movie ______ a true story about a little boy and his dog.
mcq.st: 這部電影是根據一個關於小男孩和他的狗的真實故事改編的。

mcq.q: I ______ eating instant noodles every day. I want some real food!
mcq.st: 我厭倦每天吃泡麵了。我想吃一些真正的食物！

mcq.q: Mr. Chen parked his car in the wrong place, so he ______. He had to pay 1,200 dollars.
mcq.st: 陳先生把車停在錯誤的地方，所以他被罰款了。他必須付一千二百元。

mcq.q: Please ______ crossing the street here. The cars on this road go very fast.
mcq.st: 在這裡過馬路請小心。這條路上的車開得很快。

mcq.q: I ______ my math test score. I studied very hard, but I only got 60.
mcq.st: 我對我的數學考試成績感到失望。我很努力讀書，但只考了六十分。

mcq.q: My parents ______ this weekend, so I am staying at Grandma's house.
mcq.st: 我爸媽這個週末不在家，所以我住在奶奶家。

mcq.q: After the heavy snow last night, our car ______ snow. Dad had to clean it before he drove to work.

mcq.q: Everyone ______ the news. The old bridge fell down in the storm last night.

rows.d: relaxed and comfortable

rows.st: 我們昨天在課堂上看的電影是【根據】一個真實故事改編的，所以很多學生放學後都想讀那本書。

rows.st: 每年冬天我們學校都會收集保暖衣物和毯子，送給山區【有需要的】家庭。

rows.st: 我表哥總是想買【最新的】智慧型手機，但他爸媽說他的舊手機還很好用。

rows.d: not different from another thing
rows.s: Your new backpack is _____ _____ _____ mine, so let's write our names on them to avoid picking up the wrong one.
rows.st: 你的新背包【和我的一樣】，所以我們把名字寫上去，以免拿錯吧。

rows.d: about the main idea only
rows.s: Ms. Wang liked Andy's speech because it was short and _____ _____ _____, and everyone understood his main idea quickly.
rows.st: 王老師喜歡安迪的演講，因為它簡短又【切題】，大家很快就懂他的重點。

rows.d: managed well; not causing problems
rows.c: 處於控制之下、在掌握之中
rows.s: The fire in the old building was big, but the firefighters got it _____ _____ in thirty minutes, so nobody was hurt.
rows.st: 那棟舊大樓的火勢很大，但消防員在三十分鐘內就把火勢【控制住】了，所以沒有人受傷。

mcq.q: Watermelons are ______ in winter, so they are very expensive now.
mcq.st: 西瓜在冬天不是盛產季節，所以現在很貴。

mcq.q: Grandpa was very sick last week, but the doctor says he is ______ now.
mcq.st: 爺爺上週病得很重，但醫生說他現在已經脫離險境了。

mcq.q: Mangoes are ______ in summer, so they are cheap and sweet.
mcq.st: 芒果在夏天正值盛產季節，所以又便宜又甜。

mcq.q: Mr. Lin's beef noodles are ______. Everyone says they are the best in town.
mcq.st: 林先生的牛肉麵是最棒的。大家都說那是鎮上最好吃的。

mcq.q: The car was ______ on the wet road and hit a tree.
mcq.st: 那輛車在濕滑的路上失控，撞上了一棵樹。

mcq.q: This map is ______. It doesn't show the new MRT station.
mcq.st: 這張地圖過時了。它沒有標出新的捷運站。

mcq.q: The elevator is ______, so we have to take the stairs.
mcq.st: 電梯故障了，所以我們必須走樓梯。

mcq.q: My brother's hobby is ______ mine. He likes sports, but I like reading.
mcq.st: 我哥哥的嗜好和我的不同。他喜歡運動，但我喜歡閱讀。

mcq.q: If you don't wear a helmet on a scooter, your life is ______.
mcq.st: 如果你騎機車不戴安全帽，你的生命就會有危險。

mcq.q: Help! The little boy is ______. He fell into the river!
mcq.st: 救命！那個小男孩有危險。他掉進河裡了！

mcq.q: The teacher's test questions are ______ the lessons in our textbook, so read the book carefully.
mcq.st: 老師的考題是根據我們課本裡的課文出的，所以要仔細讀課本。

mcq.q: December is ______ month of the year, and January is the first.
mcq.st: 十二月是一年中的最後一個月，而一月是第一個月。

mcq.q: Your speech was short and ______. Everyone understood your main idea.
mcq.st: 你的演講簡短又切中要點。每個人都懂你的主旨。

mcq.q: Tom looked for his lost key all day, but his search was ______. He never found it.
mcq.st: 湯姆整天都在找他遺失的鑰匙，但他的尋找都是白費力氣。他始終沒找到。

mcq.q: Ben broke the classroom window. Now he is ______ with the teacher.
mcq.st: 班打破了教室的窗戶。現在他在老師那裡惹上麻煩了。

mcq.q: My school is ______ my home, so I have to take the bus every day.
mcq.st: 我的學校離我家很遠，所以我每天都必須搭公車。

mcq.q: These shoes are ______ today. They are 50% off!
mcq.st: 這些鞋子今天特價。打五折！

mcq.q: Your English is ______ for the test. Don't worry.
mcq.st: 你的英文程度應付這次考試已經夠好了。別擔心。

mcq.q: Amy felt ______ at her new school because her classmates were very friendly.
mcq.st: 艾咪在新學校感到很自在，因為她的同學都很友善。

mcq.q: After the big typhoon, we were happy that all our family members were ______.
mcq.st: 大颱風過後，我們很高興全家人都安然無恙。

mcq.q: Your answer is ______ mine. We both wrote 25.
mcq.st: 你的答案和我的一樣。我們都寫了25。

mcq.q: We give our old clothes to people ______.
mcq.st: 我們把舊衣服捐給有需要的人。

mcq.q: Our art works are ______ in the school hall this week. Come and see them!
mcq.st: 我們的美術作品這週在學校大廳展出。來看看吧！

mcq.q: Mr. Wang is ______ tonight, so he can't go home until 10 p.m.
mcq.st: 王先生今晚值班，所以他要到晚上十點才能回家。

mcq.q: The number of people with pet dogs is ______ in Taiwan. There are more and more dogs every year.
mcq.st: 在台灣養寵物狗的人數正在增加。每年狗都越來越多。

mcq.q: The price of this phone is ______ the price of that one. This one is only NT$3,000, but that one is NT$30,000.
mcq.st: 這支手機的價格遠低於那支的價格。這支只要三千元，但那支要三萬元。

mcq.q: Ken always wants ______ phone. He buys a new one as soon as it comes out.
mcq.st: 肯總是想要最新的手機。新手機一推出他就買。

mcq.q: My grandma is 90 years old, but she is still ______. She walks in the park every morning.
mcq.st: 我奶奶九十歲了，但她身體仍然很健康。她每天早上都在公園散步。

mcq.q: Your new bike looks ______ mine. Both are red, but yours is a little bigger.
mcq.st: 你的新腳踏車看起來和我的很像。兩台都是紅色的，但你的稍微大一點。

mcq.q: Everything is ______ for the party. The food, drinks, and music are all ready.
mcq.st: 派對的一切都已就緒。食物、飲料和音樂都準備好了。

mcq.q: Ms. Lee is ______ this week. She went to Japan with her family, so we have a new teacher.
mcq.st: 李老師這週休假。她和家人去了日本，所以我們有一位代課老師。

mcq.q: The fire was big, but the firemen soon got it ______.
mcq.st: 火勢很大，但消防員很快就控制住了。

mcq.q: The hotel is ______ the beach. We can walk there in two minutes.
mcq.st: 那間飯店離海灘很近。我們走兩分鐘就到了。

mcq.q: We walked for an hour, and finally the mountain house was ______.
mcq.st: 我們走了一個小時，終於看得到山屋了。

mcq.q: Mom is ______, so she eats only salad for dinner and no dessert.
mcq.st: 媽媽正在節食，所以晚餐她只吃沙拉，不吃甜點。

mcq.q: The books on the shelf are ______. Please put them back from Book 1 to Book 10.
mcq.st: 書架上的書順序亂了。請把它們從第一冊到第十冊依序放回去。

mcq.q: Mary doesn't want to share a room with her sister. She wants a room ______.
mcq.st: 瑪莉不想和她妹妹共用房間。她想要一間屬於自己的房間。

mcq.q: Please move your bike. It's ______, and I can't get out of the door.
mcq.st: 請移開你的腳踏車。它擋到我的路，我沒辦法出門。

mcq.q: Sorry, you can't use this computer now. It is ______.
mcq.st: 抱歉，你現在不能用這台電腦。它正在使用中。

mcq.q: I'd like my eggs ______, with the yellow part on top.
mcq.st: 我的蛋要單面煎的，蛋黃朝上。

mcq.q: Jack hurt his leg in the game, and he was ______ all night.
mcq.st: 傑克在比賽中弄傷了腿，整晚都很痛。

mcq.q: All the passengers are ______ now, so the train can leave.
mcq.st: 所有乘客現在都上車了，所以火車可以出發了。

mcq.q: The final exam is ______. It's next Monday, so let's study hard.
mcq.st: 期末考就快到了。就在下週一，所以我們用功讀書吧。

mcq.q: I can't find any fresh strawberries at the market. They are ______ in August.
mcq.st: 我在市場找不到新鮮草莓。八月不是草莓的盛產季節。

mcq.q: The boat was in a big storm, but now it is back at the port and everyone is ______.
mcq.st: 那艘船遇上了大暴風雨，但現在它已回到港口，大家都脫離險境了。

mcq.q: It's July now. Lychees are ______, so you can see them in every fruit shop.
mcq.st: 現在是七月。荔枝正值盛產季節，所以每家水果店都看得到。

mcq.q: Everyone loves the beef noodles at this shop. They are ______ in our town.
mcq.st: 大家都愛這家店的牛肉麵。它們在我們鎮上是最好的。

mcq.q: The car was ______ and hit a tree on the rainy road.
mcq.st: 那輛車在下雨的路上失控，撞上了一棵樹。

mcq.q: Don't use this old dictionary. It's ______, and many new words are not in it.
mcq.st: 別用這本舊字典。它過時了，很多新字都沒有收在裡面。

mcq.q: The vending machine is ______. It took my money but gave me nothing.
mcq.st: 這台販賣機故障了。它吃了我的錢，卻什麼都沒給我。

mcq.q: Jenny looks like her twin sister, but her hobbies are ______ her sister's. Jenny loves sports, but her sister loves music.
mcq.st: 珍妮長得像她的雙胞胎姊妹，但她的嗜好和她姊妹的不同。珍妮熱愛運動，而她的姊妹熱愛音樂。

mcq.q: If you ride a bike without a helmet, your life is ______.
mcq.st: 如果你騎腳踏車不戴安全帽，你的生命就會有危險。

mcq.q: Help! The little boy fell into the river. He is ______!
mcq.st: 救命啊！那個小男孩掉進河裡了。他有危險！

mcq.q: This movie is ______ a true story. It really happened in 1999.
mcq.st: 這部電影是根據真實故事改編的。這件事真的在1999年發生過。

mcq.q: Z is ______ letter of the English alphabet.
mcq.st: Z是英文字母的最後一個字母。

mcq.q: Your speech is too long. Please keep it short and ______.
mcq.st: 你的演講太長了。請保持簡短並切中要點。

mcq.q: Tom looked for his lost dog all day, but his hard work was ______. He never found it.
mcq.st: 湯姆找他走失的狗找了一整天，但他的努力都白費了。他始終沒有找到牠。

mcq.q: Ben broke his mom's favorite cup. Now he is ______.
mcq.st: 班打破了他媽媽最愛的杯子。現在他麻煩大了。

mcq.q: Lisa's home is ______ her school, so she has to get up at six and take a bus for an hour.
mcq.st: 莉莎家離學校很遠，所以她必須六點起床，搭一個小時的公車。

mcq.q: Everything in this store is ______ this week. You can buy two T-shirts for the price of one!
mcq.st: 這家店的所有商品這週都在特價。你可以用一件的價格買兩件T恤！

rows.d: as said by; based on
rows.s: _____ _____ the weather report, it will rain heavily this afternoon, so Grandpa told me to bring an umbrella to school.
rows.st: 【根據】氣象報告，今天下午會下大雨，所以爺爺叫我帶雨傘去學校。

rows.d: on the other side of a street from
rows.s: There is a new bubble tea shop _____ _____ our school, so many students buy drinks there after class every day.
rows.st: 我們學校【對面】有一家新的珍奶店，所以很多學生每天放學後都去那裡買飲料。

rows.d: later than a time or an event
rows.s: We usually go jogging along the river _____ dinner, because the weather is much cooler at night in summer.
rows.st: 我們通常在晚餐【之後】沿著河邊慢跑，因為夏天晚上的天氣涼爽多了。

rows.d: before a time or event
rows.s: We finished our science project two days _____ _____ the deadline, so we had time to check every page.
rows.st: 我們【在截止日期之前】兩天就完成了科學報告，所以有時間檢查每一頁。

rows.d: in front of; doing better than others
rows.s: In the race, Jason ran fast and stayed _____ _____ the other runners, so he won first place easily.
rows.st: 賽跑時，傑森跑得很快，一直【領先】其他選手，所以輕鬆拿下第一名。

rows.d: together with
rows.s: Mr. Chen went hiking on Yangmingshan last Sunday _____ _____ his two sons, and they saw many beautiful flowers on the way.
rows.st: 陳先生上週日【和】他的兩個兒子去陽明山健行，他們在路上看到許多美麗的花。

rows.d: except for
rows.s: _____ _____ Kevin, everyone in my class went on the school trip to the zoo, because he had a bad cold that day.
rows.st: 【除了】凱文【之外】，我們班上每個人都去了動物園校外教學，因為他那天得了重感冒。

rows.d: used to start talking about someone or something
rows.s: Most of my classmates want to go to the beach this summer. _____ _____ me, I'd rather stay home and read comic books.
rows.st: 我大部分的同學這個暑假都想去海邊。【至於】我，我寧願待在家看漫畫。

rows.d: about; when talking about
rows.s: We have decided to visit Tainan next weekend, but _____ _____ where we will stay, we still need to check some hotels online.
rows.st: 我們已經決定下週末去台南，但【至於】要住哪裡，我們還需要上網查一些飯店。

rows.d: except for; also, besides
rows.s: _____ _____ swimming, Jason also likes playing basketball with his classmates after school on Fridays.
rows.st: 【除了】游泳以外，Jason也喜歡星期五放學後和同學打籃球。

rows.d: in the first part of something
rows.s: _____ _____ _____ _____ the new school year, our teacher asked each of us to write down three goals and share them.
rows.st: 在新學年【開始】的時候，老師要我們每個人寫下三個目標並分享出來。

rows.d: at the lowest part of
rows.s: I finally found my lost math notebook _____ _____ _____ _____ my school bag, under all my books and pencil boxes.
rows.st: 我終於找到遺失的數學筆記本，它【在書包的底部】，壓在所有書和鉛筆盒下面。

rows.d: by losing something else
rows.s: Henry finished the whole video game in one weekend, but he did it _____ _____ _____ _____ his sleep and his homework.
rows.st: 亨利一個週末就破完整個電玩遊戲，但他是【犧牲】了睡眠和功課換來的。

rows.d: in the last part of something
rows.s: _____ _____ _____ _____ the movie, the little dog finally found its family, and many people in the theater cried.
rows.st: 在電影的【結尾】，小狗終於找到了牠的家人，戲院裡很多人都哭了。

rows.d: for a certain amount of money
rows.s: The shop is selling these sneakers _____ _____ _____ _____ only five hundred dollars this week, so my cousin bought two pairs.
rows.st: 這家店本週【以】只要五百元【的價格】賣這些球鞋，所以我表哥買了兩雙。

rows.d: when seeing something
rows.s: My little sister started crying _____ _____ _____ _____ the big spider on the wall, so Dad came and took it outside.
rows.st: 我妹妹【一看到】牆上的大蜘蛛就哭了起來，所以爸爸過來把牠拿到外面。

rows.d: at a distance from someone or something
rows.s: Please keep the medicine _____ _____ small children, and put it on the top shelf of the kitchen cabinet.
rows.st: 請把藥放在【遠離】小孩的地方，放在廚房櫃子的最上層。

rows.d: for the reason of something
rows.s: The baseball game between the two schools was canceled _____ _____ the heavy rain, so all the players went home early and felt disappointed.
rows.st: 兩校之間的棒球比賽【因為】大雨而取消，所以所有球員都提早回家，覺得很失望。

rows.d: earlier than a time or an action
rows.s: Please wash your hands _____ eating dinner, because you played with the dog in the park all afternoon.
rows.st: 吃晚餐【之前】請先洗手，因為你整個下午都在公園裡跟狗玩。

rows.d: because of something
rows.s: The baseball game was stopped in the fifth inning _____ _____ the heavy rain, and all the fans had to go home early.
rows.st: 【由於】大雨，棒球比賽在第五局就停止了，所有球迷都只好提早回家。

rows.d: not including someone or something
rows.s: Everyone in my class passed the math test _____ _____ Peter, who was sick and missed most of the lessons.
rows.st: 【除了彼得以外】，我們班每個人數學考試都及格了，他生病缺了大部分的課。

rows.d: because you worry that something will happen
rows.s: Lisa walked very slowly on the wet road _____ _____ _____ falling down and breaking her new phone.
rows.st: Lisa在濕滑的路上走得很慢，【因為害怕】跌倒摔壞她的新手機。

rows.d: as well as; besides
rows.s: _____ _____ _____ English, Yu-xuan is learning Japanese because she wants to travel to Osaka with her family next year.
rows.st: 【除了英文以外】，宇萱也在學日文，因為她明年想和家人去大阪旅行。

rows.d: if something bad happens
rows.s: _____ _____ _____ fire, students should leave the classroom quietly and walk to the playground with their teacher.
rows.st: 【萬一發生】火災，學生應該安靜地離開教室，並跟著老師走到操場。

rows.d: at the place facing the front of something
rows.s: We agreed to meet _____ _____ _____ the convenience store at seven, but Jason was late because he missed the bus.
rows.st: 我們約好七點在便利商店【前面】碰面，但傑森因為錯過公車而遲到了。

rows.d: to remember a dead person
rows.s: The students planted a tree near the school gate _____ _____ _____ their kind old principal, who passed away last year.
rows.st: 學生們在校門口附近種了一棵樹，【紀念】去年過世的慈祥老校長。

rows.d: arranged by size, number, time, and so on
rows.s: Please stand in a line _____ _____ _____ height, so the shortest students are in the front and the tallest are at the back.
rows.st: 請【按照】身高【順序】排成一排，讓最矮的同學在前面，最高的在後面。

rows.d: instead of someone
rows.s: Mr. Lin was sick today, so Ms. Chen taught our English class _____ _____ _____ him.
rows.st: 林老師今天生病了，所以陳老師【代替】他上我們的英文課。

rows.d: as an answer to
rows.s: _____ _____ _____ many complaints from parents, the school decided to make the lunch menu healthier and less oily.
rows.st: 為了【回應】許多家長的抱怨，學校決定讓午餐菜單更健康、更少油。

rows.d: looking for
rows.s: Every evening our dog runs around the yard _____ _____ _____ his ball, and he barks happily when he finds it.
rows.st: 每天傍晚我們的狗都在院子裡到處跑，【尋找】牠的球，找到時就開心地吠叫。

rows.d: even though there is
rows.s: _____ _____ _____ the heavy rain, thousands of fans waited outside the stadium because they wanted to see their favorite singer.
rows.st: 【儘管】下著大雨，數千名歌迷仍在體育場外等候，因為他們想見到最喜歡的歌手。

rows.d: when thinking about this part
rows.s: _____ _____ _____ price, the small phone is a better choice, but the bigger one takes much nicer photos.
rows.st: 【從價格的角度來看】，這支小手機是比較好的選擇，但大的那支拍照好看多了。

rows.d: in the back part inside something
rows.s: The kids always like to sit _____ _____ _____ _____ the bus because they can chat and play games there.
rows.st: 孩子們總是喜歡坐【在公車的後面】，因為他們可以在那裡聊天和玩遊戲。

rows.d: in the middle of a place
rows.s: There is a big fountain _____ _____ _____ _____ the park, and kids like to play near it on hot summer days.
rows.st: 公園【中央】有一座大噴泉，炎熱的夏天孩子們喜歡在它附近玩。

rows.d: when dealing with something hard
rows.s: _____ _____ _____ _____ a strong team from Japan, our baseball players stayed calm and played their best game of the year.
rows.st: 【面對】來自日本的強隊，我們的棒球選手保持冷靜，打出了今年最好的一場比賽。

rows.d: in the front part inside something
rows.s: Amy gets carsick easily, so she always sits _____ _____ _____ _____ the bus when our class goes on a field trip.
rows.st: Amy很容易暈車，所以我們班去校外教學時，她總是坐在【公車前段】。

rows.d: in the center of something or during something
rows.s: My phone rang loudly _____ _____ _____ _____ the concert, and everyone around me turned to look at me.
rows.st: 我的手機在音樂會【中間】大聲響起，我周圍的每個人都轉頭看我。

rows.d: in the place of something or someone
rows.s: It was raining heavily on Sunday morning, so we stayed home and watched a movie _____ _____ going to the beach.
rows.st: 星期天早上下著大雨，所以我們待在家看電影，【而不是】去海邊。

rows.d: about; on the subject of
rows.s: _____ _____ _____ the school trip, every student must bring a signed letter from their parents before next Friday.
rows.st: 【關於】校外教學，每位學生都必須在下週五前帶回家長簽名的同意書。

rows.d: right beside someone or something
rows.s: In the classroom, Lisa always sits _____ _____ the window because she likes to look at the trees when she feels tired.
rows.st: 在教室裡，麗莎總是坐在窗戶【旁邊】，因為她累的時候喜歡看看外面的樹。

rows.d: and also; and even more
rows.s: Living in the city is expensive because the rent is high, _____ _____ _____ the cost of food and transportation.
rows.st: 住在城市很貴，因為房租很高，【更別提】食物和交通的費用了。

rows.d: for someone else; in place of
rows.s: Lily went up to the stage and accepted the prize _____ _____ _____ our class because our class leader was sick that day.
rows.st: 莉莉走上台【代表】我們班領獎，因為我們班長那天生病了。

rows.w: on one's way to + 地方
rows.d: while you are going to a place
rows.s: Jenny saw a little cat in the rain _____ her _____ _____ school, so she took it to the animal hospital near her home.
rows.st: 珍妮【在去】學校【的路上】看到一隻淋雨的小貓，所以她把牠帶到家附近的動物醫院。

rows.d: on the back part of an animal or person
rows.s: In Thailand, Jenny took a short ride _____ _____ _____ _____ an elephant, and she said it was a little scary but fun.
rows.st: 在泰國，珍妮坐【在一頭大象的背上】短暫騎了一下，她說有點可怕但很好玩。

rows.d: because of; using something as the reason
rows.s: The coach chose the players for the big game _____ _____ _____ _____ how hard they practiced, not just how tall they were.
rows.st: 教練【根據】球員練習的努力程度來挑選大賽的選手，而不只是看他們有多高。

rows.w: on the way to + 地方
rows.d: while going to a place
rows.s: I saw a cute little cat sleeping under a car _____ _____ _____ _____ school this morning, so I took a photo.
rows.st: 今天早上我【在去】學校【的路上】看到一隻可愛的小貓睡在車子底下，所以我拍了照。

rows.d: before
rows.s: _____ _____ our trip to Japan, my family checked the weather every day and bought warm jackets for the snow.
rows.st: 去日本旅行【之前】，我們家每天都查看天氣，還買了保暖的外套來應付下雪。

rows.d: not caring about; no matter what
rows.s: The baseball team practices every afternoon _____ _____ the weather, so the players are used to rain and hot sun.
rows.st: 棒球隊【不論】天氣如何每天下午都會練習，所以球員們早已習慣下雨和大太陽。

rows.d: immediately after something
rows.s: My sister always does her homework _____ _____ school, so she has plenty of free time to watch TV at night.
rows.st: 我姊姊總是【一】放學【就馬上】寫功課，所以她晚上有很多空閒時間看電視。

rows.d: for example; like
rows.s: Our night market has many tasty snacks, _____ _____ stinky tofu and bubble tea, so tourists love to visit it on weekends.
rows.st: 我們的夜市有很多好吃的小吃，【像是】臭豆腐和珍珠奶茶，所以觀光客週末都很喜歡來逛。

rows.d: because of someone or something good
rows.s: _____ _____ my brother's help with math, I finally passed the test and my parents took me out for dinner.
rows.st: 【多虧】我哥哥幫我複習數學，我終於通過考試，我爸媽還帶我出去吃晚餐。

rows.d: as many or as much as
rows.s: This new bus can carry _____ _____ sixty passengers, so the whole class can go on the field trip together.
rows.st: 這台新巴士可以載【多達】六十名乘客，所以全班可以一起去校外教學。

rows.d: when talking about a certain topic
rows.s: My brother is not good at sports, but _____ _____ _____ _____ computers, he knows more than anyone in our family.
rows.st: 我哥哥不擅長運動，但【說到】電腦，他懂得比家裡任何人都多。

mcq.q: Mr. Lin made a lot of money ______ his health, and now he is very sick.
mcq.st: 林先生犧牲健康賺了很多錢，現在他病得很重。

mcq.q: We stayed home ______ the heavy rain.
mcq.st: 因為大雨，我們待在家裡。

mcq.q: My brother loves math, but ______ me, I like English better.
mcq.st: 我哥哥喜歡數學，但至於我，我比較喜歡英文。

mcq.q: ______ cooking, my mom is the best in our family.
mcq.st: 說到烹飪，我媽媽是我們家最厲害的。

mcq.q: ______ English, Amy can also speak Japanese.
mcq.st: 除了英文之外，Amy也會說日文。

mcq.q: I have a question ______ the homework.
mcq.st: 我有一個關於作業的問題。

mcq.q: The little monkey is riding ______ its mother.
mcq.st: 小猴子騎在牠媽媽的背上。

mcq.q: The hungry cat walked around the kitchen ______ food.
mcq.st: 那隻飢餓的貓在廚房裡走來走去尋找食物。

mcq.q: This bus can carry ______ fifty people.
mcq.st: 這台公車可以載多達五十人。

mcq.q: I saw an old friend ______ school this morning.
mcq.st: 今天早上我在去學校的路上看到一位老朋友。

mcq.q: The driver always sits ______ the bus.
mcq.st: 司機總是坐在公車的前部。

mcq.q: ______ my teacher's help, I passed the math test.
mcq.st: 多虧老師的幫忙，我通過了數學考試。

mcq.q: Ben goes jogging every morning ______ the weather.
mcq.st: 不論天氣如何，Ben每天早上都去慢跑。

mcq.q: I like fruits ______ apples and bananas.
mcq.st: 我喜歡水果，例如蘋果和香蕉。

mcq.q: Please keep the baby ______ the hot water.
mcq.st: 請讓寶寶遠離熱水。

mcq.q: This restaurant has great food, ______ its friendly service.
mcq.st: 這家餐廳有很棒的食物，更不用說它親切的服務。

mcq.q: The students had different ideas ______ where to go for the class trip.
mcq.st: 學生們對於校外教學要去哪裡有不同的想法。

mcq.q: Mia did her homework ______ dinner.
mcq.st: Mia晚餐後馬上就寫功課。

mcq.q: Wash your hands ______ eating.
mcq.st: 吃東西之前要洗手。

mcq.q: There is a tall tree ______ our school.
mcq.st: 我們學校前面有一棵高大的樹。

mcq.q: I found my lost key ______ my bag.
mcq.st: 我在我的包包底部找到我遺失的鑰匙。

mcq.q: My phone rang ______ the movie, and everyone looked at me.
mcq.st: 我的手機在電影播到一半時響了，大家都看著我。

mcq.q: The town built a statue ______ a kind old doctor who helped many people.
mcq.st: 這個鎮為了紀念一位幫助過許多人的親切老醫生，建了一座雕像。

mcq.q: ______ playing the piano, Lily also plays the violin.
mcq.st: 除了彈鋼琴以外，Lily也會拉小提琴。

mcq.q: ______ the weather report, it will rain tomorrow.
mcq.st: 根據氣象報告，明天會下雨。

mcq.q: Mr. Wang is sick today, so Ms. Chen will teach our class ______ him.
mcq.st: 王老師今天生病，所以陳老師會代替他教我們班。

mcq.q: Our team is ten points ______ the other team.
mcq.st: 我們隊領先另一隊十分。

mcq.q: Please turn off your phone ______ the test.
mcq.st: 考試之前請關掉手機。

mcq.q: Amy sits ______ me in class, so we often talk.
mcq.st: Amy上課坐在我旁邊，所以我們常聊天。

mcq.q: Let's walk to the park ______ taking the bus.
mcq.st: 我們走路去公園，而不要搭公車吧。

mcq.q: Jenny finished her report two days ______ the deadline.
mcq.st: Jenny比截止日期提前兩天完成了報告。

mcq.q: ______ fire, please use the stairs, not the elevator.
mcq.st: 萬一發生火災，請走樓梯，不要搭電梯。

mcq.q: ______ the heavy rain, they still played soccer.
mcq.st: 儘管下大雨，他們還是去踢足球。

mcq.q: The children are sleeping ______ the car.
mcq.st: 孩子們正在車子的後座睡覺。

mcq.q: We have a big test ______ this month.
mcq.st: 我們在這個月底有一個大考。

mcq.q: ______ price, this phone is better than that one.
mcq.st: 就價格而言，這支手機比那支好。

mcq.q: Everyone went to the party ______ Tom, who was sick.
mcq.st: 除了生病的Tom以外，大家都去了派對。

mcq.q: She walked slowly on the ice ______ falling down.
mcq.st: 她因為害怕跌倒，在冰上走得很慢。

mcq.q: Please line up ______ height, from short to tall.
mcq.st: 請按照身高順序排隊，從矮到高。

mcq.q: The train was late ______ the typhoon.
mcq.st: 火車因為颱風而誤點了。

mcq.q: We went swimming ______ school.
mcq.st: 我們放學後去游泳。

mcq.q: The teacher chose the class leader ______ the students' votes.
mcq.st: 老師以學生的投票為依據選出班長。

mcq.q: We stopped at a convenience store ______ the beach.
mcq.st: 我們在去海邊的路上，在一家便利商店停了一下。

mcq.q: ______ the long lines, we had a great time at the zoo.
mcq.st: 除了大排長龍之外，我們在動物園玩得很開心。

mcq.q: I bought this T-shirt ______ 200 dollars.
mcq.st: 我以兩百元的價格買了這件T恤。

mcq.q: Let's meet at the bank; it is ______ the post office, just on the other side of the street.
mcq.st: 我們在銀行見面吧；它就在郵局的對面，就在街道的另一邊。

mcq.q: Amy is our class leader, so she thanked the teacher ______ our whole class.
mcq.st: Amy 是我們的班長，所以她代表我們全班向老師道謝。

mcq.q: ______ the movie, the hero is a poor boy, but at the end he becomes a king.
mcq.st: 在電影的開頭，主角是個窮男孩，但最後他成為了國王。

mcq.q: The little girl started to cry ______ the big dog.
mcq.st: 小女孩一看到那隻大狗就開始哭。

mcq.q: There is a big fountain ______ the park, and many paths go out from it to every side.
mcq.st: 公園的中央有一座大噴泉，許多小路從那裡通往四面八方。

mcq.q: The firefighters stayed calm and brave ______ great danger.
mcq.st: 消防員面對極大的危險時仍保持冷靜和勇敢。

mcq.q: ______ the students' letters, the school decided to open the library on Saturdays.
mcq.st: 作為對學生來信的回應，學校決定在星期六開放圖書館。

mcq.q: Please bring your notebook ______ your English book because you will need both of them tomorrow.
mcq.st: 請把你的筆記本和英文課本一起帶來，因為你明天兩樣都會用到。

mcq.q: Tom played video games all night ______ his sleep, so he was very tired the next day.
mcq.st: Tom 犧牲睡眠整晚打電動，所以隔天非常累。

mcq.q: The baseball game was stopped ______ the heavy rain.
mcq.st: 棒球比賽因為大雨而暫停了。

mcq.q: My parents both like coffee; ______ me, I prefer milk tea.
mcq.st: 我爸媽都喜歡咖啡；至於我，我比較喜歡奶茶。

mcq.q: Tina is not good at sports, but ______ math, she is the best student in our class.
mcq.st: Tina 不擅長運動，但說到數學，她是我們班上最好的學生。

mcq.q: ______ English, Ben also studies Japanese and Korean after school.
mcq.st: 除了英文之外，Ben 放學後還學日文和韓文。

mcq.q: I have a question ______ the homework for tomorrow.
mcq.st: 我有一個關於明天作業的問題。

mcq.q: The little boy is tired, so he is sitting ______ his father as they walk home together.
mcq.st: 小男孩累了，所以他們一起走路回家時，他坐在爸爸的背上。

rows.d: very much; a lot
rows.s: Lin Mei-ling studied _____ _____ _____ for the English test last month, so she was very happy when she got a high score.
rows.st: 林美玲上個月為了英文考試讀了【很多】書，所以她拿到高分時非常開心。

rows.d: very much (after a verb)
rows.s: Ben has grown _____ _____ this year, so his mom needs to buy him new school uniforms and bigger shoes.
rows.st: 班今年長高【很多】，所以他媽媽需要幫他買新的制服和更大的鞋子。

rows.d: most importantly
rows.s: When you ride a bike to school, you should wear a helmet and watch the traffic, but _____ _____, never use your phone.
rows.st: 你騎腳踏車上學時，應該戴安全帽並注意交通，但【最重要的是】，絕對不要使用手機。

rows.d: remember that; in the end
rows.s: Don't be too angry with your little brother for breaking the cup; _____ _____, he is only four years old.
rows.st: 別因為你弟弟打破杯子就太生氣，【畢竟】他才四歲。

rows.d: when a class finishes
rows.s: If you have any questions about the homework, you can come and talk to me _____ _____ in the teachers' office.
rows.st: 如果你對作業有任何問題，可以【下課後】到教師辦公室來找我談。

rows.d: when you have finished eating
rows.s: The doctor told Grandma to take this medicine three times a day _____ _____, so she keeps it on the dining table.
rows.st: 醫生要奶奶每天三次【飯後】吃這個藥，所以她把藥放在餐桌上。

rows.d: when school finishes for the day
rows.s: My friends and I often play basketball _____ _____, but today we have to go home early because of the typhoon.
rows.st: 我和朋友們常常【放學後】打籃球，但今天因為颱風，我們必須早點回家。

rows.d: earlier than planned
rows.s: Thanks to good weather, the workers finished the new library _____ _____ _____, so it opened a month early.
rows.st: 多虧好天氣，工人們【超前進度】蓋好了新圖書館，所以它提早一個月開放。

rows.d: in many places on earth
rows.s: My uncle is a pilot, so he flies _____ _____ _____ _____ and sends us postcards from many countries.
rows.st: 我叔叔是機師，所以他飛遍【全世界各地】，還從很多國家寄明信片給我們。

rows.d: for the whole day
rows.s: It rained _____ _____ _____ on Saturday, so the children stayed at home and played board games with their parents.
rows.st: 星期六雨下了【一整天】，所以孩子們待在家裡和爸媽玩桌遊。

rows.d: in every part of the world
rows.s: People _____ _____ _____ _____ love Taiwanese bubble tea, and you can even buy it in London and New York.
rows.st: 【全世界各地】的人都喜歡台灣珍珠奶茶，你甚至在倫敦和紐約都買得到。

rows.d: in every part of the world
rows.s: People _____ _____ _____ _____ love Taiwanese bubble tea, and you can find shops selling it in many big cities.
rows.st: 【世界各地】的人都喜歡台灣珍珠奶茶，在許多大城市都能找到賣它的店。

rows.d: for the whole trip or distance
rows.s: My little sister slept _____ _____ _____ from Taipei to Kaohsiung on the high-speed rail, so she missed the view.
rows.st: 我妹妹搭高鐵從台北到高雄【一路上】都在睡覺，所以錯過了沿途風景。

rows.d: during the whole year
rows.s: Kenting is warm _____ _____ _____, so many tourists go swimming there even in December and January.
rows.st: 墾丁【一年到頭】都很溫暖，所以即使在十二月和一月，也有很多遊客去那裡游泳。

rows.d: and other similar things
rows.s: In our school club, we play many board games, like chess, Monopoly, UNO, _____ _____ _____, and everyone has a great time.
rows.st: 在我們的學校社團裡，我們玩很多桌遊，像是西洋棋、大富翁、UNO【等等】，每個人都玩得很開心。

rows.d: not at all
rows.s: The movie was _____ _____ interesting, so my sister and I fell asleep before it ended and missed the last part.
rows.st: 那部電影【根本不】有趣，所以我姊姊和我在電影結束前就睡著了，錯過了最後一段。

rows.d: all day and all night
rows.c: 不眠不休地、日以繼夜地
rows.s: The nurses at the hospital worked _____ _____ _____ during the typhoon because many people were hurt and needed help.
rows.st: 颱風期間，醫院的護理師【日以繼夜地】工作，因為很多人受傷需要幫助。

rows.d: coming very soon
rows.s: Chinese New Year is just _____ _____ _____, so Mom is busy cleaning the house and buying food for the big family dinner.
rows.st: 農曆新年【即將來臨】，所以媽媽忙著打掃房子，並為家族團圓飯採買食物。

rows.d: because of this
rows.s: Tina stayed up late playing games every night; _____ _____ _____, she often fell asleep in class and got poor grades.
rows.st: 蒂娜每晚熬夜打電動，【因此】她常在課堂上睡著，成績也很差。

rows.d: like what comes next
rows.s: The teacher said that the rules for the class picnic are _____ _____: bring your own water, stay with your group, and clean up after lunch.
rows.st: 老師說班級野餐的規則【如下】：自己帶水、跟著小組行動、午餐後要清理乾淨。

rows.d: in the way I thought it would be
rows.s: _____ _____ _____, the math test was very difficult, so many students in my class didn't finish it on time.
rows.st: 【如我所料】，數學考試非常難，所以我們班很多同學沒在時間內寫完。

rows.d: very quickly; as fast as you can
rows.s: Please return the library books _____ _____ _____ _____ because many other students are waiting to borrow them.
rows.st: 請【盡快】歸還圖書館的書，因為還有很多同學在等著借。

rows.d: as quickly as you are able
rows.s: Grandma is sick in the hospital, so please come home _____ _____ _____ _____ _____ after school today.
rows.st: 奶奶生病住院了，所以今天放學後請你【盡快】回家。

rows.d: in the same way as always
rows.s: _____ _____, Grandma got up at five o'clock and went to the park to do tai chi with her friends before breakfast.
rows.st: 【像往常一樣】，奶奶五點起床，在早餐前去公園和朋友打太極拳。

rows.d: too; also
rows.s: Ben ordered a big bowl of beef noodles, and he ordered some dumplings _____ _____ because he was really hungry after soccer practice.
rows.st: 班點了一大碗牛肉麵，他【也】點了一些水餃，因為足球練習後他真的很餓。

rows.d: by paying or losing a lot
rows.s: Our team won the final game, but _____ _____ _____ _____, because two of our best players got hurt.
rows.st: 我們隊贏了決賽，但【付出了高昂代價】，因為兩名最好的球員受傷了。

rows.d: for a lot of money
rows.s: That old baseball card was sold _____ _____ _____ _____ because a famous player wrote his name on it many years ago.
rows.st: 那張舊棒球卡【以高價】賣出，因為很多年前一位知名球員在上面簽了名。

rows.d: for little money
rows.s: If you go to the market just before it closes, you can often buy fresh vegetables _____ _____ _____ _____.
rows.st: 如果你在市場快打烊前去，常常可以【以低價】買到新鮮蔬菜。

rows.d: always
rows.s: Swimmers must stay near the lifeguard _____ _____ _____ because the waves at this beach can be very strong in summer.
rows.st: 游泳的人必須【一直】待在救生員附近，因為這個海灘夏天的浪可能很大。

rows.d: not straight; leaning to one side
rows.s: The picture on the wall was hanging _____ _____ _____, so Mom asked me to make it straight before the guests arrived.
rows.st: 牆上的畫掛得【歪歪斜斜的】，所以媽媽叫我在客人到之前把它掛正。

rows.d: eating dinner
rows.s: When the phone rang last night, our whole family was _____ _____, so nobody wanted to get up and answer it.
rows.st: 昨晚電話響的時候，我們全家【正在吃晚餐】，所以沒有人想起身去接。

rows.d: in the beginning
rows.s: _____ _____, I was afraid of the big dog next door, but now we are good friends and I walk him every evening.
rows.st: 【起初】我很怕隔壁的大狗，但現在我們是好朋友，我每天傍晚都會帶牠去散步。

rows.d: close by and easy to reach
rows.s: Always keep a flashlight and some water _____ _____ during typhoon season, because the power may go out at night.
rows.st: 颱風季節時，一定要把手電筒和一些水放在【手邊】，因為晚上可能會停電。

rows.d: finally, after waiting a long time
rows.c: 終於（帶有鬆一口氣的語氣）
rows.s: We waited at the airport for almost three hours because of the storm, and _____ _____ Grandpa's plane landed safely.
rows.st: 因為暴風雨，我們在機場等了將近三個小時，【終於】爺爺的飛機平安降落了。

rows.d: not less than
rows.s: The doctor told my dad to walk _____ _____ thirty minutes every day because exercise is good for his heart.
rows.st: 醫生叫我爸爸每天【至少】走路三十分鐘，因為運動對他的心臟有好處。

rows.d: during the time for lunch
rows.s: Many students go to the school library _____ _____ because it is quiet and cool, and they can read comics there.
rows.st: 很多學生【在午餐時間】去學校圖書館，因為那裡安靜又涼爽，而且可以看漫畫。

rows.d: not more than a number

rows.st: 我弟弟要【當眾】唱歌時會害羞，但在家裡他整天都大聲唱歌。

rows.d: as a way of thanking someone
rows.s: Ming helped his neighbor carry heavy boxes upstairs, and _____ _____, she gave him a bag of fresh oranges from her farm.
rows.st: 阿明幫鄰居把重箱子搬上樓，而她送了他一袋自家農場的新鮮柳丁做為【回報】。

rows.d: in a few words
rows.s: The food was cold, the waiter was rude, and the prices were high; _____ _____, we will never eat at that restaurant again.
rows.st: 食物是冷的、服務生很無禮、價格又高；【總而言之】，我們再也不會去那家餐廳吃飯了。

rows.d: outside the earth, among the stars
rows.s: Astronauts live _____ _____ for months, and they have to exercise every day because their bodies get weak there.
rows.st: 太空人【在太空中】生活好幾個月，他們每天都必須運動，因為身體在那裡會變虛弱。

rows.d: if that is true or happens
rows.c: 如果那樣；在那種情況下
rows.s: A: Sorry, the bus to the zoo is not coming for another forty minutes. B: _____ _____ _____, let's just take a taxi there.
rows.st: A：抱歉，去動物園的公車還要四十分鐘才會來。B：【如果那樣】，我們就搭計程車去吧。

rows.d: at first; at the start
rows.s: _____ _____ _____, I couldn't swim at all, but after many lessons I can now swim across the pool.
rows.st: 【一開始】我完全不會游泳，但上了很多堂課之後，我現在能游完整個泳池了。

rows.d: inside a round shape or group
rows.s: The PE teacher asked all of us to stand _____ _____ _____ and pass the ball to the person on our left.
rows.st: 體育老師要我們全部站【在圓圈中】，把球傳給左邊的人。

rows.d: in the place inside where two walls meet
rows.s: Our teacher put a big plant _____ _____ _____ of the classroom, and it makes the room look fresh and green.
rows.st: 老師在教室的【角落】放了一盆大植物，讓教室看起來清新又綠意盎然。

rows.d: where there is no light
rows.s: My little brother is afraid of staying _____ _____ _____, so he always sleeps with a small light on.
rows.st: 我弟弟害怕待【在黑暗中】，所以他睡覺時總是開著一盞小燈。

rows.d: finally, after a long time or many changes
rows.s: We talked for an hour about where to go for the class trip, and _____ _____ _____, everyone agreed to visit Kenting.
rows.st: 我們討論了一個小時要去哪裡校外教學，【最後】大家都同意去墾丁。

rows.d: in an open area of farm land
rows.s: The farmers were working _____ _____ _____ under the hot sun, so we brought them some cold water and fruit.
rows.st: 農夫們頂著大太陽【在田野間】工作，所以我們帶了一些冷水和水果給他們。

rows.d: at the beginning; first
rows.s: If you didn't want to join the trip, why did you say yes _____ _____ _____ _____ when your friends asked you last week?
rows.st: 如果你不想參加這趟旅行，上週朋友問你時，你【一開始】為什麼要答應呢？

rows.d: in the time that will come
rows.s: _____ _____ _____, Hsiao-wen wants to be a doctor because she hopes to help sick people in poor countries.
rows.st: 【在未來】，曉雯想當醫生，因為她希望幫助貧窮國家的病人。

rows.d: in the main room for relaxing at home
rows.s: After dinner, our whole family likes to sit _____ _____ _____ _____ and watch a funny TV show together.
rows.st: 晚餐後，我們全家喜歡坐【在客廳】一起看好笑的電視節目。

rows.d: after a long time; in the end
rows.s: Eating fast food every day may seem easy, but _____ _____ _____ _____, it can cause serious health problems for you.
rows.st: 每天吃速食看起來或許很方便，但【長期下來】，它會帶給你嚴重的健康問題。

rows.d: in an area with many high hills
rows.s: My grandparents live _____ _____ _____, so the air there is fresh and the nights are cool even in summer.
rows.st: 我的祖父母住【在山上】，所以那裡空氣清新，即使夏天晚上也很涼爽。

rows.d: printed in a daily paper
rows.s: My father read a story _____ _____ _____ this morning about a dog that saved a little boy from a fire.
rows.st: 爸爸今天早上【在報紙上】讀到一篇報導，內容是一隻狗從火災中救出一個小男孩。

rows.d: in the very large sea
rows.s: Whales and sharks live _____ _____ _____, so we should not throw plastic bags into the water when we visit the beach.
rows.st: 鯨魚和鯊魚生活【在海洋裡】，所以我們去海邊時不應該把塑膠袋丟進水裡。

rows.d: in a way that is totally different
rows.s: My cousin and I both love dogs, but we think _____ _____ _____ _____ about cats, because I love them and she hates them.
rows.st: 我表妹和我都喜歡狗，但我們對貓的想法【完全相反】，因為我很愛貓，她卻很討厭。

rows.d: in the time before now
rows.s: _____ _____ _____, people wrote letters to their friends, but now most of them send messages on their phones.
rows.st: 【在過去】，人們會寫信給朋友，但現在大多數人都用手機傳訊息。

rows.d: in a grass field for animals
rows.s: The sheep were eating grass quietly _____ _____ _____ when a big black dog suddenly ran toward them.
rows.st: 羊群正【在牧場中】安靜地吃草，這時一隻大黑狗突然朝牠們跑過去。

rows.d: in a small area of still water
rows.s: There are many frogs and fish _____ _____ _____ behind our school, and we watch them during the lunch break.
rows.st: 我們學校後面的【池塘裡】有很多青蛙和魚，我們午休時會去看牠們。

rows.d: now, at this time
rows.s: My teacher says we should not worry too much about tomorrow but enjoy every day and live _____ _____ _____.
rows.st: 老師說我們不該太擔心明天，而是要享受每一天，活【在當下】。

rows.d: inside the water of a river
rows.s: The water is clean, so you can see many small fish swimming _____ _____ _____ when you stand on the old bridge.
rows.st: 水很清澈，所以你站在老橋上時，可以看到很多小魚【在河裡】游來游去。

rows.d: like another person or thing does
rows.s: Twins Andy and Eddie always laugh _____ _____ _____ _____, so their friends can't tell who is laughing.
rows.st: 雙胞胎安迪和艾迪總是【以同樣的方式】笑，所以朋友們分不出是誰在笑。

rows.d: in the salt water near land
rows.s: The water was warm and clear, so the children swam _____ _____ _____ for two hours before they went back to the hotel.
rows.st: 海水溫暖又清澈，所以孩子們【在大海中】游了兩個小時才回飯店。

rows.d: up above the earth, in the air
rows.s: When Yi-ting looked up at night, she saw many bright stars _____ _____ _____ because there were no clouds at all.
rows.st: 怡婷晚上抬頭看時，看到許多明亮的星星【在空中】，因為一點雲都沒有。

rows.d: where snow is falling or lying
rows.s: We visited Hokkaido last winter, and the kids played _____ _____ _____ all afternoon before they drank hot chocolate.
rows.st: 我們去年冬天去北海道，孩子們整個下午都【在雪中】玩耍，然後才喝熱巧克力。

rows.d: during very bad wind and rain
rows.s: Many trees fell down _____ _____ _____ last night, and the students could not go to school this morning.
rows.st: 昨晚許多樹【在暴風雨中】倒下，學生今天早上無法上學。

rows.d: where the sun shines on you
rows.s: Don't leave the chocolate _____ _____ _____ for too long, or it will melt and make a mess in the car.
rows.st: 不要把巧克力放【在陽光底下】太久，否則它會融化，把車子弄得一團亂。

rows.d: among the branches of a tree
rows.c: 在樹上（不屬於樹的東西，如鳥、貓）
rows.s: Our cat climbed up very high, and now it is sitting _____ _____ _____ and crying because it is afraid to come down.
rows.st: 我們的貓爬得很高，現在正坐【在樹上】哭叫，因為牠不敢下來。

rows.d: inside water, swimming or floating
rows.s: The swimming coach told us to relax our bodies when we are _____ _____ _____, or we will get tired very quickly.
rows.st: 游泳教練告訴我們【在水裡】時要放鬆身體，否則很快就會累。

rows.d: in nature, not in a zoo or home
rows.s: Tigers in the zoo look calm and lazy, but _____ _____ _____ they must hunt for their own food every day.
rows.st: 動物園裡的老虎看起來平靜又懶散，但【在野外】牠們每天都得自己獵食。

rows.d: on the earth; anywhere
rows.s: Mount Everest is the highest mountain _____ _____ _____, and many climbers dream of standing on its top one day.
rows.st: 聖母峰是【世界上】最高的山，許多登山者夢想有一天能站上峰頂。

rows.d: used to make a question stronger
rows.s: What _____ _____ _____ happened to your shoes? They are so dirty, and you only bought them yesterday!
rows.st: 你的鞋子【到底】發生了什麼事？它們好髒，而且你昨天才買的！

rows.d: by doing it like this
rows.s: Grandma puts the vegetables in cold water before she cooks them, and _____ _____ _____ they stay fresh and green.
rows.st: 奶奶在煮蔬菜前先把它們泡在冷水裡，【以這種方式】讓它們保持新鮮翠綠。

rows.d: early enough to do something
rows.s: Peter ran all the way to the station and got there just _____ _____ to catch the last train home.
rows.st: 彼得一路跑到車站，【及時】趕上了回家的最後一班火車。

rows.d: when everything is added together
rows.s: We bought three T-shirts and two hats at the market, and we paid one thousand dollars _____ _____.
rows.st: 我們在市場買了三件T恤和兩頂帽子，【總共】付了一千元。

rows.d: one after another
rows.s: During the speaking test, the students went to the teacher's desk _____ _____ and answered three questions about their hobbies.
rows.st: 口說測驗時，學生們【依次地】走到老師桌前，回答三個關於嗜好的問題。

rows.d: as a result; next
rows.s: Kids learn good habits from their parents, and they _____ _____ teach those habits to their own children when they become adults.
rows.st: 孩子從父母身上學到好習慣，長大成人後再【轉而】把這些習慣教給自己的孩子。

rows.d: wearing the special clothes of a school or job
rows.s: All the students at Mei-ling's school must come to class _____ _____ on Mondays, but they can wear their own clothes on Fridays.
rows.st: 美玲學校的所有學生週一都必須【穿制服】來上課，但週五可以穿自己的衣服。

rows.d: to be safe if something happens
rows.s: The sky looked dark this morning, so Kevin put an umbrella in his backpack _____ _____ _____.
rows.st: 今天早上天空看起來很暗，所以Kevin在背包裡放了一把傘【以防萬一】。

rows.d: the evening or night before today
rows.s: I stayed up late _____ _____ to finish my science report, so I feel very sleepy in class today.
rows.st: 我【昨晚】熬夜完成自然報告，所以今天上課覺得很想睡。

rows.d: on the most recent time before now
rows.s: I forgot my umbrella _____ _____ and got very wet, so this time I brought two in my backpack.
rows.st: 我【上一次】忘了帶傘，淋得全身濕透，所以這次我在背包裡帶了兩把。

rows.d: at the time when we saw each other before
rows.s: _____ _____ _____ _____, you were still in elementary school, but now you are taller than your older brother.
rows.st: 【上一次我們見面時】，你還在讀國小，但現在你已經比你哥哥還高了。

rows.d: the year before this year
rows.s: My family went to Japan _____ _____, and we saw beautiful cherry blossoms in a big park in Tokyo.
rows.st: 我們家【去年】去了日本，在東京的一座大公園看到了美麗的櫻花。

rows.d: slowly, a small amount at a time
rows.s: At first Wei-ting couldn't swim at all, but _____ _____ _____ she got better, and now she can swim fifty meters.
rows.st: 一開始，薇婷完全不會游泳，但她【一點一點地】進步，現在她能游五十公尺了。

rows.d: usually; most of the time
rows.s: _____ _____ _____ _____, my dad comes home late on Fridays because he has meetings, so we usually eat dinner without him.
rows.st: 【大多數時候】，我爸爸星期五都很晚回家，因為他要開會，所以我們通常沒等他就先吃晚餐。

rows.d: almost; about
rows.s: The new science project is _____ _____ _____ finished, but we still need to add some pictures before we give it to the teacher.
rows.st: 新的自然科專題【差不多】完成了，但在交給老師之前我們還需要加一些圖片。

rows.d: the most important thing is
rows.s: To learn English well, read every day, practice speaking, and _____ _____ _____ _____, never be afraid of mistakes.
rows.st: 要學好英文，就要每天閱讀、練習說，而且【最重要的是】，永遠不要害怕犯錯。

rows.d: the most important thing is
rows.s: Before a long hike, bring water and snacks, and _____ _____, tell your family where you are going.
rows.st: 長途健行前要帶水和點心，而且【最重要的是】，要告訴家人你要去哪裡。

rows.d: never, not at any time (strong)

rows.st: 我【絕對不會】再一個人在海裡游泳，因為去年夏天一個大浪差點把我捲走。

rows.d: not anymore

rows.st: 自從我們家附近的新捷運站開通後，我哥哥【不再】需要在雨中騎機車上班了。

rows.d: not more than; only
rows.s: Each student can borrow _____ _____ _____ five books from the school library at one time, so choose carefully.
rows.st: 每個學生一次可以從學校圖書館借【不超過】五本書，所以要仔細挑選。

rows.d: used to show something is surprising or extreme
rows.s: Jack was so tired after the long hike that he did _____ _____ eat dinner before he fell asleep on the sofa.
rows.st: 傑克在長途健行後累到【連】晚餐【都沒】吃就在沙發上睡著了。

rows.d: only; just this thing
rows.s: My little brother was so tired after soccer practice that he wanted _____ _____ a hot bath and his soft bed.
rows.st: 我弟弟足球練習後累到【只】想要泡個熱水澡和他柔軟的床。

rows.d: sometimes, but not often
rows.s: Tina usually walks to school, but _____ _____ _____ her father drives her there when it rains very hard.
rows.st: Tina通常走路上學，但【偶爾】雨下得很大時，她爸爸會開車載她去。

rows.d: yes, surely
