rows.st: 我妹妹問她能不能玩我的新拼圖時，我說：「【當然】可以，但請不要弄丟任何一片。」

rows.d: not to be shared with the public
rows.c: 非公開的、不列入紀錄的
rows.s: The mayor told the student reporters something _____ _____ _____, so they agreed not to put it in the school newspaper.
rows.st: 市長告訴學生記者一些【不列入紀錄的】事情，所以他們同意不把它寫進校刊裡。

rows.d: in a regular way, like daily or weekly
rows.s: Our class cleans the park near the school _____ _____ monthly _____, and we always find lots of plastic bottles there.
rows.st: 我們班【以每月一次為基礎】定期清掃學校附近的公園，而且我們總是在那裡發現很多塑膠瓶。

rows.d: being a member of a group of players
rows.s: Jason has been _____ _____ _____ since he was nine, and he practices soccer with his friends every Saturday morning.
rows.st: 傑森從九歲起就一直【在球隊裡】，他每週六早上都和朋友練足球。

rows.d: usually; as a normal amount
rows.s: _____ _____, students in our class spend about two hours on homework every night, but some spend much more time.
rows.st: 【平均而言】，我們班的學生每晚花大約兩小時寫作業，但有些人花的時間多很多。

rows.d: traveling for work
rows.s: Ms. Huang often flies to Singapore _____ _____, but this time she took her children with her for a short trip.
rows.st: 黃小姐常常【因公出差】飛到新加坡，但這次她帶孩子一起去短暫旅行。

rows.d: used to make a question stronger
rows.s: What _____ _____ happened to your shoes? They're covered in mud, and you only went out to buy milk!
rows.st: 你的鞋子【到底】怎麼了？上面全是泥巴，而你只是出去買個牛奶而已！

rows.d: in the world
rows.s: Water is very important to every living thing _____ _____, so we should not waste it when we brush our teeth.
rows.st: 水對【世界上】每一種生物都很重要，所以我們刷牙時不應該浪費水。

rows.d: by walking
rows.s: The museum is only ten minutes from our hotel, so we decided to go there _____ _____ instead of taking a taxi.
rows.st: 博物館離我們飯店只有十分鐘，所以我們決定【步行】過去，而不搭計程車。

rows.d: every Monday
rows.s: _____ _____, our class has P.E. in the morning, so we always wear our sports clothes to school.
rows.st: 【每週一】我們班早上有體育課，所以我們總是穿運動服上學。

rows.d: carried on the back of a person
rows.s: The hikers carried heavy bags _____ their _____ when they climbed Yangmingshan, but they still smiled all the way up.
rows.st: 健行的人爬陽明山時【背上】背著很重的包包，但他們一路上還是面帶微笑。

rows.d: on top of a person's head
rows.s: My little sister walked into the kitchen with a paper crown _____ her _____ because she wanted to be a princess today.
rows.st: 我妹妹【頭上】戴著紙皇冠走進廚房，因為她今天想當公主。

rows.d: alone; without help
rows.s: Eric is only fourteen, but he traveled to Kaohsiung _____ his _____ by train, and his parents were very proud of him.
rows.st: 艾瑞克才十四歲，但他【獨自】搭火車去了高雄，他的父母非常以他為傲。

rows.d: on the right or left side of someone
rows.s: When you walk out of the MRT station, you will see the post office _____ your _____, right next to a small coffee shop.
rows.st: 你走出捷運站時，會看到郵局【在你的右邊】，就在一家小咖啡店旁邊。

rows.d: not by accident; meaning to do it
rows.s: I'm sorry I stepped on your foot, but I didn't do it _____ _____ because the bus suddenly stopped.
rows.st: 對不起我踩到你的腳，但我不是【故意的】，是因為公車突然停下來。

rows.d: on top of a bed
rows.s: Don't leave your wet towel _____ _____ _____, or your sheets will get wet and smell bad tonight.
rows.st: 不要把濕毛巾放【在床上】，否則你的床單會濕掉，今晚會有臭味。

rows.d: played by a machine for CDs
rows.s: Dad put his favorite old song _____ _____ _____ _____, and we all sang along while we cleaned the house.
rows.st: 爸爸把他最愛的老歌放進【CD播放機中】播放，我們一邊打掃房子一邊跟著唱。

rows.d: using a mobile phone
rows.s: Students should not play games _____ _____ _____ _____ in class, or the teacher will take the phones away until the end of the day.
rows.st: 學生上課時不應該【在手機上】玩遊戲，否則老師會把手機收走直到放學。

rows.d: using a computer
rows.s: My sister spends two hours _____ _____ _____ every night because she has to do her homework and send emails.
rows.st: 我姊姊每晚花兩個小時【在電腦上】，因為她要寫作業和寄電子郵件。

rows.d: the opposite is true
rows.s: Many people think this math teacher is very strict. _____ _____ _____, she is kind and always helps students after class.
rows.st: 很多人認為這位數學老師很嚴格。【相反地】，她很親切，下課後總是會幫助學生。

rows.d: at the place outside where two streets meet
rows.s: There is a convenience store _____ _____ _____ of my street, so I often buy breakfast there before I go to school.
rows.st: 我家那條街的【轉角】有一家便利商店，所以我上學前常在那裡買早餐。

rows.d: at a place where food is grown
rows.s: Uncle Wang grows rice and vegetables _____ _____ _____, and he gets up very early every morning to feed the chickens.
rows.st: 王叔叔【在農場裡】種稻米和蔬菜，而且他每天一大早就起床餵雞。

rows.d: lying or sitting down on the ground inside
rows.s: My little brother left his toy cars _____ _____ _____, and Dad almost fell when he walked into the room.
rows.st: 我弟弟把他的玩具車留【在地板上】，爸爸走進房間時差點跌倒。

rows.d: on the ground covered with grass
rows.s: On sunny weekends, many families sit _____ _____ _____ in Daan Park and enjoy a picnic with sandwiches and fruit.
rows.st: 天氣晴朗的週末，很多家庭會在大安公園坐【在草地上】，享受有三明治和水果的野餐。

rows.d: online, using the Internet
rows.s: If you don't know the meaning of a word, you can look it up _____ _____ _____ or ask your teacher.
rows.st: 如果你不知道一個字的意思，可以【在網路上】查，或問你的老師。

rows.d: talking or waiting on the phone
rows.s: Please hurry and come to the phone, Ben, because Grandma is _____ _____ _____ and she wants to talk to you.
rows.st: 班，請快點來接電話，因為奶奶正【在電話線上】，她想跟你說話。

rows.d: available for people to buy
rows.s: The new phone will be _____ _____ _____ next month, and my brother is saving money to buy one.
rows.st: 新手機下個月就會【上市】，我哥哥正在存錢想買一支。

rows.d: on the surface of the moon
rows.s: Our science teacher told us that there is no air _____ _____ _____, so people need special suits when they walk there.
rows.st: 自然老師告訴我們【月球上】沒有空氣，所以人們在那裡行走時需要穿特殊的太空衣。

rows.d: on the side of a mountain
rows.s: There are many tea farms _____ _____ _____ near Alishan, and the workers pick tea leaves there early in the morning.
rows.st: 阿里山附近的【山坡上】有很多茶園，工人們一大早就在那裡採茶葉。

rows.d: used to give the first side of an idea
rows.s: _____ _____ _____ _____, living near school saves Amy a lot of time, but on the other hand, the rent there is very high.
rows.st: 【一方面】，住在學校附近幫艾咪省下很多時間，但另一方面，那裡的房租非常貴。

rows.d: used to give a different idea
rows.s: Living in the countryside is quiet and peaceful. _____ _____ _____ _____, it is not easy to find a good job there.
rows.st: 住在鄉下安靜又平和。【另一方面】，在那裡要找到好工作並不容易。

rows.d: talking to someone by phone
rows.s: Please be quiet, everyone, because your father is _____ _____ _____ with his boss and it is an important call.
rows.st: 大家請安靜，因為爸爸正在跟他老闆【通電話】，那是一通很重要的電話。

rows.d: heard through a radio
rows.s: When Grandpa drives to the market, he always listens to the news _____ _____ _____ because he wants to know the weather.
rows.st: 爺爺開車去市場時，總是聽【收音機裡】的新聞，因為他想知道天氣。

rows.d: at a large farm for cows or horses
rows.s: Cowboys work _____ _____ _____ all day, and they ride horses to take care of hundreds of cows.
rows.st: 牛仔們整天【在牧場上】工作，他們騎馬照顧好幾百頭牛。

rows.d: on top of the water of a river
rows.s: In June, many people come to watch the dragon boat races _____ _____ _____, and they cheer loudly for their favorite teams.
rows.st: 六月時，很多人來看【河面上】的龍舟比賽，並大聲為喜愛的隊伍加油。

rows.d: as a player for your school
rows.s: Kai-wen plays _____ _____ _____ _____, so he has to practice basketball every afternoon after his classes finish.
rows.st: 凱文【在校隊中】打球，所以每天下午下課後都要練習籃球。

rows.d: shown on a TV or computer screen
rows.s: The words _____ _____ _____ were too small, so the students in the back of the classroom couldn't read them.
rows.st: 【螢幕上】的字太小了，所以教室後面的學生看不清楚。

rows.d: placed on a shelf
rows.s: Please put the dictionary back _____ _____ _____ after you use it, so other students can find it easily.
rows.st: 字典用完後請把它放回【架子上】，這樣其他同學才能輕鬆找到。

rows.d: put aside and not used or done for now
rows.s: Our class trip plan has been _____ _____ _____ for months because the school doesn't have enough money for the bus.
rows.st: 我們班的旅行計畫已經【被擱置】好幾個月了，因為學校沒有足夠的錢租遊覽車。

rows.d: on the path for walking beside a road
rows.s: Please walk _____ _____ _____ and not on the road, because cars and scooters drive very fast on this busy street.
rows.st: 請走【在人行道上】，不要走在馬路上，因為這條繁忙的街上汽機車都開得很快。

rows.d: right away, at that place
rows.s: When the boy found a lost wallet on the street, he gave it to the police _____ _____ _____, and the owner thanked him later.
rows.st: 那個男孩在街上撿到一個遺失的錢包時，他【當場】就把它交給了警察，失主後來向他道謝。

rows.w: on the top of the mountain
rows.d: at the highest part of a mountain
rows.s: We got up at four o'clock, and when we stood _____ _____ _____ _____ _____ _____, we watched the beautiful sunrise together.
rows.st: 我們四點起床，當我們站【在山頂】時，一起看了美麗的日出。

rows.d: growing on a tree, like leaves or fruit
rows.c: 在樹上（屬於樹上的東西，如樹葉、果實）
rows.s: There are lots of red apples _____ _____ _____ in Grandpa's garden, so we will pick some and bake a pie this weekend.
rows.st: 爺爺花園裡的【樹上】長了很多紅蘋果，所以這週末我們要摘一些來烤派。

rows.d: on top of the TV set
rows.s: Mom put a small vase of flowers _____ _____ _____, but the cat jumped up and knocked it onto the floor.
rows.st: 媽媽在【電視機上】放了一個小花瓶，但貓跳上去把它撞到地上。

rows.d: on Saturday or Sunday
rows.s: _____ _____ _____, we usually go hiking in Yangmingshan, and then we have hot pot together for dinner.
rows.st: 【在週末】，我們通常去陽明山健行，然後一起吃火鍋當晚餐。

rows.d: in general; mostly
rows.s: There were a few problems with the hotel room, but _____ _____ _____ we had a wonderful time during our trip to Kenting.
rows.st: 飯店房間有一些小問題，但【大體上】我們在墾丁旅行時玩得很愉快。

rows.d: at the right time, not late
rows.s: Our English teacher is very strict, so we always try to hand in our homework _____ _____ every Monday morning.
rows.st: 我們的英文老師很嚴格，所以我們每週一早上總是努力【準時】交作業。

rows.d: shown as a TV program
rows.s: My family likes to watch baseball games _____ _____ on Sunday nights, and we always cheer loudly for our favorite team.
rows.st: 我們家喜歡在週日晚上看【電視上】的棒球比賽，而且我們總是為最喜歡的隊伍大聲加油。

rows.d: taking time away from school or work
rows.s: Our family will be _____ _____ in Japan next week, so our neighbor will feed our cat while we are away.
rows.st: 我們家下週要去日本【度假】，所以我們不在時，鄰居會幫我們餵貓。

rows.d: from Monday to Friday
rows.s: Students have to get up early _____ _____, but on Saturdays they can sleep late and relax at home.
rows.st: 學生【在平日】必須早起，但週六可以睡晚一點，在家放鬆。

rows.d: sometimes, but not often
rows.s: My family usually eats at home, but _____ _____ _____ _____, we go out for hot pot when Dad gets paid.
rows.st: 我們家通常在家吃飯，但【偶爾】爸爸領薪水時，我們會出去吃火鍋。

rows.d: one person or thing after another
rows.s: The students walked into the music room _____ _____ _____ and quietly sat down because the test was about to start.
rows.st: 學生們【一個接一個地】走進音樂教室並安靜地坐下，因為考試就要開始了。

rows.d: suddenly, when you do not expect it
rows.c: 出乎意料地、突如其來地
rows.s: My cousin in America called me _____ _____ _____ _____ last night, and we talked for an hour because we hadn't spoken in years.
rows.st: 我在美國的表哥昨晚【出乎意料地】打電話給我，我們聊了一個小時，因為我們已經好幾年沒說話了。

rows.d: many times, again and again
rows.s: The baby wanted to hear the same song _____ _____ _____ _____, so her mother sang it ten times before she fell asleep.
rows.st: 寶寶想要【一次又一次】聽同一首歌，所以媽媽唱了十遍她才睡著。

rows.d: in any weather; no matter what
rows.s: My father goes jogging by the river every morning, _____ _____ _____, because he says exercise keeps him happy.
rows.st: 我爸爸每天早上都去河邊慢跑，【不論晴雨】，因為他說運動讓他快樂。

rows.d: at once; immediately
rows.s: When Mom saw that my fever was very high, she took me to the doctor _____ _____ and didn't even finish her coffee.
rows.st: 媽媽發現我發高燒時，【立刻】帶我去看醫生，連咖啡都沒喝完。

rows.d: from that time until now
rows.s: Grace moved to Kaohsiung last summer, and I haven't seen her _____ _____, but we often chat online.
rows.st: 葛蕾絲去年夏天搬到高雄，【從那以後】我就沒見過她了，不過我們常在網路上聊天。

rows.d: until now
rows.s: I have read four books _____ _____ this summer, and I plan to finish two more before school starts again.
rows.st: 這個暑假【到目前為止】我已經讀了四本書，而且我打算在開學前再讀完兩本。

rows.d: at a time in the future
rows.s: Kelly loves animals very much, and she hopes that _____ _____ she can become a doctor who takes care of sick dogs.
rows.st: 凱莉非常喜歡動物，她希望【將來有一天】能成為照顧生病狗狗的醫生。

rows.d: a short time later
rows.s: Our school bus left the parking lot at eight, and _____ _____, it started to rain heavily, so we were glad to be inside.
rows.st: 我們的校車八點離開停車場，【不久之後】就開始下大雨，所以我們很慶幸自己在車裡。

rows.d: at some time in the future
rows.s: If you keep practicing the guitar every day, you will play your favorite song well _____ _____ _____.
rows.st: 如果你每天持續練吉他，你【遲早】能把你最喜歡的歌彈好。

rows.d: more than at any time in the past
rows.s: After practicing every day this summer, Annie can swim faster _____ _____ _____, so she will join the race.
rows.st: 這個暑假每天練習之後，安妮游得【比以往任何時候】都快，所以她要參加比賽。

rows.d: compared with what normally happens
rows.s: Ryan woke up later _____ _____ this morning, so he missed breakfast and ran all the way to school.
rows.st: 萊恩今天早上起得【比平常】晚，所以他沒吃早餐，一路跑到學校。

rows.d: used to explain something more clearly
rows.s: The museum is closed on the first Monday of every month; _____ _____, you cannot visit it on December 7 this year.
rows.st: 博物館每個月的第一個星期一休館；【也就是說】，你今年12月7日不能去參觀。

rows.d: two days from today
rows.s: Today is Wednesday, so _____ _____ _____ _____ will be Friday, and we are going to have our sports day then.
rows.st: 今天是星期三，所以【後天】就是星期五，那天我們要舉辦運動會。

rows.d: two days before today
rows.s: I bought this umbrella _____ _____ _____ _____, but I already left it on the bus this morning when I was sleepy.
rows.st: 我【前天】才買了這把雨傘，但今天早上想睡覺時就把它忘在公車上了。

rows.d: the opposite of what was said
rows.s: I thought Tina was helping Eric with math, but it was _____ _____ _____ _____, because Eric was helping her.
rows.st: 我以為是蒂娜在教艾瑞克數學，但其實【正好相反】，是艾瑞克在教她。

rows.d: in every part of the world
rows.s: Soccer is played _____ _____ _____, and millions of fans watch the World Cup on TV every four years.
rows.st: 足球【遍及全世界】，每四年都有數百萬球迷在電視上看世界盃。

rows.d: moving one way and then back again
rows.s: Our dog was so excited about the walk that he ran _____ _____ _____ in front of the door while I put on my shoes.
rows.st: 我們的狗對散步太興奮了，在我穿鞋時，牠在門前【來回】跑個不停。

rows.d: used to give the first reason
rows.s: We can't go camping this weekend; _____ _____ _____, it's going to rain, and also my dad has to work on Saturday.
rows.st: 我們這週末不能去露營；【首先】，會下雨，而且我爸爸星期六還要上班。

rows.d: up to now
rows.s: Our class has collected over five hundred bottle caps _____ _____, and we hope to reach one thousand by summer vacation.
rows.st: 【到目前為止】，我們班已經收集了五百多個瓶蓋，我們希望在暑假前達到一千個。

rows.d: and something even worse happened
rows.s: I missed the bus this morning, and _____ _____ _____ _____, it started to rain heavily on my way to school.
rows.st: 我今天早上沒趕上公車，而且【更糟的是】，在上學途中開始下起大雨。

rows.d: in a way that surprises someone
rows.s: _____ my _____, the shy new student sang beautifully at the talent show, and everyone in the hall clapped for her.
rows.st: 【令我驚訝的是】，那位害羞的新同學在才藝表演上唱得很好聽，禮堂裡的每個人都為她鼓掌。

rows.d: for this goal
rows.s: Our class wants to keep the park near our school clean. _____ _____ _____, we pick up trash there every Friday.
rows.st: 我們班想讓學校附近的公園保持乾淨。【為了這個目的】，我們每週五都去那裡撿垃圾。

rows.d: two times every week
rows.s: Sarah takes piano lessons _____ _____ _____, on Tuesdays and Fridays, because she wants to play in the school concert.
rows.st: 莎拉【一週】上【兩次】鋼琴課，在星期二和星期五，因為她想在學校音樂會上演奏。

rows.d: much too; far more than is good
rows.s: This bubble tea is _____ _____ sweet for me, so next time I will ask for half sugar and less ice.
rows.st: 這杯珍珠奶茶對我來說【太】甜【了】，所以下次我要點半糖少冰。

rows.d: also, and this is important too
rows.s: This backpack is light and strong. _____ _____, it is on sale today, so I'm going to buy it for school.
rows.st: 這個背包又輕又堅固。【而且】它今天特價，所以我要買來上學用。

rows.d: and a worse thing is
rows.s: I left my homework at home today. _____ _____, I also forgot my lunch box, so I was hungry all day.
rows.st: 我今天把作業忘在家裡。【更糟的是】，我也忘了帶便當，所以我餓了一整天。

rows.d: using a check to pay
rows.s: The school asked parents to pay for the class trip _____ _____ _____ or in cash before the end of this month.
rows.st: 學校請家長在這個月底前【用支票】或現金繳交校外教學的費用。

rows.d: paying by credit card, not cash
rows.c: 用信用卡（= by credit card）
rows.s: The shoes cost three thousand dollars, and Dad didn't have enough cash, so he paid _____ _____ _____ _____.
rows.st: 那雙鞋要三千元，爸爸身上現金不夠，所以他【用信用卡】付款。

rows.d: carefully
rows.s: These glasses are very old and easy to break, so please carry them _____ _____ when you move them to the kitchen.
rows.st: 這些玻璃杯很舊又容易破，所以你把它們搬到廚房時請【小心地】拿。

rows.d: without stopping to rest
rows.s: The workers built the bridge for ten hours _____ _____ _____, so they were very tired and hungry at night.
rows.st: 工人們【不休息地】蓋了十個小時的橋，所以晚上他們又累又餓。

rows.d: certainly; surely
rows.s: _____ _____ _____, Jenny is the best singer in our class, so we chose her for the school singing contest.
rows.st: 【毫無疑問地】，Jenny是我們班最會唱歌的人，所以我們選她參加學校的歌唱比賽。

rows.d: always, every time
rows.s: My grandmother goes to the park to exercise at six every morning _____ _____, even when it is cold or rainy.
rows.st: 我奶奶每天早上六點【一定】會去公園運動，即使天氣冷或下雨也一樣。

rows.d: the most terrible part is
rows.s: I missed the bus and forgot my lunch, and _____ _____ _____, I left my homework at home on the day it was due.
rows.st: 我錯過了公車又忘了帶午餐，而【最糟的是】，我在作業要交的那天把它忘在家裡了。

mcq.q: The doctors worked ______ to save the sick boy.
mcq.st: 醫生們不眠不休地工作，為了救那個生病的男孩。

mcq.q: You don't need to pay. You can get the ice cream ______ today.
mcq.st: 你不用付錢。今天你可以免費拿到冰淇淋。

mcq.q: Look! Some ducks are swimming ______ behind our school.
mcq.st: 你看！有些鴨子在我們學校後面的池塘裡游泳。

mcq.q: ______, I didn't like dogs, but now I love them.
mcq.st: 起初，我不喜歡狗，但現在我很愛牠們。

mcq.q: Mr. Lin sleeps only three hours a night to make money. He works ______, and now he is sick.
o: at the cost of his health
mcq.st: 林先生為了賺錢每晚只睡三個小時。他以健康為代價工作，現在他生病了。

mcq.q: Amy moved to Taipei in 2020, and she has lived there ______.
mcq.st: Amy在2020年搬到台北，從那時起她就一直住在那裡。

mcq.q: In one minute, Ben ran ______ between the sofa and the door five times.
mcq.st: 一分鐘內，Ben在沙發和門之間來回跑了五次。

mcq.q: ______, living in a big city is fun. On the other hand, it is very noisy.
mcq.st: 一方面，住在大城市很有趣。另一方面，大城市很吵。

mcq.q: There are many people at the bus stop, so we have to wait ______.
o: from the bottom of my heart
mcq.st: 公車站有很多人，所以我們必須排隊等候。

mcq.q: Tom has two dogs and three cats. He has five pets ______.
mcq.st: Tom有兩隻狗和三隻貓。他總共有五隻寵物。

mcq.q: The teacher drew a big circle on the ground and told us to put the ball ______.
mcq.st: 老師在地上畫了一個大圓圈，並叫我們把球放在圓圈裡。

mcq.q: At night, we can see the moon and stars ______.
mcq.st: 晚上，我們可以看到天空中的月亮和星星。

mcq.q: Jack didn't understand the new word, so the teacher said it ______ until he remembered it.
mcq.st: Jack不懂這個新單字，所以老師一次又一次地唸，直到他記住為止。

mcq.q: I have never been to Japan, but I hope to go there ______.
mcq.st: 我從來沒去過日本，但我希望將來有一天能去那裡。

mcq.q: Harry Potter books are popular ______. People in many countries read them.
mcq.st: 哈利波特的書在全世界各地都很受歡迎。很多國家的人都讀這些書。

mcq.q: A: I'm going to the store now. ______, have you seen my red umbrella?
mcq.st: A：我現在要去商店。順便問一下，你有看到我的紅色雨傘嗎？B：它在門後面。

mcq.q: Grandpa walks to the park every morning, ______. Even heavy rain can't stop him.
mcq.st: 爺爺每天早上不論晴雨都走路去公園。連大雨也無法阻止他。

mcq.q: We waited for the bus for an hour. ______, it came.
mcq.st: 我們等公車等了一個小時。終於，公車來了。

mcq.q: I want to be a doctor ______.
mcq.st: 我將來想當一名醫生。

mcq.q: Mr. Wang moved to Kaohsiung, so he ______ lives next to us.
mcq.st: 王先生搬到高雄了，所以他不再住在我們隔壁。

mcq.q: The new phone was too hard to use, so Grandma went ______ and used her old phone again.
mcq.st: 新手機太難用了，所以奶奶回到舊方式，又用回她的舊手機。

mcq.q: We don't have school ______, so I often sleep late on Saturday.
mcq.st: 我們週末不用上學，所以我星期六常常睡到很晚。

mcq.q: Kevin gets up early ______ catch the first bus.
mcq.st: Kevin早起是為了趕上第一班公車。

mcq.q: To stay healthy, you should eat vegetables and sleep well. ______, you must exercise every day. That is the key.
mcq.st: 為了保持健康，你應該吃蔬菜並睡飽。最重要的是，你必須每天運動。那才是關鍵。

mcq.q: There is a bird's nest ______ near my window.
mcq.st: 我窗戶附近的樹上有一個鳥巢。

mcq.q: A: How do you go to school?
mcq.st: A：你怎麼去上學？B：我搭公車去。公車站就在我家前面，車程只要十分鐘。

mcq.q: Our class eats lunch together in the classroom ______ every school day.
mcq.st: 我們班每個上學日的午餐時間都一起在教室吃午餐。

mcq.q: Dr. Chen is seventy, but he is still ______. He sees sick people every day.
mcq.st: 陳醫師七十歲了，但他仍在執業。他每天都看病人。

mcq.q: Kevin always does his homework ______, just before the teacher asks for it.
mcq.st: Kevin總是在最後一刻才寫作業，就在老師要收作業之前。

mcq.q: It's six o'clock. Let's go home ______. It will be night soon.
mcq.st: 六點了。我們天黑前回家吧。很快就要入夜了。

mcq.q: Please stop smoking ______. Your family wants you to be healthy.
mcq.st: 為了你家人著想，請戒菸。你的家人希望你健康。

mcq.q: We had no money, so our plan to build a new park is ______ now.
mcq.st: 我們沒有錢，所以蓋新公園的計畫現在被擱置了。

mcq.q: It is warm in Kenting ______, so you can swim there even in winter.
mcq.st: 墾丁一年到頭都很溫暖，所以即使在冬天你也能在那裡游泳。

mcq.q: The new library was going to open in May, but it opened in March, two months ______.
mcq.st: 新圖書館原本要在五月開幕，但它在三月就開了，比預定提早兩個月。

mcq.q: I went to bed at 11:00 ______, so I am tired this morning.
mcq.st: 我昨晚十一點才睡，所以今天早上很累。

mcq.q: I read about the fire ______ this morning. It was on page 3.
mcq.st: 我今天早上在報紙上讀到那場火災的消息。它在第三版。

mcq.q: Ms. Lee didn't want other students to hear, so she talked to Tom ______.
mcq.st: 李老師不想讓其他學生聽到，所以她私下和Tom談話。

mcq.q: The package was sent from Japan to Taiwan ______, so it arrived in only two days.
mcq.st: 這個包裹是從日本空運寄到台灣的，所以只花兩天就到了。

mcq.q: A: Why did you push me?
mcq.st: A：你為什麼推我？B：對不起。我不是故意的。是有人先推我的。

mcq.q: My favorite singer was ______ last night, so I watched the show at home.
mcq.st: 我最喜歡的歌手昨晚上了電視節目，所以我在家看了那個節目。

mcq.q: The kids are sitting ______ in the living room, because there are no chairs.
mcq.st: 孩子們坐在客廳的地板上，因為那裡沒有椅子。

mcq.q: I often play basketball with my classmates ______. We play for ten minutes before the next class starts.
mcq.st: 我常在下課後和同學打籃球。我們在下一堂課開始前打十分鐘。

mcq.q: My uncle grows rice and keeps chickens ______ in the country.
mcq.st: 我叔叔在鄉下的農場裡種稻、養雞。

mcq.q: Jason is ______, and he plays baseball with his teammates every Saturday.
mcq.st: Jason 是一支球隊的隊員，他每週六和隊友們一起打棒球。

mcq.q: Mom, look! Your photo is ______ of the computer.
mcq.st: 媽，你看！你的照片在電腦螢幕上。

mcq.q: Ben's home is very close to school, so he doesn't take the bus; he goes to school ______.
mcq.st: Ben 的家離學校很近，所以他不搭公車；他走路去上學。

mcq.q: Grandpa doesn't have a TV, so he listens to the news ______ every morning.
mcq.st: 爺爺沒有電視，所以他每天早上收聽收音機裡的新聞。

mcq.q: The farmer is working ______ under the hot sun, planting rice.
mcq.st: 那位農夫正在炎熱的太陽下在田野間工作，種著稻子。

mcq.q: Kevin didn't study for the test. ______, he got a bad grade.
mcq.st: Kevin 沒有準備考試。因此，他考得很差。

mcq.q: A: It's going to rain this afternoon.
mcq.st: A：今天下午會下雨。

mcq.q: The cookies are ______ in the kitchen, but I can't reach them because I'm too short.
o: on the top of the mountain
mcq.st: 餅乾在廚房的架子上，但我太矮了拿不到。

mcq.q: My aunt is a nurse ______, but she wants to be a doctor in the future.
mcq.st: 我阿姨目前是護理師，但她將來想當醫生。

mcq.q: Grandma made this sweater ______, not with a machine.
mcq.st: 奶奶是用手工織這件毛衣的，不是用機器。

mcq.q: Living in a big city is very convenient. ______, it is often noisy and crowded.
mcq.st: 住在大城市非常方便。另一方面，那裡常常又吵又擁擠。

mcq.q: We ran all the way to the station and got there ______ to catch the last train.
mcq.st: 我們一路跑到車站，及時趕上了最後一班火車。

mcq.q: Tom studied for five hours ______; he didn't even stop to eat or drink.
mcq.st: Tom 不休息地讀了五個小時的書；他甚至沒有停下來吃東西或喝水。

mcq.q: I usually play basketball with my friends ______, and then I go home for dinner.
mcq.st: 我通常放學後和朋友打籃球，然後回家吃晚餐。

mcq.q: This glass bowl breaks easily, so please carry it ______.
mcq.st: 這個玻璃碗很容易破，所以請小心地拿。

mcq.q: When astronauts are ______, they can look down and see the whole Earth.
mcq.st: 當太空人在太空中時，他們可以往下看到整個地球。

mcq.q: Amy doesn't play the piano for money; she plays it just ______.
mcq.st: Amy 彈鋼琴不是為了賺錢；她只是為了好玩而彈。

mcq.q: These lions live in the zoo now, but they used to live ______ in Africa.
mcq.st: 這些獅子現在住在動物園裡，但牠們以前住在非洲的野外。

mcq.q: Our team played two games ______ on Saturday, with no rest between them.
mcq.st: 我們的隊伍星期六連續打了兩場比賽，中間沒有休息。

mcq.q: At the night market, you can buy food, clothes, toys, ______.
mcq.st: 在夜市，你可以買到食物、衣服、玩具等等。

mcq.q: Many people have helped us, and ______ we have collected 5,000 books for the poor children.
mcq.st: 很多人幫助了我們，到目前為止我們已經為貧困的孩子們收集了五千本書。

mcq.q: I got up late this morning. ______, it started to rain on my way to school.
mcq.st: 我今天早上起晚了。更糟的是，在上學途中開始下雨了。

mcq.q: I met my old classmate ______ at the supermarket yesterday; we didn't plan it at all.
mcq.st: 我昨天在超市碰巧遇到我的老同學；我們完全沒有事先約好。

mcq.q: My little sister is only six, but she can tie her shoes ______ without anyone's help.
mcq.st: 我妹妹才六歲，但她可以不靠任何人幫忙，自己綁鞋帶。

mcq.q: This hotel has a big swimming pool. ______, it has a free gym for its guests.
mcq.st: 這家飯店有一座大游泳池。此外，它還有一間供房客免費使用的健身房。

mcq.q: In this game, you can change the color of your car ______; just click the button whenever you want.
mcq.st: 在這個遊戲裡，你可以隨心所欲地改變車子的顏色；想改的時候按下按鈕就好。

mcq.q: The school bought these computers ______, not for playing games.
mcq.st: 學校買這些電腦是為了學習的目的，不是為了玩遊戲。

mcq.q: The movie started at seven, and Tim arrived ______, so he missed only the first few minutes.
mcq.st: 電影七點開始，Tim 不久之後就到了，所以他只錯過了開頭幾分鐘。

mcq.q: This plan sounds easy, but ______ it is very hard to do.
mcq.st: 這個計畫聽起來很簡單，但實際上很難做到。

mcq.q: I was late for school three times this week, so ______ I will get up earlier.
mcq.st: 我這週上學遲到了三次，所以從現在起我會早點起床。

mcq.q: We have lived in this house for ten years, but we are moving tomorrow, so tonight we will sleep here ______.
mcq.st: 我們在這間房子住了十年，但我們明天就要搬家了，所以今晚是我們最後一次睡在這裡。

mcq.q: This elevator can take ten people ______, so we can't all get in together.
mcq.st: 這台電梯最多只能載十個人，所以我們沒辦法全部一起進去。

mcq.q: The food in this restaurant is delicious. ______ the prices are very low.
mcq.st: 這家餐廳的食物很好吃。而且，價格很便宜。

mcq.q: The children are ______ in the park; they are flying kites and having fun.
mcq.st: 孩子們正在公園裡玩耍；他們在放風箏，玩得很開心。

mcq.q: Kevin has changed ______ since he moved to Japan; he looks very different now.
mcq.st: Kevin 搬到日本後改變了很多；他現在看起來很不一樣。

mcq.q: Doctors say children should sleep ______ nine hours every night, not less.
mcq.st: 醫生說孩子們每晚應該至少睡九個小時，不能更少。

mcq.q: The blue whale is the biggest animal ______.
o: at the cost of the environment
mcq.st: 藍鯨是世界上最大的動物。

mcq.q: It takes ______ an hour to get to the zoo by bus; it's about 55 to 65 minutes.
mcq.st: 搭公車到動物園差不多要一個小時；大約五十五到六十五分鐘。

mcq.q: Taipei 101 is ______ one of the most famous buildings in Taiwan.
mcq.st: 台北101毫無疑問是台灣最有名的建築之一。

mcq.q: The picture on the wall is hanging ______, so please make it straight.
mcq.st: 牆上的畫掛歪了，所以請把它弄正。

mcq.q: I couldn't find this book in any store, so I bought it ______.
mcq.st: 我在任何一家店都找不到這本書，所以我在網路上買了它。

mcq.q: I lost my wallet on the bus. ______ my phone was in it, too.
mcq.st: 我在公車上弄丟了錢包。更糟的是，我的手機也在裡面。

mcq.q: This restaurant is very popular, so you need to call and book a table ______.
mcq.st: 這家餐廳很受歡迎，所以你需要事先打電話訂位。

mcq.q: What ______ happened to your room? It's a big mess!
mcq.st: 你的房間到底發生了什麼事？簡直一團亂！

rows.d: A and also B
rows.s: Linda can speak English _____ _____ _____ Japanese, so she often helps foreign tourists at the train station.
rows.st: 琳達會說英文【以及】日文，所以她常常在火車站幫助外國觀光客。

rows.d: instead of
rows.s: On hot summer days, I usually drink cold water _____ _____ soda, because it is much better for my body.
rows.st: 炎熱的夏天，我通常喝冰水【而不是】汽水，因為那對身體好多了。

rows.w: as far as + N + be concerned
rows.d: in someone's opinion
rows.s: _____ _____ _____ I _____ _____, summer is the best season because we can swim in the sea and eat shaved ice every day.
rows.st: 【就】我【而言】，夏天是最棒的季節，因為我們每天都可以去海邊游泳、吃剉冰。

rows.d: in a way that seems like
rows.s: Grandpa's old dog ran around the yard happily _____ _____ it were a young puppy again, and all of us laughed.
rows.st: 爺爺的老狗開心地在院子裡跑來跑去，【彷彿】牠又變回一隻小狗，我們全都笑了。

rows.d: only if
rows.s: Mom said that I could play basketball with my friends after school _____ _____ _____ I finished my homework before dinner.
rows.st: 媽媽說【只要】我在晚餐前寫完功課，放學後就可以和朋友去打籃球。

rows.d: right after; immediately when
rows.s: _____ _____ _____ the bell rang, the students ran out of the classroom because they wanted to play dodgeball on the playground.
rows.st: 鐘聲【一】響，學生們【就】衝出教室，因為他們想去操場玩躲避球。

rows.d: in a way that seems like something is true
rows.s: Mark ate his lunch very quickly _____ _____ he had not eaten anything for two days, and then he asked for more rice.
rows.st: 馬克很快地吃完午餐，【彷彿】他兩天都沒吃東西一樣，然後他又要了更多飯。

rows.d: and also
rows.s: Mrs. Chen bought some apples _____ _____ _____ a big watermelon at the market, so her bags were very heavy.
rows.st: 陳太太在市場買了一些蘋果【以及】一顆大西瓜，所以她的袋子非常重。

rows.d: the two things or people together
rows.s: _____ my father _____ my mother work at the hospital, so my grandma often cooks dinner for us on weekdays.
rows.st: 我爸爸【和】媽媽【都】在醫院工作，所以平日常常是奶奶煮晚餐給我們吃。

rows.d: one of two choices
rows.s: We can _____ take the MRT _____ ride our bikes to the night market, because both ways are easy and cheap.
rows.st: 我們【不是】搭捷運【就是】騎腳踏車去夜市，因為兩種方式都方便又便宜。

rows.d: whether or not something happens
rows.c: 即使（條件句：以現在簡單式代替未來式）
rows.s: _____ _____ it rains tomorrow, we will still go to the zoo because we have already bought the tickets online.
rows.st: 【即使】明天下雨，我們還是會去動物園，因為我們已經在網路上買好票了。

rows.d: although; in spite of the fact that
rows.s: _____ _____ it was raining heavily, Mia still walked her dog in the park because he really needed exercise.
rows.st: 【即使】雨下得很大，米亞還是在公園遛狗，因為牠真的需要運動。

rows.d: because something might happen
rows.s: Take an umbrella with you _____ _____ it rains this afternoon, because the weather report says a storm is coming.
rows.st: 帶把傘吧，【以防】今天下午下雨，因為氣象報告說暴風雨要來了。

rows.d: not this one and not the other one
rows.s: _____ Tom _____ his sister likes spicy food, so they always order the mild curry when they go to that restaurant.
rows.st: 湯姆【既不】喜歡辣的食物，他妹妹【也不】喜歡，所以他們去那家餐廳時總是點小辣的咖哩。

rows.d: it is B, and it is not A
rows.s: The man who called you last night was _____ your uncle _____ your cousin Jason, because your uncle was in Japan then.
rows.st: 昨晚打電話給你的人【不是】你舅舅，【而是】你表哥傑森，因為你舅舅那時在日本。

rows.d: both A and B, and B is extra
rows.s: Sophie is _____ _____ good at playing the piano, _____ _____ great at drawing, so she often wins prizes at school.
rows.st: 蘇菲【不僅】擅長彈鋼琴，【而且】很會畫畫，所以她常在學校得獎。

rows.w: not only A but also B
rows.d: A is true, and B is true too
rows.s: Amy is _____ _____ good at math _____ _____ great at playing the piano, so her parents are very proud of her.
rows.st: 安美【不僅】數學很好，【而且】鋼琴也彈得很棒，所以她爸媽非常以她為榮。

rows.d: because something is now true
rows.s: _____ _____ the final exam is over, we can finally relax and go to the movies with our friends this weekend.
rows.st: 【既然】期末考結束了，我們這個週末終於可以放鬆，跟朋友去看電影了。

rows.d: not in any other case except if
rows.s: Dad said I can play video games on Saturday _____ _____ I finish all my homework first.
rows.st: 爸爸說我【只有在】先寫完所有功課的【條件下】，星期六【才】能打電動。

rows.d: not at any other time except when
rows.s: My little brother cleans his room _____ _____ Mom tells him three times, so his room is always messy.
rows.st: 我弟弟【只有在】媽媽講了三次【的時候才】打掃房間，所以他的房間總是很亂。

rows.d: so much that something happens
rows.s: The math test was _____ difficult _____ many students could not finish it before the bell rang at ten o'clock.
rows.st: 數學考試【如此】難，【以致於】很多學生在十點鐘鈴響前都寫不完。

rows.d: in order to make something possible
rows.s: Grandma speaks loudly on the phone _____ _____ Grandpa can hear her clearly, because he doesn't hear very well now.
rows.st: 奶奶講電話時很大聲，【好讓】爺爺能聽清楚，因為他現在聽力不太好。

rows.d: so much of something that a result happens
rows.s: It was _____ a hot day _____ we all jumped into the swimming pool as soon as we got to the hotel.
rows.st: 那天【如此】炎熱，【以致於】我們一到飯店就全都跳進了游泳池。

mcq.q: My little brother is very shy; he talks to people ______ his mother is next to him.
mcq.st: 我弟弟很害羞；只有在他媽媽在他旁邊的時候，他才會跟別人說話。

mcq.q: ______ I am concerned, summer is the best season because I can swim every day.
mcq.st: 就我而言，夏天是最棒的季節，因為我每天都可以游泳。

mcq.q: Ben was very hungry, so he started eating ______ he got home.
mcq.st: Ben 很餓，所以他一回到家就開始吃東西。

mcq.q: You can go to the movies tonight ______ you finish your homework first.
mcq.st: 只有在你先完成功課的條件下，你今晚才可以去看電影。

mcq.q: The new bike in the living room is ______ because today is his birthday, so I can't ride it.
o: neither for me nor for my brother
both for me and for my brother
not for me but for my brother
either for me or for my brother
mcq.st: 客廳裡的新腳踏車不是給我的，而是給我弟弟的，因為今天是他的生日，所以我不能騎它。

mcq.q: Kevin talks ______ he knows everything, but he really doesn't.
mcq.st: Kevin 說話的樣子好像他什麼都知道，但其實他並不知道。

mcq.q: Ms. Lin is our English teacher, and she can speak ______, so she can talk with the students from Japan.
mcq.st: 林老師是我們的英文老師，她會說英文以及日文，所以她能和來自日本的學生交談。

mcq.q: Dad is very busy this weekend, so he can drive us to the zoo ______, but not on both days.
o: both on Saturday and on Sunday
not only on Saturday but also on Sunday
either on Saturday or on Sunday
neither on Saturday nor on Sunday
mcq.st: 爸爸這個週末很忙，所以他不是星期六就是星期日可以載我們去動物園，但不能兩天都載。

mcq.q: Lucy went to school ______ she had a bad cold.
mcq.st: 雖然 Lucy 得了重感冒，她還是去上學了。

mcq.q: Many people go to my uncle's restaurant because the food there is ______; it costs little and tastes great.
o: not only cheap but also delicious
mcq.st: 很多人去我叔叔的餐廳，因為那裡的食物不僅便宜而且美味；花費少又很好吃。

mcq.q: The little boy cried ______ he was badly hurt, but he only fell down on the soft grass.
mcq.st: 那個小男孩哭得彷彿受了重傷，但他只是跌倒在柔軟的草地上。

mcq.q: The box was ______ I couldn't carry it by myself.
mcq.st: 那個箱子重到我自己一個人搬不動。

mcq.q: Take an umbrella with you ______ it rains this afternoon.
mcq.st: 帶把雨傘在身上，以防今天下午下雨。

mcq.q: It was ______ all the students stayed inside the classroom.
mcq.st: 那天是如此炎熱的一天，以致於所有學生都待在教室裡。

mcq.q: Mom says cake is bad for my teeth, so she always gives me ______ after dinner.
mcq.st: 媽媽說蛋糕對我的牙齒不好，所以晚餐後她總是給我水果，而不是蛋糕。

mcq.q: I couldn't choose between the red shirt and the blue one, so I bought ______, and now I have two new shirts.
o: neither the red one nor the blue one
both the red one and the blue one
the red one rather than the blue one
either the red one or the blue one
mcq.st: 我無法在紅色和藍色的襯衫之間做選擇，所以紅色和藍色的我都買了，現在我有兩件新襯衫。

mcq.q: ______ came to my birthday party, so I had two good friends with me.
mcq.st: Tom 以及 Amy 來參加了我的生日派對，所以我有兩位好朋友陪著我。

mcq.q: ______ can come to my party, because Tom is sick and Amy is visiting her grandma.
o: Not only Tom but also Amy
mcq.st: Tom 和 Amy 都不能來參加我的派對，因為 Tom 生病了，而 Amy 要去探望她的奶奶。

mcq.q: Every morning, my strong grandpa ______: he swims at six and runs in the park at seven.
o: not only swims but also runs
mcq.st: 我強壯的爺爺每天早上不僅游泳而且跑步：他六點游泳，七點在公園跑步。

mcq.q: ______ you are in junior high school, you should get up early by yourself.
mcq.st: 既然你已經是國中生了，你應該自己早起。

mcq.q: Please speak louder ______ everyone in the classroom can hear you.
mcq.st: 請說大聲一點，好讓教室裡的每個人都能聽到你說話。

mcq.q: ______ it rains tomorrow, we will still play basketball in the gym.
mcq.st: 即使明天下雨，我們還是會在體育館打籃球。

mcq.q: You can borrow my bike ______ you give it back to me before dinner.
mcq.st: 只要你在晚餐前還給我，你就可以借我的腳踏車。

mcq.q: My dad drinks coffee ______ he has to work late at night; he never drinks it in the morning.
mcq.st: 我爸爸只有在必須熬夜工作的時候才喝咖啡；他早上從不喝咖啡。

mcq.q: ______ my little sister is concerned, ice cream is the best food in the world.
mcq.st: 就我妹妹而言，冰淇淋是世界上最棒的食物。

mcq.q: The baby stopped crying ______ she saw her mother.
mcq.st: 那個嬰兒一看到她媽媽就停止哭泣了。

mcq.q: The old lady will sell her house ______ someone pays five million dollars for it; she won't take less.
mcq.st: 那位老太太只有在有人出五百萬元的條件下才會賣她的房子；少一點她都不接受。

mcq.q: My favorite sport is ______; I play basketball every day, but I never swim.
mcq.st: 我最喜歡的運動不是游泳而是籃球；我每天打籃球，但我從不游泳。

mcq.q: Mom looked at me ______ she didn't believe my story.
mcq.st: 媽媽看著我，好像她不相信我說的故事。

mcq.q: Jenny can play ______, so she can play two instruments.
o: neither the piano nor the violin
the piano as well as the violin
either the piano or the violin
the piano rather than the violin
mcq.st: Jenny 會彈鋼琴以及拉小提琴，所以她會兩種樂器。

mcq.q: We have only two choices for lunch today: you can have ______, but not both.
o: not only rice but also noodles
mcq.st: 我們今天午餐只有兩個選擇：你不是吃飯就是吃麵，但不能兩個都吃。

mcq.q: ______ Ken studied very hard, he didn't pass the math test.
mcq.st: 雖然 Ken 很用功讀書，他的數學考試還是沒有及格。

mcq.q: Our new classmate, Mia, can speak ______; she learned Japanese from her mother and Korean from her father.
o: not only Japanese but also Korean
mcq.st: 我們的新同學 Mia 不僅會說日文，而且會說韓文；她跟媽媽學日文，跟爸爸學韓文。

mcq.q: Ted spends money ______ he is a rich man, but he is only a student.
mcq.st: Ted 花錢的樣子彷彿他是個有錢人，但他只是個學生。

mcq.q: The movie was ______ I laughed until I cried.
mcq.st: 那部電影如此好笑，以致於我笑到哭了。

mcq.q: Write down my phone number ______ you get lost in the city.
mcq.st: 把我的電話號碼寫下來，以防你在城市裡迷路。

mcq.q: Jack is ______ everyone in our class likes him.
mcq.st: Jack 是如此親切的男孩，以致於我們班上每個人都喜歡他。

mcq.q: It's sunny and warm today, so let's ______.
o: both walk to school and take the bus
walk to school rather than take the bus
not walk to school but take the bus
neither walk to school nor take the bus
mcq.st: 今天陽光普照又溫暖，所以我們走路上學，而不要搭公車吧。

mcq.q: ______ will join the soccer team, so our class will have two players on the team.
mcq.st: Tom 和 Ken 兩個人都會加入足球隊，所以我們班在隊上會有兩名球員。

mcq.q: Ann is on the school basketball team and the volleyball team because she plays ______ very well.
mcq.st: Ann 是學校籃球隊和排球隊的隊員，因為她籃球以及排球都打得很好。

mcq.q: I like ______, so I only drink water.
o: not only coffee but also tea
mcq.st: 我既不喜歡咖啡也不喜歡茶，所以我只喝水。

mcq.q: Grandpa's farm grows ______; he sells apples in fall and oranges in winter.
o: not only apples but also oranges
mcq.st: 爺爺的農場不僅種蘋果，而且種柳橙；他秋天賣蘋果，冬天賣柳橙。

mcq.q: ______ the rain has stopped, let's go out and play in the park.
mcq.st: 既然雨已經停了，我們出去公園玩吧。

mcq.q: I got up early this morning ______ I could catch the first bus.
mcq.st: 我今天早上很早起床，好讓我能趕上第一班公車。

mcq.q: I will finish my homework tonight ______ I have to stay up late.
mcq.st: 即使我必須熬夜，我今晚也會把功課寫完。

mcq.q: You can play video games ______ you finish your homework first.
mcq.st: 只要你先寫完功課，你就可以玩電動。

mcq.q: My little brother is quiet ______ he is sleeping; at other times, he is very noisy.
mcq.st: 我弟弟只有在睡覺的時候才安靜；其他時候他都很吵。

mcq.q: ______ my dad is concerned, math is the most useful subject at school.
mcq.st: 就我爸爸而言，數學是學校裡最有用的科目。

mcq.q: ______ the bell rang, the students ran out of the classroom.
mcq.st: 鐘聲一響，學生們就跑出教室。

mcq.q: You can get a free cake ______ you buy two drinks; if you buy only one, you have to pay for it.
mcq.st: 只有在你買兩杯飲料的情況下，才能得到一個免費蛋糕；如果你只買一杯，就必須付錢買蛋糕。

mcq.q: Dad never drinks coffee, so Mom bought him ______ for his birthday.
o: not only coffee but also tea
mcq.st: 爸爸從不喝咖啡，所以媽媽買給他的生日禮物不是咖啡而是茶。

mcq.q: Ben eats ______ he hasn't eaten for days, but he just had lunch an hour ago.
mcq.st: 班吃東西的樣子好像他好幾天沒吃東西了，但他一小時前才剛吃過午餐。

mcq.q: Ken can speak ______, so he often helps visitors from America and Japan.
mcq.st: 肯會說英文以及日文，所以他常常幫助來自美國和日本的遊客。

mcq.q: There is only one seat left in the car, so ______ can come with us.
o: not only Tom but also Ben
mcq.st: 車上只剩一個座位，所以不是湯姆就是班可以跟我們一起去。

mcq.q: ______ it was raining hard, Lily still walked to school.
mcq.st: 雖然雨下得很大，莉莉還是走路去上學。

mcq.q: Amy is very busy after school because she learns ______; she has piano class on Monday and swimming class on Friday.
o: not only piano but also swimming
mcq.st: 艾美放學後很忙，因為她不僅學鋼琴，而且還學游泳；她星期一上鋼琴課，星期五上游泳課。

mcq.q: My grandma looks ______ she is fifty, but she is really seventy.
mcq.st: 我奶奶看起來好像五十歲，但她其實七十歲了。

mcq.q: The soup was ______ I couldn't eat it right away, so I waited for ten minutes.
mcq.st: 湯如此燙，以致於我無法馬上喝，所以我等了十分鐘。

mcq.q: Bring a jacket ______ it gets cold at night in the mountains.
mcq.st: 帶件外套，以防山上晚上變冷。

mcq.q: It was ______ we all went swimming in the river.
mcq.st: 那天是如此炎熱的一天，以致於我們全都去河裡游泳了。

08.title: 名詞片語（含數量詞） Noun & Quantity Phrases

rows.d: something very important
rows.s: Winning the school singing contest was _____ _____ _____ for Mia, so she practiced every night after dinner for a month.
rows.st: 贏得學校歌唱比賽對Mia來說是【一件大事】，所以她連續一個月每天晚餐後都在練習。

rows.d: the amount of food that fills a bowl
rows.s: I was so hungry after basketball practice that I ate _____ _____ _____ rice and two eggs at dinner.
rows.st: 籃球練習後我餓到晚餐吃了【一碗】飯和兩顆蛋。

rows.d: a very rare and special chance
rows.s: Meeting her favorite singer after the show was _____ _____ _____ _____ _____ for Emma, so she took many photos.
rows.st: 在演出後見到她最喜歡的歌手對Emma來說是【千載難逢的機會】，所以她拍了很多照片。

rows.d: a man who has become very different
rows.s: My uncle used to smoke and stay up late, but after he got sick, he became _____ _____ _____ who runs every morning.
rows.st: 我叔叔以前會抽菸又熬夜，但生病後他成了一個每天早上跑步的【改頭換面的人】。

rows.d: a mild illness with a runny nose and cough
rows.s: Alice caught _____ _____ _____ after playing in the rain, so she stayed home and drank a lot of warm water.
rows.st: Alice 在雨中玩耍後得了【普通感冒】，所以她待在家裡喝了很多溫開水。

rows.d: a person who is a friend of both of you
rows.s: Mia and I met at a birthday party because we have _____ _____ _____, and now we walk to school together.
rows.st: Mia 和我是在一場生日派對上認識的，因為我們有一位【共同的朋友】，現在我們一起走路上學。

rows.d: an error that many people make
rows.s: Forgetting the "s" after "he" or "she" is _____ _____ _____ for young learners, so our teacher reminds us often.
rows.st: 在 he 或 she 後面忘了加 s 是年輕學習者【常見的錯誤】，所以我們老師常常提醒我們。

rows.d: two people who love each other
rows.s: _____ _____ were sitting on the bench in the park, and they were sharing an ice cream while watching the sunset.
rows.st: 【一對情侶】坐在公園的長椅上，邊看夕陽邊分享一支冰淇淋。

rows.d: two of something
rows.s: Mom bought _____ _____ _____ apples at the market, one for me and one for my little brother, because we both love fruit.
rows.st: 媽媽在市場買了【兩個】蘋果，一個給我，一個給我弟弟，因為我們都很愛吃水果。

rows.d: twelve eggs
rows.s: Mom asked me to buy _____ _____ _____ at the convenience store because she wants to make a big cake for my birthday party.
rows.st: 媽媽叫我去便利商店買【一打蛋】，因為她想為我的生日派對做一個大蛋糕。

rows.d: a very popular song or movie
rows.s: The new song by that Taiwanese band became _____ _____ in just one week, and now everyone at school sings it.
rows.st: 那個台灣樂團的新歌在短短一週內就成了【熱門歌曲】，現在學校裡每個人都在唱。

rows.d: much (used with uncountable nouns)
rows.c: 大量的（+ 不可數名詞）
rows.s: Our school uses _____ _____ _____ _____ water every day, so the principal asked everyone to turn off the taps after washing hands.
rows.st: 我們學校每天使用【大量的】水，所以校長請大家洗完手要關好水龍頭。

rows.d: many (used with countable nouns)
rows.s: _____ _____ _____ _____ students joined the beach clean-up last Saturday, so we finished the work before lunch.
rows.st: 上星期六有【大量的】學生參加淨灘活動，所以我們在午餐前就完成了工作。

rows.d: a candle that is burning
rows.s: Never leave _____ _____ _____ alone in your room, because it can start a fire if it falls over.
rows.st: 千萬不要把【點著的蠟燭】留在房間裡沒人看著，因為它倒下的話可能會引起火災。

rows.w: a matter of life and death
rows.d: a very serious and important thing
rows.s: Please don't call me during class unless it is _____ _____ _____ _____ _____ _____, because the teacher will be angry.
rows.st: 除非是【生死攸關的事情】，否則上課時請不要打電話給我，因為老師會生氣。

rows.d: almost getting hurt but staying safe
rows.s: Our family had _____ _____ _____ when a big tree fell onto the road just after our car drove past it.
rows.st: 我們的車剛開過去，一棵大樹就倒在馬路上，我們全家真是【死裡逃生】。

rows.d: some; several
rows.s: _____ _____ _____ students in our class were sick last week, so our teacher moved the math test to Friday.
rows.st: 我們班上【一些】學生上週生病了，所以老師把數學考試延到星期五。

rows.d: two things that are used together
rows.s: Grandpa bought me _____ _____ _____ running shoes because my old ones were too small and had holes in them.
rows.st: 爺爺買給我【一雙】慢跑鞋，因為我的舊鞋太小，而且破洞了。

rows.d: a paper or pass that lets you go somewhere
rows.s: My uncle won _____ _____ _____ Disneyland in a lucky draw, so he is taking my cousin there this summer.
rows.st: 我叔叔在抽獎中贏得一張迪士尼樂園的【門票】，所以他今年夏天要帶我表弟去那裡。

rows.d: a game where both sides have the same score
rows.s: The soccer game ended in _____ _____, two to two, so both teams have to play again next Sunday afternoon.
rows.st: 這場足球賽以二比二【平手】結束，所以兩隊下週日下午得再比一次。

rows.d: many different kinds of
rows.s: The night market near my house sells _____ _____ _____ snacks, so my family often goes there for dinner on weekends.
rows.st: 我家附近的夜市賣【各式各樣的】小吃，所以我們家週末常去那裡吃晚餐。

rows.d: the usual way a person or group lives
rows.s: For many farmers in Taiwan, getting up early to work in the fields is _____ _____ _____ _____, not just a job.
rows.st: 對台灣許多農夫來說，早起下田工作是一種【生活方式】，而不只是一份工作。

rows.d: a noisy party where people act crazily
rows.c: 狂野的派對；瘋狂的派對
rows.s: The neighbors had _____ _____ _____ until two in the morning, so my little sister could not fall asleep at all.
rows.st: 鄰居開了一場【瘋狂的派對】直到凌晨兩點，所以我妹妹完全睡不著。

rows.d: a way to use or get something
rows.s: Students in the small mountain village did not have _____ _____ the Internet, so they went to the library to do their homework.
rows.st: 那個小山村的學生沒有【管道使用】網路，所以他們去圖書館寫功課。

rows.d: a movie with fights, car chases, and danger
rows.s: My brother loves watching _____ _____ with lots of car chases, but I prefer funny cartoons.
rows.st: 我哥哥很愛看有很多飛車追逐的【動作片】，但我比較喜歡好笑的卡通。

rows.d: a society with many old people
rows.s: Taiwan is becoming an _____ _____ because many people live longer and fewer babies are born each year.
rows.st: 台灣正逐漸成為【高齡化社會】，因為很多人活得更久，而且每年出生的嬰兒越來越少。

rows.d: a machine that cooks food with hot air
rows.s: My mom bought a new _____ _____ last week, and now she makes crispy chicken wings without using much oil.
rows.st: 我媽媽上週買了一台新的【氣炸鍋】，現在她不用很多油就能做出酥脆的雞翅。

rows.d: a win over everyone; winning every game
rows.c: 全面擊敗；全勝（常用於比賽或遊戲）
rows.s: Our class won every game in the school basketball contest this year, so everyone called it an _____ and cheered loudly.
rows.st: 我們班今年在學校籃球比賽中贏了每一場，所以大家都說這是一次【全勝】，並大聲歡呼。

rows.d: a place with rides and games for fun
rows.s: We went to the _____ _____ on Children's Day and rode the roller coaster three times because it was so exciting.
rows.st: 我們兒童節去了【遊樂園】，坐了三次雲霄飛車，因為太刺激了。

rows.d: the right reply to a question or problem
rows.s: Nobody in the class knew the _____ _____ the last math question, so the teacher explained it on the board.
rows.st: 班上沒有人知道最後一題數學【的答案】，所以老師在黑板上講解。

rows.d: the right replies to questions
rows.s: After the math test, Mr. Chen wrote all the _____ _____ _____ _____ on the board, so we could check our own mistakes.
rows.st: 數學考試後，陳老師把所有【問題的解答】寫在黑板上，所以我們可以檢查自己的錯誤。

rows.d: some other person
rows.s: The library was so quiet on Sunday morning that I didn't see _____ _____ there except the old man at the desk.
rows.st: 星期天早上圖書館好安靜，除了櫃檯那位老先生，我沒看到【其他人】。

rows.d: some other thing
rows.s: The waiter brought our noodles and asked, "Would you like _____ _____ to drink, or is water fine for you today?"
rows.st: 服務生送上我們的麵，然後問：「您想喝點【其他的東西】嗎？還是今天喝水就好？」

rows.d: a door at the back of a building
rows.s: Dad came home very late, so he quietly opened the _____ _____ and walked into the kitchen without waking anyone up.
rows.st: 爸爸很晚才回家，所以他悄悄打開【後門】走進廚房，沒有吵醒任何人。

rows.d: eating the right amounts of different healthy foods
rows.s: Our health teacher says that a _____ _____ with fruit, vegetables, and rice can help us stay strong and healthy all year.
rows.st: 健康老師說，有水果、蔬菜和米飯的【均衡飲食】能幫助我們一整年保持強壯健康。

rows.d: a large movie screen in a theater
rows.s: We could watch the movie at home, but it is much more exciting to see it on the _____ _____ with popcorn.
rows.st: 我們可以在家看這部電影，但配著爆米花在【大銀幕】上看刺激多了。

rows.d: a disease that birds can give to people
rows.s: Many farmers in the village were worried because _____ _____ was found in some chickens, so they had to close their farms.
rows.st: 村裡許多農夫很擔心，因為有些雞被發現感染了【禽流感】，所以他們必須關閉農場。

rows.d: a date with someone you have never met
rows.c: 相親；事先不認識的約會
rows.s: My aunt's friend set her up on a _____ _____ with a doctor, and they had dinner at a nice restaurant.
rows.st: 我阿姨的朋友安排她和一位醫生【相親】，他們在一家不錯的餐廳吃了晚餐。

rows.d: a game played on a board with pieces
rows.s: On rainy weekends, my family likes to stay home and play a _____ _____ together after dinner.
rows.st: 下雨的週末，我們家喜歡待在家，晚餐後一起玩【桌遊】。

rows.d: an egg cooked in hot water
rows.s: For breakfast, I usually eat a _____ _____ and a piece of toast, and I drink a glass of warm milk.
rows.st: 我早餐通常吃一顆【水煮蛋】和一片吐司，再喝一杯溫牛奶。

rows.d: a short paper about a book you read
rows.s: After Mei-ling finished reading the story about a brave dog, she wrote a _____ _____ for her English class.
rows.st: 美玲讀完那本關於一隻勇敢小狗的故事後，為英文課寫了一份【閱讀報告】。

rows.d: a piece of writing that says what you think of a book
rows.s: For homework, each student has to write a short _____ _____ about a story they read during summer vacation.
rows.st: 每個學生的作業是寫一篇短短的【書評】，介紹暑假讀過的一個故事。

rows.d: a short tie shaped like a bow
rows.s: My little brother wore a black _____ _____ and a white shirt to our aunt's wedding, and he looked very cute.
rows.st: 我弟弟穿著白襯衫、打著黑色【蝴蝶結領結】去參加阿姨的婚禮，看起來很可愛。

rows.d: the place where you buy show tickets
rows.s: We waited in a long line at the _____ _____, but all the tickets for the new movie were already sold out.
rows.st: 我們在【售票處】排了很長的隊，但那部新電影的票已經全部賣完了。

rows.d: very new and important news
rows.s: Dad turned up the TV when the _____ _____ said a big typhoon would hit Taiwan tomorrow morning.
rows.st: 當【突發新聞】說明天早上會有強烈颱風侵襲台灣時，爸爸把電視音量調大。

rows.d: what buyers say about something they bought
rows.s: Before I ordered the shoes online, I read the _____ _____, and most people said they were comfortable and cheap.
rows.st: 在網路上訂這雙鞋之前，我先看了【買家回饋】，大部分人說它們舒服又便宜。

rows.d: a long, sweet snack
rows.s: Mom said I could buy one _____ _____ at the convenience store if I finished all my homework before dinner.
rows.st: 媽媽說如果我在晚餐前寫完所有作業，就可以在便利商店買一條【糖果棒】。

rows.d: a small bag you take onto a plane
rows.s: You can take one small _____ _____ with you on the plane, but your big suitcase must stay in another part of the plane.
rows.st: 你可以帶一件小的【隨身行李】上飛機，但你的大行李箱必須放在飛機的另一個地方。

rows.d: the glass part of a phone that shows pictures
rows.s: Ben dropped his phone on the floor in the classroom, and now there is a big crack across his _____ _____ _____.
rows.st: Ben在教室裡把手機摔到地上，現在他的【手機螢幕】上有一條大裂痕。

rows.d: bags you give to the airline at the airport
rows.s: At the airport, Dad put our _____ _____ on the counter, and the lady said it was two kilos too heavy.
rows.st: 在機場，爸爸把我們的【托運行李】放到櫃檯上，櫃檯小姐說它超重了兩公斤。

rows.d: a long, flat piece of chocolate
rows.s: Kai was very hungry after the long hike, so he shared a big _____ _____ with his brother on the way home.
rows.st: 長途健行後凱很餓，所以回家路上他和弟弟分吃了一條大【巧克力棒】。

rows.d: what you can see of a city
rows.s: We went to the top of Taipei 101 at night, and the _____ _____ with all the lights was so beautiful.
rows.st: 我們晚上去了台北101頂樓，燈火通明的【城市景觀】好美。

rows.d: a sky with no clouds
rows.s: We went to the mountains to look at the stars because there was a _____ _____ and no rain all night.
rows.st: 我們去山上看星星，因為整晚都是【晴朗的天空】而且沒有下雨。

rows.d: a voice that is easy to hear
rows.s: Our class chose Jenny to read the speech on stage because she has a _____ _____ and never speaks too fast.
rows.st: 我們班選Jenny上台唸講稿，因為她有【清晰的聲音】，而且說話從不太快。

rows.d: something that many people or animals usually do
rows.s: Looking at phones while walking is _____ _____ among teenagers, but it can be very dangerous on busy streets.
rows.st: 邊走路邊看手機是青少年之間的【常見行為】，但在繁忙的街道上這可能很危險。

rows.d: an idea that many people think is true
rows.s: It is a _____ _____ in Taiwan that you should not give someone a clock as a gift, so people rarely do it.
rows.st: 在台灣有一個【普遍的信念】，就是不應該送別人時鐘當禮物，所以人們很少這麼做。

rows.d: a mistake in a computer program
rows.s: The game kept closing by itself, and the engineer said a _____ _____ in the program caused the problem.
rows.st: 遊戲一直自己關掉，工程師說是程式裡的【電腦錯誤】造成這個問題。

rows.d: the part of a computer that shows pictures
rows.s: Dad told me to take a break because I had been looking at the _____ _____ for three hours and my eyes were red.

mcq.q: The night market sells ______ snacks, so you can try many different foods there.
mcq.st: 夜市賣各式各樣的小吃，所以你可以在那裡嚐到許多不同的食物。

mcq.q: The doctor told me to put ______ into my eyes twice a day.
mcq.st: 醫生叫我一天點兩次眼藥水。

mcq.q: Riding a bike is a cheap and healthy ______ getting to school.
mcq.st: 騎腳踏車是一種便宜又健康的上學方法。

09.title: 慣用語與句型 Expressions & Sentence Patterns

rows.d: you must do what you promised
rows.s: A: Can you do my chores tomorrow instead? I'm too tired today. B: No way! _____ _____ _____ _____ _____. You promised to wash the dishes tonight.
rows.st: A：你明天可以幫我做家事嗎？我今天太累了。B：不行！【說好的事就要算數】。你答應今晚要洗碗的。

rows.d: something very easy to do
rows.s: A: Was the English quiz hard this morning? B: No, it was _____ _____ _____ _____ because I studied all the new words last night.
rows.st: A：今天早上的英文小考難嗎？B：不難，簡直【輕而易舉】，因為我昨晚把新單字都讀完了。

rows.d: a typhoon comes and hurts a place
rows.s: When _____ _____ _____ Taiwan in the summer, many trees fall down, so people should stay at home and stay safe.
rows.st: 夏天【颱風襲擊】台灣時，很多樹會倒下，所以大家應該待在家裡注意安全。

rows.d: as much as needed (after adj./adv.)
rows.c: 足夠……的（形容詞／副詞在前）
rows.s: Kevin is not tall _____ to reach the top shelf, so he has to stand on a chair to get the dictionary.
rows.st: 凱文不夠高【足以】搆到最上層的架子，所以他得站在椅子上才能拿到字典。

rows.w: after + 現在簡單式, S + 未來式
rows.d: when one thing finishes, another thing will happen
rows.c: 條件句：在某事發生之後，另一件事會接著發生
rows.s: _____ I finish my math homework this evening, I will play video games with my older brother for an hour.
rows.st: 今天傍晚【在】我寫完數學作業【之後】，我會和哥哥一起打一個小時的電動。

rows.d: Do you understand what I said?
rows.s: A: You must finish your homework before you play any video games tonight. _____ _____ _____? B: Yes, Mom, I understand.
rows.st: A：今晚玩任何電動之前，你一定要先寫完功課。【我說清楚了嗎？】B：是的，媽媽，我懂了。

rows.d: an earthquake shakes and hurts a place
rows.s: Last year, _____ _____ _____ the small town at night, but luckily nobody was hurt because the buildings were strong.
rows.st: 去年一場【地震襲擊】了那個小鎮，發生在夜裡，但幸好建築物很堅固，所以沒有人受傷。

rows.d: Are you joking?
rows.s: A: Our teacher said we will have three tests tomorrow. B: _____ _____ _____? We just had a big test today!
rows.st: A：老師說我們明天要考三個考試。B：【你在開玩笑吧？】我們今天才剛考完一次大考！

rows.d: the same in some way as
rows.s: My little sister is now _____ tall _____ my mother, and she is only twelve years old this year.
rows.st: 我妹妹現在已經【跟】我媽媽【一樣】高了，而她今年才十二歲。

rows.d: to the highest degree you can
rows.s: The bus was going to leave in five minutes, so Linda ran to the station _____ fast _____ _____ and just caught it.
rows.st: 公車五分鐘後就要開了，所以琳達【盡可能】快地跑向車站，剛好趕上。

rows.d: very, very poor
rows.s: After Uncle Ray lost his job, he was _____ _____ _____ _____ _____ _____, so our family helped him pay his rent.
rows.st: 雷叔叔失業後變得【一文不名】，所以我們家幫他付房租。

rows.d: will continue to exist for a long time
rows.s: Many people think online shopping _____ _____ _____ _____, because it is fast and easy for busy families.
rows.st: 很多人認為網路購物【會長久存在】，因為它對忙碌的家庭來說既快速又方便。

rows.c: 某人正值十幾歲／二十多歲／三十多歲
rows.s: My cousin _____ _____ her _____ now, so she likes to hang out with her friends more than with our family.
rows.st: 我表姊現在【正值十幾歲】，所以她比較喜歡和朋友出去，而不是和我們家人在一起。

rows.w: before + 現在簡單式, S + 未來式
rows.d: one thing will happen first, then another
rows.c: 條件句：在某事發生之前，另一件事會先發生
rows.s: _____ my mom gets home from work tonight, I will wash all the dishes and clean the kitchen to surprise her.
rows.st: 今晚【在】媽媽下班回家【之前】，我會把碗都洗好、把廚房打掃乾淨給她一個驚喜。

rows.d: kind hopes written at the end of a card
rows.s: At the end of her card to her old teacher, Wendy wrote, "_____ _____ for a happy and healthy new year!"
rows.st: 溫蒂在給以前老師的卡片結尾寫道：「【致上最誠摯的祝福】，祝您新年快樂又健康！」

rows.d: doing it late is better than not at all
rows.s: A: Sorry, I only finished my science report this morning, two days late. B: Well, _____ _____ _____ _____. Be on time next time.
rows.st: A：抱歉，我今天早上才完成自然報告，晚了兩天。B：嗯，【晚做總比不做好】。下次要準時喔。

rows.d: good in a way I did not expect
rows.s: The new noodle shop near our school was much _____ _____ _____ _____, so we plan to eat there again next week.
rows.st: 我們學校附近那家新麵店【比我想像的】好太多了，所以我們打算下週再去吃。

rows.d: is already the best it can be
rows.s: We are at the beach, the sun is shining, and we all have ice cream in our hands, so life _____ _____ _____ _____!
rows.st: 我們在海邊，陽光燦爛，每個人手上都拿著冰淇淋，人生真是【再好不過了】！

rows.d: you cannot stop yourself from doing something
rows.s: I know I should stop eating chocolate before dinner, but I _____ _____ _____ because it tastes so good.
rows.st: 我知道晚餐前不該再吃巧克力，但我【忍不住】，因為它太好吃了。

rows.d: it is likely that
rows.s: The sky is dark and the wind is strong, so _____ _____ the baseball game will be stopped this afternoon.
rows.st: 天空很暗，風也很強，所以今天下午的棒球比賽【很可能】會暫停。

rows.w: cost an arm and a leg
rows.d: be very, very expensive
rows.c: 非常昂貴；貴得嚇人（口語）
rows.s: The new game console looks really cool, but it _____ _____ _____ _____ _____ _____, so I will wait for a sale.
rows.st: 新的遊戲機看起來真的很酷，但它【貴得嚇人】，所以我會等特價。

rows.d: Do you understand it?
rows.s: A: First you add these two numbers, and then you divide the answer by three. _____ _____ _____ _____? B: Yes, now it looks easy.
rows.st: A：首先把這兩個數字相加，然後把答案除以三。【你了解了嗎？】B：了解，現在看起來很簡單。

rows.d: a polite question asking if something is OK
rows.s: A: _____ _____ _____ opening the window? It's really hot in here. B: Not at all. I'll open it for you.
rows.st: A：【你介意】打開窗戶【嗎？】這裡真的好熱。B：一點也不。我幫你開。

rows.d: please move; you are blocking me
rows.s: A: Can I stand here and watch you cook the noodles, Mom? B: Sure, but _____ _____ _____ _____ _____, because the pot is very hot.
rows.st: A：媽，我可以站在這裡看妳煮麵嗎？B：可以，但【別擋我的路】，因為鍋子很燙。

rows.d: stop annoying me; let me do my work
rows.s: A: Hey, do you want to play cards with us in the living room? B: _____ _____ _____ now. I'm studying for tomorrow's test.
rows.st: A：嘿，你要來客廳跟我們玩牌嗎？B：現在【別煩我】。我在準備明天的考試。

rows.d: don't make someone angry
rows.s: A: Should I take Lisa's seat while she's away? B: No! _____ _____ Lisa. She gets really angry when people touch her things.
rows.st: A：莉莎不在時我可以坐她的位子嗎？B：不行！【別惹】莉莎。別人碰她的東西時她會非常生氣。

rows.w: Don't judge a book by its cover.
rows.d: don't decide what someone is like from their looks
rows.s: A: The new boy looks scary, so I don't want to talk to him. B: _____ _____ _____ _____ _____ _____ _____. He's actually very kind.
rows.st: A：那個新來的男生看起來很兇，所以我不想跟他說話。B：【人不可貌相】。他其實很善良。

rows.d: please go on; don't worry about me
rows.s: A: Oh, Grandpa, are you going to sit here with us? B: _____ _____ _____. I'm just reading my newspaper, so keep playing your game.
rows.st: A：喔，爺爺，你要坐在這裡跟我們一起嗎？B：【別管我。】我只是在看報紙，你們繼續玩遊戲吧。

rows.d: don't try to make me do something
rows.s: A: Come on, just tell me your secret. I'll give you my cookie! B: _____ _____ _____. I said I don't want to talk about it.
rows.st: A：拜託啦，告訴我你的祕密就好。我把我的餅乾給你！B：【別逼我。】我說了我不想談這件事。

rows.d: we will not talk about it anymore
rows.c: 不再討論；討論到此為止
rows.s: A: Mom, can I stay up late and play games tonight? B: No, you have school tomorrow. _____ _____ _____.
rows.st: A：媽，我今晚可以熬夜打電動嗎？B：不行，你明天要上學。【討論到此為止】。

rows.d: it is very easy; anyone can do it
rows.c: 連嬰兒都能……（形容非常簡單）
rows.s: This new phone game is so easy that _____ _____ _____ _____ play it, so my grandpa wants to try it too.
rows.st: 這款新的手機遊戲簡單到【連嬰兒都能】玩，所以我爺爺也想試試看。

rows.d: a polite way to ask someone to move or listen
rows.s: A: _____ _____, could I get past? My bus stop is next. B: Oh, sure, sorry about that!
rows.st: A：【借過】，可以讓我過去嗎？下一站就是我要下車的站了。B：喔，當然，不好意思！

rows.d: do the most important thing first
rows.c: 要事第一；先做重要的事
rows.s: A: Let's play video games now! B: _____ _____ _____. We need to finish our math homework before dinner.
rows.st: A：我們現在來打電動吧！B：【先做重要的事】。我們得在晚餐前寫完數學作業。

rows.d: happy times always end soon
rows.c: 美好的事物總是不長久
rows.s: A: Our summer vacation is over already, and school starts tomorrow. B: I know. _____ _____ _____ _____.
rows.st: A：我們的暑假已經結束了，明天就開學。B：我知道。【美好的事物總是不長久】。

rows.d: move this carefully because it can break
rows.c: 小心處理（常見於包裹標示）
rows.s: The box had glass cups inside, so Mom wrote "_____ _____ _____" on it before she sent it to Grandma.
rows.st: 箱子裡裝著玻璃杯，所以媽媽寄給奶奶之前在上面寫了「【小心處理】」。

rows.d: did something at some time in the past
rows.s: I _____ visited Tainan _____, so I can show you the best places to eat beef soup when we get there next week.
rows.st: 我【以前曾】去過台南，所以下週我們到那裡時，我可以帶你去吃最好吃的牛肉湯。

rows.w: Have you ever been to + 地方?
rows.d: did you visit this place before?
rows.s: A: _____ _____ _____ _____ _____ Hualien? B: Yes, I went there with my family last summer and saw Taroko Gorge.
rows.st: A：【你曾經去過】花蓮【嗎】？B：有，我去年夏天跟家人去過，還看了太魯閣峽谷。

rows.d: Telling the truth is always best.
rows.s: A: I broke Mom's favorite cup. Should I hide it? B: No, just tell her the truth. _____ _____ _____ _____ _____.
rows.st: A：我打破了媽媽最喜歡的杯子。我該把它藏起來嗎？B：不，跟她說實話就好。【誠實為上策】。

rows.d: I agree with you completely
rows.s: A: Our school should have more sports clubs, so students can exercise after class. B: _____ _____ _____ _____. I'd join the tennis club.
rows.st: A：我們學校應該有更多運動社團，讓學生下課後可以運動。B：【我非常同意】。我會加入網球社。

rows.d: I don't believe it.
rows.s: A: Tom says he finished all his homework in ten minutes. B: _____ _____ _____ _____. He always needs at least an hour!
rows.st: A：Tom說他十分鐘就寫完所有功課了。B：【我才不信】。他總是至少要一個小時！

rows.d: I do not understand.
rows.s: A: Everyone laughed at Tom's joke about the cat and the fish. B: _____ _____ _____ _____. Why is it so funny?
rows.st: A：大家都被Tom關於貓和魚的笑話逗笑了。B：【我不懂】。為什麼那麼好笑？

rows.d: it's OK with me
rows.s: A: Do you want to eat noodles or rice for dinner tonight? B: _____ _____ _____. Both are fine with me, so you can choose.
rows.st: A：你今晚晚餐想吃麵還是飯？B：【我不介意。】兩個我都可以，所以你來選吧。

rows.d: I understand now.
rows.s: A: You need to click this button first, and then the game will start. B: Oh, _____ _____ _____. Thanks for your help!
rows.st: A：你要先按這個按鈕，然後遊戲就會開始。B：喔，【我懂了】。謝謝你的幫忙！

rows.d: I agree with what you just said
rows.c: 我附議／我贊同（正式或幽默用法）
rows.s: A: I think we should order pizza for the class party because everyone likes it. B: _____ _____ _____. Let's get two big ones.
rows.st: A：我覺得班級派對應該訂披薩，因為大家都喜歡。B：【我附議】。我們訂兩個大的吧。

rows.d: I understand now.
rows.s: A: The library is closed today because they are cleaning the floors and windows. B: _____ _____. I will come back tomorrow, then.
rows.st: A：圖書館今天休館，因為他們在清潔地板和窗戶。B：【我了解了】。那我明天再來。

rows.w: I'd love/like to, but + 子句
rows.d: a polite way to say no
rows.s: A: Do you want to come to my birthday party on Saturday night? B: _____ _____ _____, _____ I have to visit my grandparents.
rows.st: A：你星期六晚上要來我的生日派對嗎？B：【我很想去，但】我得去探望祖父母。

rows.w: If + 現在簡單式, S + 未來式
rows.d: if this happens, another thing will happen
rows.c: 條件句：如果某事發生，將會……
rows.s: _____ it rains tomorrow morning, our class will not go to the zoo, and we will watch a movie at school instead.
rows.st: 【如果】明天早上下雨，我們班就不會去動物園，而是會在學校看電影。

rows.d: I really wish
rows.s: _____ _____ I had studied harder for the math test, I would not feel so worried about my grade now.
rows.st: 【但願】我當初考數學前更用功一點，這樣我現在就不會這麼擔心成績了。

rows.d: I will phone you again soon
rows.s: A: Can we talk about the class trip now? B: Sorry, I'm on a noisy bus. _____ _____ _____ _____ when I get home.
rows.st: A：我們現在可以討論校外教學嗎？B：抱歉，我在很吵的公車上。我到家後【待會打給你】。

rows.d: No, thank you; I won't join.
rows.s: A: We're going to the haunted house at the night market. Do you want to come? B: _____ _____. I get scared too easily.
rows.st: A：我們要去夜市的鬼屋。你要一起來嗎？B：【我就不去了】。我太容易被嚇到了。

rows.w: It costs + 人 + 錢 + to + VR
rows.d: doing something needs this much money
rows.s: _____ _____ us five thousand dollars _____ fix the old car, so Dad decided to buy a new one next year.
rows.st: 修那台舊車【花了】我們五千元，所以爸爸決定明年買一台新的。

rows.d: It is not accepted as real or right.
rows.s: A: I got the ball into the basket, so our team wins! B: Sorry, _____ _____ _____ because your foot was on the line.
rows.st: A：我把球投進籃框了，所以我們隊贏了！B：抱歉，【不算】，因為你的腳踩到線了。

rows.w: It doesn't matter whether/if + 子句
rows.d: something is not important either way
rows.s: _____ _____ _____ _____ you win or lose the race, because the most important thing is to have fun with your friends.
rows.st: 【不管】你比賽贏或輸【都沒關係】，因為最重要的是和朋友們一起玩得開心。

rows.d: I don't remember it.
rows.s: A: Do you remember a girl named Lily from our elementary school? B: Hmm, sorry, _____ _____ _____ _____ _____.
rows.st: A：你記得我們國小一個叫Lily的女生嗎？B：嗯，抱歉，【我沒印象】。

rows.w: It takes + 人 + 時間 + to + VR
rows.d: someone needs this much time to do something
rows.c: 花某人多少時間做…（= 人 spend + 時間 + V-ing）
rows.s: _____ _____ me twenty minutes _____ walk from my home to school, so I always leave before seven o'clock.
rows.st: 我從家裡走路到學校【要花我】二十分鐘，所以我總是七點前出門。

rows.w: It turns out that + 子句
rows.d: in the end, we learn that
rows.s: We thought someone had stolen Dad's car, but _____ _____ _____ _____ he had parked it on another street.
rows.st: 我們以為有人偷了爸爸的車，但【原來】他把車停在另一條街上。

rows.w: It turns out to be + N/adj.
rows.d: in the end it is something
rows.s: We were worried about the camping trip because of the storm, but _____ _____ _____ _____ _____ a sunny day.
rows.st: 我們因為暴風雨而擔心露營，但【結果是】個晴天。

rows.w: It was not until + 時間/子句 + that + 句子
rows.d: only at that time did something happen
rows.s: It was _____ _____ ten o'clock at night that my sister finally finished her homework and went to bed.
rows.st: 我姊姊【直到】晚上十點【才】終於寫完功課去睡覺。

rows.d: I can't understand it.
rows.s: A: Can you help me with this math question about circles? B: Sorry, _____ _____ _____. Let's ask Mr. Lin after class.
rows.st: A：你可以幫我解這題關於圓形的數學題嗎？B：抱歉，【我也搞不懂】。我們下課後去問林老師吧。

rows.d: I am happy and honored to do this
rows.c: 很樂意做⋯⋯／是我的榮幸做⋯⋯
rows.s: Thank you all for coming to our school concert tonight, and _____ _____ _____ _____ introduce our wonderful music teacher, Ms. Lin.
rows.st: 謝謝大家今晚來參加我們學校的音樂會，【我很榮幸能】為大家介紹我們優秀的音樂老師林老師。

rows.d: I will pay for it
rows.s: A: Let me pay for the bubble tea this time. B: No, no, _____ _____ _____. You paid for our lunch yesterday.
rows.st: A：這次珍奶讓我付吧。B：不不不，【我請客】。你昨天已經請我們吃午餐了。

rows.d: Now I can do it after others.
rows.s: A: I have finished my turn on the swing, so who wants to go next? B: _____ _____ _____! I have been waiting for ten minutes.
rows.st: A：我盪完鞦韆了，接下來誰要玩？B：【輪到我了】！我已經等了十分鐘。

rows.w: It's never too late to learn.
rows.d: you can learn at any age
rows.s: My grandpa started to learn English at seventy because he believes _____ _____ _____ _____ _____ _____.
rows.st: 我爺爺七十歲才開始學英文，因為他相信【活到老，學到老】。

rows.d: It is not important; no problem.
rows.s: A: I'm so sorry that I forgot to bring your comic book back today. B: _____ _____ _____ _____ _____. You can give it to me tomorrow.
rows.st: A：真抱歉，我今天忘了把你的漫畫書帶來還你。B：【沒什麼大不了的】。你明天再給我就好。

rows.d: do it now or lose the chance
rows.c: 機不可失；此時不做更待何時
rows.s: A: Should I ask Jenny to dance with me? The music ends in two minutes! B: _____ _____ _____ _____. Go and ask her!
rows.st: A：我該邀珍妮跟我跳舞嗎？音樂再兩分鐘就結束了！B：【機不可失】。快去邀她！

rows.d: I will pay (spoken)
rows.s: A: How much was my hamburger? I want to pay you back. B: Don't worry about it. _____ _____ _____.
rows.st: A：我的漢堡多少錢？我要還你。B：別在意啦。【我請客】。

rows.d: slang: it is really cool or great
rows.s: A: Look at my new skateboard. My uncle bought it for me in the U.S. B: Wow, _____ _____! Can I try it after school?
rows.st: A：你看我的新滑板。我叔叔在美國買給我的。B：哇，【太厲害了！】我放學後可以試試看嗎？

rows.d: it is the right time to have or do something
rows.s: Put away your phones and wash your hands, everyone. _____ _____ _____ dinner, and Grandma made your favorite fried rice.
rows.st: 大家把手機收起來去洗手。【晚餐時間到了】，奶奶做了你們最喜歡的炒飯。

rows.d: it is the right time to do something
rows.s: It's already eleven o'clock and you have a test tomorrow morning, so _____ _____ _____ turn off the TV and go to bed.
