rows.d: something will happen in both cases
rows.c: 條件句：無論某事是否發生，都將會……
rows.s: _____ it is sunny _____ _____ this Saturday, we will still go to the night market with our cousins from Taichung.
rows.st: 【無論】這個星期六【是否】出太陽，我們都還是會和台中來的表哥表姊去逛夜市。

rows.d: asks where someone is going
rows.s: A: I'm leaving the library now, Peter. B: Me too. _____ _____ _____ _____ _____? Maybe we can walk together.
rows.st: A：彼得，我現在要離開圖書館了。B：我也是。【你要往哪走】？也許我們可以一起走。

rows.d: which other person?
rows.s: A: Jenny and Mark are coming to my birthday party on Saturday. B: Great! _____ _____ is coming?
rows.st: A：珍妮和馬克星期六會來我的生日派對。B：太好了！【還有誰】會來？

rows.d: did something often in the past
rows.c: 過去常常（表習慣）= used to
rows.s: When I was a child, my grandmother _____ take me to the morning market every Sunday and buy me soy milk.
rows.st: 我小時候，奶奶每個星期天【常常】帶我去早市，還會買豆漿給我。

rows.d: used to say "yes, of course" strongly
rows.s: A: Are you coming to watch my basketball game on Saturday afternoon? B: _____ _____! I wouldn't miss it for anything.
rows.st: A：你星期六下午會來看我的籃球比賽嗎？B：【當然】！我說什麼都不會錯過的。

rows.d: used to say you agree completely
rows.s: A: This math test was so hard, and I didn't finish the last page. B: _____ _____ _____ _____ _____. I almost cried.
rows.st: A：這次數學考試好難，我最後一頁都沒寫完。B：【完全同意】。我差點哭了。

rows.d: enjoy life and try new things now
rows.c: 人生只有一次；及時行樂
rows.s: A: I'm a little scared to try the big roller coaster at the theme park. B: Come on! _____ _____ _____ _____. Let's go!
rows.st: A：我有點害怕去玩主題樂園的大雲霄飛車。B：來嘛！【人生只有一次】，走吧！

mcq.q: A: I just won a free trip to Japan!
o: What do you have in mind?
mcq.st: A：我剛贏得一趟免費的日本之旅！

mcq.q: A: I'm going to eat Tom's ice cream in the fridge.
o: I have seen this movie before.
mcq.st: A：我要去吃冰箱裡湯姆的冰淇淋。

mcq.q: A: The concert tickets are on sale for only one more hour. Should I buy one?
o: It turns out that the shop is closed.
mcq.st: A：演唱會門票只剩一個小時可以買。我該買一張嗎？

mcq.q: A: I think we should have the class party on Friday.
mcq.st: A：我認為我們應該在星期五辦班級派對。

mcq.q: A: How was the sunrise at Alishan?
o: It cost an arm and a leg.
mcq.st: A：阿里山的日出怎麼樣？

mcq.q: A: Do you mind if I open the window?
mcq.st: A：你介意我打開窗戶嗎？

mcq.q: At the end of her birthday card to Grandma, Amy wrote, "______, Amy."
o: There is a market for cards
mcq.st: 在給奶奶的生日卡片最後，艾咪寫道：「致上最誠摯的祝福，艾咪。」

mcq.q: A: Who will buy the drinks for the party?
o: I don't know when the party will start.
I turned a blind eye to it.
mcq.st: A：誰要買派對的飲料？

mcq.q: A: You ran ten kilometers this morning. Are you tired?
mcq.st: A：你今天早上跑了十公里。你累嗎？

mcq.q: A: That new boy looks scary. I don't want to talk to him.
o: Don't judge a book by its cover.
mcq.st: A：那個新來的男孩看起來很可怕。我不想跟他說話。

mcq.q: The teacher said, "______ Please put down your pencils and hand in your test papers."
o: Chances are that it will rain.
mcq.st: 老師說：「時間到了。請放下鉛筆，交出你們的考卷。」

mcq.q: A: Mom, can I play video games now?
o: What else do you want to do?
mcq.st: A：媽，我現在可以玩電動嗎？

mcq.q: A: Dad, can I skip washing the dishes tonight?
o: The report says that it will rain.
mcq.st: A：爸，我今晚可以不洗碗嗎？

mcq.q: A: How was the math test?
o: It doesn't matter if I pass.
It was a piece of cake.
mcq.st: A：數學考試怎麼樣？

mcq.q: A: Is Jenny coming to your birthday party?
o: I don't know if she will come.
One is red, and the other is blue.
mcq.st: A：珍妮會來你的生日派對嗎？

mcq.q: A: Look at those birds in the sky.
mcq.st: A：看天空中的那些鳥。

mcq.q: A: Why did the chicken cross the road? To get to the other side! Ha ha!
mcq.st: A：雞為什麼要過馬路？為了到另一邊去！哈哈！

mcq.q: A: I'm afraid to try skydiving.
o: What's your take on the movie?
mcq.st: A：我不敢嘗試跳傘。

mcq.q: A: Tom, you have played with the ball for twenty minutes. ______ Give it to me, please.
mcq.st: A：湯姆，你已經玩球玩了二十分鐘了。輪到我了。請把球給我。

o: How about going to the park?
Have you ever been to Japan?
mcq.st: A：你曾經去過日本嗎？

mcq.q: A: I didn't finish my homework last night.
o: The box is too heavy to carry.
mcq.st: A：我昨晚沒寫完功課。

mcq.q: Good evening, everyone. ______ introduce our special guest tonight, the singer Amy Lin.
o: It costs me a lot to
mcq.st: 大家晚安。我很榮幸為大家介紹今晚的特別來賓，歌手林艾咪。

mcq.q: A: Should we eat pizza or noodles tonight?
mcq.st: A：我們今晚該吃披薩還是麵？

mcq.q: A: Hurry! The last bus leaves in three minutes!
o: I'll run as fast as possible.
What kinds of games do you like?
mcq.st: A：快點！末班公車三分鐘後就要開了！

mcq.q: A: This new phone is only 100 dollars, and you get a free computer with it!
o: The last thing I want to do is study.
mcq.st: A：這支新手機只要一百元，而且還送你一台電腦！

mcq.q: A: Did you copy Tom's answers on the test?
o: That's the last thing I would do.
It cost an arm and a leg.
mcq.st: A：你考試時抄湯姆的答案嗎？

mcq.q: A: Is your brother taller than you?
o: He is as tall as I am.
After he comes home, he will eat dinner.
mcq.st: A：你哥哥比你高嗎？

mcq.q: A: Should I wear the red shirt or the blue one to the party?
o: It cost me 500 dollars to buy it.
mcq.st: A：我該穿紅色還是藍色的襯衫去派對？

mcq.q: A: Did you really see a famous singer at the MRT station?
o: It's one of the tallest buildings in the world.
mcq.st: A：你真的在捷運站看到一位有名的歌手嗎？

mcq.q: A: Hey, I'm carrying a very heavy box. ______
mcq.st: A：嘿，我正搬著一個很重的箱子。別擋我的路。

mcq.q: When Mom said he couldn't go to the concert, Ben ______ and didn't talk to anyone all evening.
o: cost an arm and a leg
mcq.st: 當媽媽說他不能去演唱會時，班拉長了臉，整個晚上都不跟任何人說話。

mcq.q: A: Will you still go hiking if it rains tomorrow?
o: Tom is the last person to tell a lie.
Whether it rains or not, I will go.
mcq.st: A：如果明天下雨，你還會去爬山嗎？

mcq.q: A: Do you remember Mr. Chen, our first-grade teacher?
mcq.st: A：你記得陳老師嗎？我們一年級的老師。

mcq.q: A: Come on, just jump into the pool! Do it now!
mcq.st: A：快點，跳進泳池就對了！現在就跳！

mcq.q: A: Are you going to the mountains this weekend?
o: I'm not sure whether it will snow there.
It's time to go to bed.
mcq.st: A：你這個週末要去山上嗎？

mcq.q: A: Can I borrow your new comic book?
o: I haven't finished reading it yet.
mcq.st: A：我可以借你的新漫畫書嗎？

mcq.q: A: Why does your dad speak Japanese so well?
mcq.st: A：你爸爸日文為什麼說得這麼好？

mcq.q: A: Can I play with your phone? Please? Please? Please?
mcq.st: A：我可以玩你的手機嗎？拜託？拜託？拜託？

mcq.q: A: Hi, Mike. Do you have time to talk now?
o: This is the least I can do.
mcq.st: A：嗨，麥克。你現在有時間講話嗎？

mcq.q: A: How long does it take you to get to school?
o: I'd love to, but I have to study.
Walking there takes me only five minutes.
mcq.st: A：你到學校要花多久時間？

mcq.q: A: How was the new restaurant?
o: It turned out to be terrible.
It was better than I thought.
mcq.st: A：那家新餐廳怎麼樣？

mcq.q: A: How much money did your parents give you for your birthday? Tell me!
o: I turned a deaf ear to it.
mcq.st: A：你爸媽生日給了你多少錢？告訴我！

mcq.q: A: Sorry, I'm 30 minutes late for the party.
mcq.st: A：抱歉，我參加派對遲到了三十分鐘。

mcq.q: A: Let me pay for the drinks.
o: It was not until ten that I got home.
mcq.st: A：飲料讓我付吧。

mcq.q: Teacher: No phones in class. If I see one, I will take it. ______
mcq.st: 老師：上課不准用手機。如果我看到，我就會沒收。我說清楚了嗎？

mcq.q: A: Why can't Amy wear that skirt to school?
o: It takes her ten minutes to put it on.
mcq.st: A：為什麼艾咪不能穿那件裙子去學校？

mcq.q: A: I'm so sorry. I broke your pencil.
mcq.st: A：真抱歉，我把你的鉛筆弄斷了。

mcq.q: A: Did Dad eat breakfast with you at seven?
o: He didn't get up until ten.
mcq.st: A：爸爸七點有和你一起吃早餐嗎？

mcq.q: A: What do you think of my new skateboard?
mcq.st: A：你覺得我的新滑板怎麼樣？

mcq.q: A: The bus left five minutes ago. Let's run after it!
o: There's no point running after it.
It's never too late to learn.
mcq.st: A：公車五分鐘前就開走了。我們追上去吧！

mcq.q: A: When will you wash your hands?
o: Before I eat dinner, I will wash my hands.
I would wash my hands with cold water.
If it rains, I will stay home.
mcq.st: A：你什麼時候會洗手？

mcq.q: The box has glass cups in it, so Mom wrote "______" on it.
mcq.st: 箱子裡有玻璃杯，所以媽媽在上面寫了「小心處理」。

mcq.q: A: ______ Can I get past, please?
o: It's too good to be true.
mcq.st: A：借過一下。我可以過去嗎？

mcq.q: I have three pets. ______
o: If I get a dog, I will be happy.
One is a dog, another is a cat, and the other is a bird.
One is a dog, and the other is a cat.
mcq.st: 我有三隻寵物。一隻是狗，另一隻是貓，剩下那隻是鳥。

o: What kinds of milk do you like?
What are you going to the store for?
mcq.st: A：你去商店是為了什麼？

mcq.q: A: Kevin, how should I make the dumplings for you?
o: Just the way you used to make them.
mcq.st: A：凱文，我該怎麼幫你做水餃？

mcq.q: A: Why is there no school today?
o: A strong typhoon is hitting Taipei.
mcq.st: A：為什麼今天不用上學？

mcq.q: A: Why did you leave the movie early?
o: It was such a boring movie.
It was too good to be true.
It was the best movie I have ever seen.
mcq.st: A：你為什麼提早離開電影院？

mcq.q: A: Why were your shoes wet yesterday?
o: When I walked home, it started to rain.
mcq.st: A：你昨天的鞋子為什麼濕了？

mcq.q: A: When will you tell Mom the good news?
o: Once she gets home, I will tell her.
mcq.st: A：你什麼時候要告訴媽媽這個好消息？

rows.d: used to add another point
rows.s: Our school library has many new storybooks this year. _____, it now has six computers that students can use after class.
rows.st: 我們學校圖書館今年有很多新的故事書。【此外】，現在還有六台學生下課後可以使用的電腦。

rows.d: used to add one more point to what you said
rows.s: Walking to school is good for your health because you move your body every day. _____, it saves your parents time and gas money.
rows.st: 走路上學對健康有益，因為你每天都在活動身體。【再者】，這也幫爸媽省下時間和油錢。

rows.d: used to add another fact or idea
rows.s: My cousin is very good at drawing pictures of animals. She _____ plays the guitar in the school band every Friday afternoon.
rows.st: 我表姊很會畫動物。她【也】每週五下午在學校樂團彈吉他。

rows.d: used to add one more thing of the same kind
rows.s: One reason I like summer is the long vacation. _____ reason is that I can swim in the pool with my friends every day.
rows.st: 我喜歡夏天的一個原因是長假。【另一個】原因是我每天都能和朋友在泳池游泳。

rows.d: used to add another thing; means 'and also'
rows.s: Lily practices the piano every evening after dinner. She can play the violin _____ _____ _____ the piano, so she joined two music clubs.
rows.st: 莉莉每天晚餐後練鋼琴。她會拉小提琴【以及】彈鋼琴，所以參加了兩個音樂社團。

rows.d: used to add another reason or point
rows.s: I don't want to go to the night market tonight because I am too tired. _____, I still have a lot of homework to finish.
rows.st: 我今晚不想去夜市，因為我太累了。【而且】，我還有很多功課要寫完。

rows.d: used to add something that happens together with another thing
rows.c: 加上；連同（補充）（正式用語）
rows.s: Tom stayed up late playing games every night. This, _____ _____ a bad breakfast, made him feel sleepy in class.
rows.st: 湯姆每晚熬夜打電動。這件事【加上】早餐吃不好，讓他上課時很想睡。

rows.d: used to add one more point, often in writing
rows.c: 此外；再者（補充）（正式用語）
rows.s: Riding a bike to school is cheaper than taking the bus. _____, it is good for the earth because bikes do not make dirty air.
rows.st: 騎腳踏車上學比搭公車便宜。【再者】，這對地球也好，因為腳踏車不會製造髒空氣。

rows.d: used to add another important point
rows.c: 此外；而且（補充）（正式用語）
rows.s: Our new teacher explains grammar in a clear and easy way. _____, she always gives us fun games to practice new words.
rows.st: 我們的新老師用清楚又簡單的方式講解文法。【此外】，她總是給我們有趣的遊戲來練習新單字。

rows.d: used to add a point that is just as important as the last one
rows.s: Eating healthy food is important for growing students. _____ _____, you should sleep at least eight hours every night.
rows.st: 吃健康的食物對成長中的學生很重要。【同樣重要的是】，你每晚應該至少睡八個小時。

rows.d: used to add more information
rows.s: Our new classroom has bigger windows and brighter lights. _____ _____, it has an air conditioner and a new projector.
rows.st: 我們的新教室有更大的窗戶和更亮的燈。【此外】，還有冷氣和新的投影機。

rows.d: used to add a point that is the same or similar
rows.s: You should say thank you when someone helps you at school. _____, you should say sorry when you make a mistake.
rows.st: 在學校有人幫你時，你應該說謝謝。【同樣地】，你犯錯時應該說對不起。

rows.d: used to add a stronger or more important point
rows.c: 此外；而且（補充）（正式用語）
rows.s: This small cafe near our school sells cheap and tasty sandwiches. _____, the owner is very kind and always remembers our names.
rows.st: 學校附近這間小咖啡店賣便宜又好吃的三明治。【而且】，老闆很親切，總是記得我們的名字。

rows.d: used to show a result that matches the situation
rows.c: 因此；於是（結果）（正式用語）
rows.s: The weather report said a typhoon was coming on Friday. _____, our school canceled the sports day and moved it to next week.
rows.st: 氣象報告說颱風週五會來。【因此】，學校取消了運動會，改到下週舉行。

rows.d: used to show that one thing happens first and the next thing follows
rows.s: Amy always feels tired when she gets home. _____ she finishes her homework, she takes a hot shower and goes to bed.
rows.st: 艾美回到家總是覺得很累。【在】她寫完功課【之後】，她會洗個熱水澡然後上床睡覺。

rows.d: used to show a result, often a bad one
rows.c: 結果；因此（結果）（正式用語）
rows.s: Jack forgot to set his alarm clock last night. _____ _____ _____, he missed the school bus and was late for class.
rows.st: 傑克昨晚忘了設鬧鐘。【結果】，他錯過了校車，上課遲到了。

rows.d: used to show the result of something
rows.s: Mary studied English for one hour every day this semester. _____ _____ _____, she got the highest score on the final exam.
rows.st: 瑪莉這學期每天讀一小時英文。【結果】，她期末考得到最高分。

rows.d: used to talk about what was happening at a certain time in the past
rows.s: My parents moved to Taipei ten years ago. _____ _____ _____, there was no MRT station near our home, so they rode a scooter to work.
rows.st: 我爸媽十年前搬到台北。【當時】，我們家附近沒有捷運站，所以他們騎機車上班。

rows.d: used to show that one thing happens earlier than another
rows.s: Mom has a rule in our house about dinner. _____ we eat dinner, we must wash our hands and set the table together.
rows.st: 媽媽在家裡定了一個晚餐規定。【在】吃晚餐【之前】，我們必須洗手並一起擺好餐桌。

rows.d: used to show that two things happen at the same time
rows.s: Ben was cooking noodles for the family in the kitchen. _____, his little sister was cleaning the table in the living room.
rows.st: 班在廚房為家人煮麵。【同時】，他妹妹在客廳擦桌子。

rows.d: used to show the result of an action
rows.c: 因此；結果（結果）（正式用語）
rows.s: Kevin ate too much ice cream at the party last night. _____, he had a stomachache and could not come to school today.
rows.st: 凱文昨晚在派對上吃了太多冰淇淋。【結果】，他肚子痛，今天沒辦法來上學。

rows.d: used to introduce the last step or the end result
rows.s: We waited for the bus in the rain for forty minutes. _____, it came, and we all got on quickly.
rows.st: 我們在雨中等公車等了四十分鐘。【終於】，公車來了，我們都很快上了車。

rows.d: used to show what comes next in order
rows.c: 接著是；隨後是（時間順序）
rows.s: Our school concert started with a song from the choir. It was _____ _____ a short play by the ninth graders.
rows.st: 我們學校的音樂會由合唱團的一首歌開場。【接著是】九年級學生的一齣短劇。

rows.d: used to show the reason or goal for an action
rows.s: Our class wants to clean the beach next Saturday morning. _____ _____ _____, everyone will bring trash bags and gloves.
rows.st: 我們班想在下週六早上去淨灘。【為了這個目的】，每個人都會帶垃圾袋和手套。

rows.d: used to show the reason for the next action
rows.c: 因為這個原因；因此（原因）
rows.s: My little brother is afraid of big dogs. _____ _____ _____, we never walk past the house with the black dog.
rows.st: 我弟弟很怕大狗。【因為這個原因】，我們從來不走過那間養黑狗的房子。

rows.d: used to show a result, often in writing
rows.s: Our school is very far from the MRT station and there are few buses. _____, many students ride bikes to school.
rows.st: 我們學校離捷運站很遠，公車也很少。【因此】，很多學生騎腳踏車上學。

rows.d: used to talk about the beginning, before things changed
rows.c: 起初；一開始（時間順序）（正式用語）
rows.s: _____, I did not like living in the new town because I had no friends. Now I love it and have many classmates to play with.
rows.st: 【一開始】，我不喜歡住在新的小鎮，因為我沒有朋友。現在我很喜歡，也有很多同學可以一起玩。

rows.d: used to show the following step
rows.s: To make a cup of milk tea, first put a tea bag in hot water. _____, add some milk and a little sugar.
rows.st: 要做一杯奶茶，首先把茶包放進熱水裡。【接下來】，加一些牛奶和一點糖。

rows.d: used to show what will happen if you do not do something
rows.s: You should bring an umbrella with you today. _____, you will get wet on the way home because it will rain this afternoon.
rows.st: 你今天應該帶把傘。【否則】，你回家路上會淋濕，因為今天下午會下雨。

rows.d: used to talk about something that happened before now
rows.c: 先前；以前（時間）（正式用語）
rows.s: Mr. Lin teaches math at our school now. _____, he worked as an engineer at a computer company in Hsinchu.
rows.st: 林老師現在在我們學校教數學。【以前】，他在新竹一家電腦公司當工程師。

rows.d: used to show what happened because of the last thing
rows.s: It suddenly started to rain hard during our basketball game. _____ _____, we stopped playing and ran into the classroom.
rows.st: 我們打籃球時突然開始下大雨。【於是】，我們停止比賽，跑進教室。

rows.d: used to show what happened later, after something else
rows.c: 隨後；後來（時間順序）（正式用語）
rows.s: Sam hurt his leg while playing soccer last month. _____, he could not join the school race, so he cheered for his team.
rows.st: 山姆上個月踢足球時傷了腿。【後來】，他沒辦法參加學校的賽跑，所以他為隊友加油。

rows.d: used to show the next thing that happens
rows.s: On Sunday morning, my family went to the park for a walk. _____ we had beef noodles at a small shop nearby.
rows.st: 週日早上，我們全家去公園散步。【然後】我們在附近一家小店吃牛肉麵。

rows.d: used to show a result or conclusion
rows.s: The museum is closed on Mondays for cleaning. _____, we will visit it on Tuesday morning with our teacher instead.
rows.st: 博物館每週一休館打掃。【因此】，我們會改在週二早上和老師一起去參觀。

rows.d: used to show a result, often in writing
rows.s: Anna practiced speaking English with her friends every day. _____, she was not nervous at all in the speech contest.
rows.st: 安娜每天和朋友練習說英文。【因此】，她在演講比賽時一點也不緊張。

rows.d: used to show that two people or things are the same in some way
rows.s: Both of my parents love sports very much. My mother, _____ _____ _____ my father, runs in the park every morning.
rows.st: 我爸媽都非常喜歡運動。我媽媽【和】我爸爸【一樣】，每天早上都在公園跑步。

rows.d: used to say something is more or less true when compared with others
rows.c: 相對地；比較起來（比較）（正式用語）
rows.s: Most of my classmates live far away and take the bus to school. My home is _____ close, so I can walk there in five minutes.
rows.st: 我大部分同學住得很遠，要搭公車上學。我家【相對】近，所以走五分鐘就到了。

rows.d: used to show the opposite side of a comparison
rows.c: 相反地（比較／對比）（正式用語）
rows.s: Some students like to study early in the morning when it is quiet. _____, others study better late at night.
rows.st: 有些學生喜歡在安靜的清晨讀書。【相反地】，有些人在深夜讀書效果比較好。

rows.d: used to show that one thing changes in the same way as another
rows.c: 相應地；同樣地（比較）（正式用語）
rows.s: The number of students at our school grew a lot this year. _____, the school hired more teachers and opened two new classrooms.
rows.st: 今年我們學校的學生人數增加很多。【相應地】，學校聘請了更多老師，還開了兩間新教室。

rows.d: used to put two similar things together
rows.c: 加上；連同（比較）（正式用語）
rows.s: Good sleep helps students remember what they learn. Healthy food, _____ _____ exercise, also helps them do well at school.
rows.st: 充足的睡眠幫助學生記住所學。健康的食物【加上】運動，也能幫助他們在學校表現良好。

rows.d: used to show that two things are similar
rows.s: Plants need water and sunlight to grow tall and strong. _____ _____ _____ _____, children need good food and love to grow well.
rows.st: 植物需要水和陽光才能長得又高又壯。【同樣地】，孩子需要好的食物和愛才能好好長大。

rows.d: used to show that something is the same as the thing before
rows.s: My father always reads the newspaper with his coffee in the morning. _____, my grandfather reads a book with his tea.
rows.st: 我爸爸早上總是邊喝咖啡邊看報紙。【同樣地】，我爺爺邊喝茶邊看書。

rows.d: used to add a similar but stronger point
rows.c: 此外；而且（比較／補充）（正式用語）
rows.s: This new phone is lighter than my old one. _____, its camera is much better, so my photos look clearer.
rows.st: 這支新手機比我的舊手機輕。【而且】，它的相機好很多，所以我的照片看起來更清楚。

rows.d: used to give the first side of a comparison (often with 'on the other hand')
rows.s: _____ _____ _____ _____, living in a big city is very convenient. On the other hand, it is often noisy and crowded.
rows.st: 【一方面】，住在大城市很方便。另一方面，那裡常常又吵又擁擠。

rows.d: used to say two things are almost the same
rows.s: Tom's school bag and my school bag are very _____. They are both blue and have a cartoon cat on the front.
rows.st: 湯姆的書包和我的書包非常【相似】。它們都是藍色的，前面都有一隻卡通貓。

rows.d: used to say one thing is almost the same as another
rows.s: My new phone is _____ _____ my old one. They are both black and small, and they have the same games.
rows.st: 我的新手機【和】我的舊手機【很像】。它們都是黑色的、小小的，而且有一樣的遊戲。

rows.d: used to show that two things are alike
rows.s: Cats like to sleep in warm and quiet places during the day. _____, dogs often look for a soft bed to take a nap.
rows.st: 貓白天喜歡在溫暖安靜的地方睡覺。【同樣地】，狗也常常找柔軟的床午睡。

rows.d: used to show people or things that are joined or the same
rows.s: My best friend Kelly enjoys drawing in her free time. She, _____ _____ her twin sister, won first prize in the art contest.
rows.st: 我最好的朋友凱莉空閒時喜歡畫畫。她【和】她的雙胞胎妹妹【一起】在美術比賽中得到第一名。

rows.d: used to compare two different facts
rows.s: My brother loves to play basketball outside on weekends, _____ I prefer to stay at home and read comic books.
rows.st: 我哥哥週末喜歡在外面打籃球，【而】我比較喜歡待在家看漫畫。

rows.d: used to show two things happening in a similar way at the same time
rows.s: My sister practices the piano in the living room every evening, _____ I practice the violin in my room at the same time.
rows.st: 我姊姊每天晚上在客廳練鋼琴，【而】我同一時間在房間裡練小提琴。

rows.d: used to introduce an opposite opinion
rows.s: Many students think that homework helps them learn better. _____ _____ _____ _____ that too much homework makes students tired and unhappy.
rows.st: 很多學生認為作業能幫助他們學得更好。【另一種看法是】，太多作業會讓學生又累又不開心。

rows.d: used to agree that something bad or different is true
rows.s: Our class trip to the zoo was a lot of fun. _____, it rained in the morning, but the sun came out after lunch.
rows.st: 我們班去動物園的校外教學很好玩。【不可否認地】，早上下了雨，但午餐後太陽就出來了。

rows.d: used to add a small point that makes the first part less strong
rows.c: 雖然；儘管（讓步）（正式用語）
rows.s: After many hard weeks, Tom finally finished his science report, _____ two days after the teacher's deadline.
rows.st: 經過好幾個辛苦的星期，Tom 終於完成了他的自然報告，【雖然】比老師規定的期限晚了兩天。

rows.d: used to give another choice
rows.c: 或者；另一個選擇是（替代）
rows.s: We can take the MRT to the museum on Saturday. _____, we can ride our bikes there if the weather is nice.
rows.st: 星期六我們可以搭捷運去博物館。【或者】，如果天氣好，我們也可以騎腳踏車去。

rows.d: used to show that the second part is surprising after the first part
rows.s: _____ Amy was very tired after school, she still finished all her homework before dinner.
rows.st: 【雖然】Amy 放學後非常累，她還是在晚餐前寫完了所有作業。

rows.d: used to add a surprising or opposite idea
rows.s: Ben studied for the English test for only one hour, _____ _____ he got the highest score in the class.
rows.st: Ben 只花了一個小時準備英文考試，【卻】拿到了全班最高分。

rows.d: used to show the opposite situation
rows.s: In summer, many people in Taiwan buy cold drinks and ice cream. _____, in winter, they buy more hot soup and hot tea.
rows.st: 在夏天，台灣很多人買冷飲和冰淇淋。【相反地】，在冬天，他們會買比較多熱湯和熱茶。

rows.d: used to show that something happens even with a problem
rows.s: _____ the heavy rain, all the students still played soccer on the school field after class.
rows.st: 【儘管】下著大雨，所有學生放學後還是在學校操場踢足球。

rows.d: used to show how one person or thing is not the same as another
rows.s: Most students in my class take the bus to school. _____ _____ them, Lily walks to school every day because she lives near it.
rows.st: 我們班大部分學生搭公車上學。【與】他們【不同】，Lily 每天走路上學，因為她住得很近。

rows.d: used to show a surprising result after a problem
rows.s: The math test was very difficult, and many students did not finish it. _____ _____, Jack got a good score.
rows.st: 數學考試非常難，很多學生都沒寫完。【即使如此】，Jack 還是考得很好。

rows.d: used to show that something happens even with a problem
rows.s: _____ _____ it was very cold this morning, my little brother did not want to wear his jacket to school.
rows.st: 【即使】今天早上很冷，我弟弟還是不想穿外套去上學。

rows.d: used to agree that a point is true before giving a different idea
rows.s: My dad wants to buy the new phone because it has a great camera. _____, it is very expensive, but he thinks it is worth the money.
rows.st: 我爸爸想買那支新手機，因為它的相機很棒。【誠然】，它很貴，但他覺得很值得。

rows.d: used to show a different or opposite idea
rows.s: Mia wanted to go to the night market with her friends on Friday. _____, her mom said she had to stay home and study.
rows.st: Mia 星期五想和朋友去夜市。【然而】，她媽媽說她必須待在家讀書。

rows.d: used to show that two things are very different
rows.c: 相比之下；對照之下（對比）
rows.s: My sister's room is always clean and tidy. _____ _____, my room is full of books, clothes, and toys on the floor.
rows.st: 我姊姊的房間總是乾淨整齊。【相比之下】，我的房間地上堆滿了書、衣服和玩具。

rows.d: used to show what happens in place of another thing
rows.s: We planned to have a picnic in the park on Sunday, but it rained all day. _____, we stayed home and watched a movie together.
rows.st: 我們本來計畫星期天去公園野餐，但下了一整天的雨。【取而代之】，我們待在家一起看電影。

rows.w: it could also be said that
rows.d: used to give another way to look at an idea
rows.s: Many people say that cell phones are bad for students. _____ _____ _____ _____ _____ _____ cell phones help students find information quickly.
rows.st: 很多人說手機對學生不好。【也可以說】，手機能幫助學生很快找到資料。

rows.d: used to show that something still happens after a problem
rows.c: 儘管如此；然而（讓步）（正式用語）
rows.s: The mountain path was long and steep. _____, all the students kept walking and reached the top before noon.
rows.st: 山路又長又陡。【儘管如此】，所有學生都繼續走，並在中午前到達山頂。

rows.d: used to show that something happens even with a problem
rows.s: _____ the long bus ride, all the students enjoyed their school trip to Kenting very much.
rows.st: 【儘管】坐了很久的公車，所有學生都非常喜歡這次去墾丁的校外教學。

rows.d: used to show that something still happens after a problem
rows.c: 儘管如此（讓步）（正式用語）
rows.s: Grandpa is eighty years old and has a bad leg. _____, he takes a walk in the park every morning.
rows.st: 爺爺八十歲了，腿也不好。【儘管如此】，他每天早上都會去公園散步。

rows.d: used to say the opposite is true
rows.s: My brother is not lazy at all. _____ _____ _____, he gets up at six every morning to clean the house and walk the dog.
rows.st: 我哥哥一點都不懶惰。【正好相反】，他每天早上六點起床打掃家裡和遛狗。

rows.d: used to give the first side of an idea
rows.s: _____ _____ _____ _____, living in a big city is convenient because there are many stores and MRT stations. On the other hand, it is often noisy and crowded.
rows.st: 【一方面】，住在大城市很方便，因為有很多商店和捷運站。另一方面，那裡常常又吵又擠。

rows.d: used to give the other side of an idea
rows.s: Living in the countryside is quiet, and the air is fresh. _____ _____ _____ _____, there are not many stores, and the buses do not come often.
rows.st: 住在鄉下很安靜，空氣也很新鮮。【另一方面】，那裡商店不多，公車也不常來。

rows.d: used to show what will happen if you do not do something
rows.s: You should bring an umbrella to school today. _____, you will get wet when it rains this afternoon.
rows.st: 你今天應該帶雨傘去學校。【否則】，下午下雨時你會淋濕。

rows.d: used to give the true or opposite idea after a negative
rows.s: Lisa did not feel sad when she lost the game. _____, she felt happy because she had tried her best.
rows.st: Lisa 輸了比賽並不難過。【反而】，她很開心，因為她已經盡力了。

rows.d: used to show that something does not change a plan or action
rows.s: Our basketball team practices every afternoon. We practice outside _____ _____ the weather, even on very hot or rainy days.
rows.st: 我們籃球隊每天下午都練球。【不管】天氣如何，我們都在戶外練習，即使是很熱或下雨的日子。

rows.d: used to show that something continues after a problem
rows.s: The math problem was very hard, and I asked my teacher for help twice. I _____ could not find the right answer.
rows.st: 這題數學很難，我問了老師兩次。我【還是】找不到正確答案。

rows.d: used to show that two people or things are different
rows.s: _____ his older brother, who loves sports, Kevin likes to stay home and read books or draw pictures.
rows.st: 【不像】熱愛運動的哥哥，Kevin 喜歡待在家看書或畫畫。

rows.d: used to compare two different facts
rows.s: My father likes to drink hot coffee every morning, _____ my mother always drinks a glass of cold milk.
rows.st: 我爸爸每天早上喜歡喝熱咖啡，【而】我媽媽總是喝一杯冰牛奶。

rows.d: used to show the most important point
rows.s: A good student should be kind and work hard. _____ _____, he or she should always be honest with teachers and friends.
rows.st: 好學生應該善良又努力。【最重要的是】，他或她應該永遠對老師和朋友誠實。

rows.d: used to point out one thing more than others
rows.s: My family loves all kinds of fruit in summer. My little brother _____ likes watermelon, and he eats it every day.
rows.st: 我們家夏天喜歡吃各種水果。我弟弟【尤其】喜歡西瓜，他每天都吃。

rows.d: used to add a stronger, true point
rows.s: Jenny is not just good at math. _____ _____, she got the highest score in our whole school last month.
rows.st: Jenny 不只是數學好而已。【事實上】，她上個月拿到全校最高分。

rows.d: used to point out one special person or thing
rows.s: Everyone in my class enjoyed the school trip to the zoo. Amy, _____ _____, loved watching the pandas eat bamboo for an hour.
rows.st: 我們班每個人都很喜歡去動物園的校外教學。【尤其是】Amy，她看貓熊吃竹子看了一個小時。

rows.d: used to say that something is really true
rows.c: 確實；的確（強調）（正式用語）
rows.s: The teacher said the test would be hard. It was _____ very difficult, and many students could not finish it on time.
rows.st: 老師說這次考試會很難。考試【的確】非常難，很多學生沒辦法準時寫完。

rows.d: used to point out one thing more than others
rows.s: I like all of my classes this year. I am _____ interested in science because we do fun experiments every week.
rows.st: 我喜歡今年所有的課。我【特別】對自然課有興趣，因為我們每週都做有趣的實驗。

rows.d: used to give an example
rows.s: There are many ways to save water at home. _____ _____ _____, you can turn off the tap while you brush your teeth.
rows.st: 在家有很多省水的方法。【舉例來說】，你可以在刷牙時把水龍頭關掉。

rows.d: used to give an example that shows an idea
rows.c: 舉例說明（舉例）（正式用語）
rows.s: Exercise can help you feel happier. _____ _____ _____, my father always smiles more after he goes jogging in the park.
rows.st: 運動可以讓你更快樂。【舉例說明】，我爸爸每次去公園慢跑後都笑得更多。

rows.d: used to show the main example or reason
rows.c: 主要地（舉例／說明重點）（正式用語）
rows.s: Students in our reading club read many kinds of books. They _____ read comic books and short stories, but sometimes they read science books too.
rows.st: 我們讀書社的學生讀很多種書。他們【主要】讀漫畫和短篇故事，但有時候也讀科學書。

rows.d: used to give an example
rows.s: Taipei has many great places to visit. _____ _____, you can go to Taipei 101 or walk around the night markets.
rows.st: 台北有很多很棒的地方可以去。【例如】，你可以去台北101，或是逛逛夜市。

rows.d: used to give an example
rows.s: Some animals sleep during the day. _____ _____, owls sleep in the daytime and look for food at night.
rows.st: 有些動物在白天睡覺。【例如】，貓頭鷹白天睡覺，晚上才出來找食物。

rows.d: used to show an idea with an example
rows.c: 以…為例說明（舉例）（正式用語）
rows.s: Kindness can change someone's day, as _____ _____ the way Tom helped a lost little girl find her mother at the station.
rows.st: 善意可以改變一個人的一天，【就像】Tom 在車站幫一個迷路的小女孩找到媽媽【所說明的那樣】。

rows.d: used to give one special example
rows.s: Many fruits are good for your health. Oranges, _____ _____, have a lot of vitamin C and can help you stay healthy.
rows.st: 很多水果對健康很好。【特別是】柳橙，含有很多維他命C，可以幫助你保持健康。

rows.d: used to talk about one situation or example
rows.c: 在這種情況下（舉例／說明情況）
rows.s: Sometimes it rains heavily during PE class. _____ _____ _____, the students play table tennis in the gym instead of running outside.
rows.st: 有時候體育課會下大雨。【在這種情況下】，學生們會在體育館打桌球，而不是在外面跑步。

rows.d: used to give examples that are part of a group
rows.s: Mom bought a lot of food for the birthday party, _____ cake, fried chicken, and three big bottles of juice.
rows.st: 媽媽為生日派對買了很多食物，【包括】蛋糕、炸雞和三大瓶果汁。

rows.d: used to show a big and clear change
rows.c: 明顯地（說明程度）（正式用語）
rows.s: Lily practiced speaking English every night for three months. Her speaking became _____ better, and her teacher was very surprised.
rows.st: Lily 每天晚上練習說英文，練了三個月。她的口說【明顯地】進步了，老師非常驚訝。

rows.d: used to name the exact people or things
rows.c: 也就是；即（舉例說明）（正式用語）
rows.s: Two students from our class won prizes in the English speech contest, _____ Kevin and Mary.
rows.st: 我們班有兩位同學在英語演講比賽得獎，【也就是】Kevin 和 Mary。

rows.d: used to point out an important example
rows.c: 尤其是；特別是（舉例）（正式用語）
rows.s: Many important guests came to our school's birthday party, _____ the mayor of Taipei, who gave a short speech.
rows.st: 很多重要的來賓來參加我們學校的校慶，【尤其是】台北市長，他還做了簡短的致詞。

rows.d: used to talk about one special time
rows.c: 這一次（舉例說明特定時候）
rows.s: Dad usually cooks dinner for our family on Sundays. _____ _____ _____, Mom made dinner because Dad was sick in bed.
rows.st: 爸爸通常在星期天幫全家煮晚餐。【這一次】，因為爸爸生病躺在床上，所以媽媽煮了晚餐。

rows.d: used to give more exact details
rows.s: The teacher asked us to bring something for art class. _____, she wanted us to bring old newspapers and some glue.
rows.st: 老師要我們帶東西來上美術課。【具體來說】，她要我們帶舊報紙和一些膠水。

rows.d: used to give examples
rows.s: Our school has many after-school clubs, _____ _____ the dance club, the chess club, and the robot club.
rows.st: 我們學校有很多課後社團，【像是】舞蹈社、西洋棋社和機器人社。

rows.d: used to show how something works with an example
rows.c: 為了示範；為了證明（舉例說明）
rows.s: Our science teacher wanted to show us that air takes up space. _____ _____, she put an empty cup upside down into a bowl of water.
rows.st: 我們的自然老師想讓我們知道空氣會佔空間。【為了示範】，她把一個空杯子倒過來放進一碗水裡。

rows.d: used to give an example that explains an idea
rows.s: Small actions can help protect the earth. _____ _____, if every student brings a water bottle, our school can use thousands fewer plastic cups each year.
rows.st: 小小的行動就能幫忙保護地球。【舉例來說明】，如果每個學生都帶水壺，我們學校每年就能少用好幾千個塑膠杯。

rows.d: used to give an important reason to remember
rows.s: You should not be too angry with your little sister. _____ _____, she is only five years old and did not mean to break your toy.
rows.st: 你不應該對妹妹太生氣。【畢竟】，她才五歲，而且她不是故意弄壞你的玩具的。

rows.d: used to give a final opinion after thinking about everything
rows.s: The hotel was small and a little old. _____ _____ _____, we still had a great family trip because the beach was beautiful.
rows.st: 那間飯店又小又有點舊。【整體考量下】，我們全家的旅行還是很棒，因為海灘很美。

rows.d: used to add another side of an idea
rows.c: 同時；但另一方面（補充／延伸）
rows.s: Playing video games can be fun and relaxing. _____ _____ _____ _____, playing for too long can hurt your eyes and your grades.
rows.st: 打電動可以很好玩又放鬆。【同時】，玩太久會傷害你的眼睛和成績。

rows.d: used to show that something is easy to see or understand
rows.s: Ben's face turned red, and he could not look at the teacher. _____, he had forgotten to do his homework again.
rows.st: Ben 的臉變紅了，而且他不敢看老師。【顯然】，他又忘記寫功課了。

rows.d: used to say something in a few words
rows.s: The movie was very long, but the story was simple. _____ _____, a brave boy saves his town from a terrible dragon.
rows.st: 那部電影很長，但故事很簡單。【簡言之】，一個勇敢的男孩從可怕的龍手中救了他的小鎮。

rows.d: used to give the most basic or main idea
rows.c: 本質上；基本上（總結重點）（正式用語）
rows.s: The teacher talked about many rules for the school trip. _____ _____, she wanted us to stay safe and stay with our group.
rows.st: 老師講了很多校外教學的規定。【基本上】，她希望我們注意安全，並且跟著自己的小組。

rows.d: used to give more true information about an idea
rows.s: At first, I thought the new student was shy. _____ _____, she is very friendly and has already made many friends in our class.
rows.st: 一開始我以為新同學很害羞。【事實上】，她非常友善，而且已經在我們班交到很多朋友了。

rows.d: used to say the same idea in another way
rows.s: Our teacher said, "Your homework must be on my desk before eight tomorrow morning." _____ _____ _____, we cannot be late with our homework.
rows.st: 老師說：「你們的作業明天早上八點前一定要放在我桌上。」【換句話說】，我們交作業不能遲到。

rows.d: used to give a short summary
rows.s: We missed the bus, it started to rain, and I lost my umbrella. _____ _____, it was a really bad morning for me.
rows.st: 我們錯過了公車，又開始下雨，我還弄丟了雨傘。【總之】，那是我很糟的一個早上。

rows.d: used to show that something said before is really true
rows.c: 確實；的確（延伸證實）（正式用語）
rows.s: Grandma said the night market would be crowded on Saturday. _____, there were so many people that we could hardly walk.
rows.st: 奶奶說星期六夜市會很擠。【的確】，人多到我們幾乎走不動。

rows.d: used to say what looks true from what we see
rows.s: The sky is getting dark, and the wind is very strong. _____ _____ that a big storm is coming to our city tonight.
rows.st: 天空越來越暗，風也很大。【看來】今晚會有一場大暴風雨來到我們的城市。

rows.d: used to explain exactly what you mean
rows.c: 也就是（進一步說明）（正式用語）
rows.s: There is one important thing you must remember before every test, _____ to write your name on the answer sheet.
rows.st: 每次考試前有一件重要的事你一定要記得，【也就是】在答案卷上寫上你的名字。

rows.d: used to show that something is expected
rows.c: 自然地；理所當然（延伸結果）
rows.s: Kevin stayed up late playing games the night before the test. _____, he felt very tired and could not focus in class.
rows.st: Kevin 考試前一晚熬夜打電動。【理所當然】，他覺得很累，上課也無法專心。

rows.d: used to show that something is easy to expect
rows.s: Tim worked hard on his science project for many weeks. _____ _____, he was very happy when he won first prize.
rows.st: Tim 花了好幾個星期認真做他的科展作品。【當然】，他得到第一名時非常開心。

rows.d: used to give a general opinion
rows.s: There were a few small problems during our class trip. _____ _____ _____, everyone had a good time and wanted to go again.
rows.st: 我們的班級旅行有一些小問題。【整體來說】，大家都玩得很開心，還想再去一次。

rows.d: used to explain something more exactly
rows.s: Please finish your science report before the weekend, _____ _____, by Friday afternoon at the latest.
rows.st: 請在週末前完成你的自然報告，【也就是說】，最晚星期五下午要完成。

rows.d: used to explain an idea in another way
rows.c: 也就是說（重新說明）（正式用語）
rows.s: My cousin has been a vegetarian for five years. _____ _____ _____ _____, he does not eat any meat or fish at all.
rows.st: 我表哥吃素已經五年了。【也就是說】，他完全不吃任何肉或魚。

rows.d: used to agree that one point is true before adding another
rows.c: 誠然；的確（讓步延伸）（正式用語）
rows.s: Many students complain about our school lunch. _____ _____ _____, it is not always delicious, but it is healthy and cheap.
rows.st: 很多學生抱怨我們學校的午餐。【的確】，它不一定都好吃，但它很健康又便宜。

rows.d: used to say the same idea in another way
rows.s: Mr. Lin said, "Do not judge a book by its cover." _____ _____ _____ _____, we should not decide what people are like just by their looks.
rows.st: 林老師說：「不要以貌取書。」【換個說法】，我們不應該只看外表就決定一個人是怎樣的人。

rows.d: used to show that one thing happens later than another
rows.s: Mom says we can watch TV for one hour _____ we finish our homework and clean our rooms.
rows.st: 媽媽說我們【在】寫完功課、打掃完房間【之後】，可以看一個小時的電視。

rows.d: used to talk about a time in the past
rows.s: My family lived in a small village in Nantou ten years ago. _____ _____ _____, there was no convenience store near our house.
rows.st: 十年前我們家住在南投的一個小村莊。【那時候】，我們家附近沒有便利商店。

rows.d: used to show that one thing happens earlier than another
rows.s: My little brother always brushes his teeth and reads a short story _____ he goes to bed at night.
rows.st: 我弟弟晚上【睡覺之前】總是會刷牙，並讀一個短篇故事。

rows.d: used to show that two things happen at the same time
rows.c: 同時（時間順序）（正式用語）
rows.s: Mia is taking piano lessons every Saturday morning this year. _____, she is also learning to swim at the sports center.
rows.st: Mia 今年每個星期六早上都在上鋼琴課。【同時】，她也在運動中心學游泳。

rows.d: used to show the last step or event
rows.s: First, we cleaned the classroom, and then we put up the posters. _____, we hung colorful balloons for the Christmas party.
rows.st: 首先，我們打掃了教室，接著貼上海報。【最後】，我們為聖誕派對掛上彩色氣球。

rows.d: used to show what comes next
rows.s: Our school sports day began with a short speech by the principal, _____ _____ a relay race between all the classes.
rows.st: 我們學校的運動會以校長的簡短致詞開始，【接著是】各班之間的大隊接力。

rows.d: used to list steps in order
rows.s: There are three easy steps to make a cup of tea. _____, boil some water. Second, put a tea bag in a cup. Third, pour in the hot water.
rows.st: 泡一杯茶有三個簡單的步驟。【第一】，把水煮開。第二，把茶包放進杯子。第三，倒入熱水。

rows.d: used to talk about the first step or the beginning
rows.s: _____, I thought our new math teacher was very strict. Later, I found out that she was really kind and funny.
rows.st: 【起初】我以為我們的新數學老師很嚴格。後來我發現她其實非常親切又有趣。

rows.d: used to show the following step
rows.s: First, wash the rice and put it in the pot. _____, add two cups of water and turn on the rice cooker.
rows.st: 首先，把米洗好放進鍋子裡。【接著】，加兩杯水，然後打開電鍋。

rows.d: used to talk about something that happened before
rows.s: Mr. Lin teaches English at our school now. _____, he worked as a tour guide in Tainan for five years.
rows.st: 林老師現在在我們學校教英文。【先前】，他在台南當了五年的導遊。

rows.d: used to show what happened after something
rows.c: 隨後；後來（順序）（正式用語）
rows.s: Amy lost her bike near the park on Monday. _____, a kind old man found it and took it to the police station.
rows.st: 艾美星期一在公園附近弄丟了腳踏車。【隨後】，一位好心的老先生找到它，並把它送到警察局。

rows.d: used to show the next thing that happens
rows.s: We finished our homework right after dinner. _____, we watched a funny movie together in the living room.
rows.st: 我們晚餐後馬上寫完功課。【然後】，我們一起在客廳看了一部好笑的電影。

rows.d: used to give a reason that people should remember
rows.s: Don't be too angry with Tom about the broken cup. _____ _____, he is only seven years old.
rows.st: 別因為打破杯子的事對湯姆太生氣。【畢竟】，他才七歲而已。

rows.d: used to show a result
rows.s: Jenny studied hard for the English test every night. _____ _____ _____, she got the highest score in her class.
rows.st: 珍妮每天晚上都認真準備英文考試。【結果】，她拿到了全班最高分。

rows.d: used to say the main idea in a few words
rows.s: Our class trip had good food, fun games, and beautiful views. _____, it was the best day of the school year.
rows.st: 我們的校外教學有好吃的食物、好玩的遊戲和美麗的風景。【簡單來說】，那是這學年最棒的一天。

rows.d: used to give a general idea of the whole thing
rows.s: Some students were late, and a few forgot their books. _____ _____ _____, the first week of school went well.
rows.st: 有些學生遲到，還有幾個人忘了帶書。【大體上】，開學第一週還算順利。

rows.d: used to show a result
rows.s: It rained very heavily all morning. _____, the school sports day was moved to next Friday.
rows.st: 整個早上都下著大雨。【因此】，學校運動會延到下星期五舉行。

rows.d: used to give the last point or to end a talk
rows.s: We have talked about healthy food, enough sleep, and exercise. _____, remember that a happy mind is also important for good health.
rows.st: 我們已經談過健康飲食、充足睡眠和運動。【最後】，請記得快樂的心情對健康也很重要。

rows.d: used to show a result
rows.s: The school bus broke down on the way to school this morning. _____, many students were late for the first class.
rows.st: 今天早上校車在上學途中故障了。【因此】，很多學生第一節課都遲到了。

rows.d: used to say that something is true no matter what happens
rows.s: I'm not sure if it will rain tomorrow afternoon. _____ _____ _____, you should bring an umbrella just to be safe.
rows.st: 我不確定明天下午會不會下雨。【無論如何】，你都應該帶把傘以防萬一。

rows.d: used to say that something is true no matter what happens
rows.c: 無論如何（總結）（正式用語）
rows.s: We may go to the beach or the zoo on Sunday. _____ _____ _____, we will have a fun day together as a family.
rows.st: 星期天我們可能去海邊或動物園。【無論如何】，我們全家都會一起度過愉快的一天。

rows.d: used to say the main idea in a few words
rows.s: The movie had great music, funny actors, and an exciting story. _____ _____, it was worth the money.
rows.st: 那部電影有很棒的音樂、有趣的演員和刺激的故事。【簡言之】，它值回票價。

rows.d: used to start the last part or main idea
rows.s: Reading helps us learn new words, relax, and understand the world. _____ _____, everyone should read for at least twenty minutes every day.
rows.st: 閱讀能幫助我們學新單字、放鬆心情，並了解這個世界。【總之】，每個人每天都應該至少閱讀二十分鐘。

rows.d: used to say the main idea in a few words
rows.s: Tim forgot his homework, missed the bus, and lost his wallet. _____ _____, he had a really bad day.
rows.st: 提姆忘了帶作業、錯過公車，還弄丟了錢包。【簡而言之】，他過了很糟的一天。

rows.d: used to say the same idea in another, easier way
rows.s: Our teacher said this quiz will not count toward our final grade. _____ _____ _____, we do not need to worry about it too much.
rows.st: 老師說這次小考不會算進期末成績。【換句話說】，我們不需要太擔心它。

rows.d: used to give a short review of the main points
rows.s: Exercise makes our bodies strong and helps us sleep better at night. _____ _____, it is good for both our bodies and our minds.
rows.st: 運動讓我們身體強壯，也幫助我們晚上睡得更好。【總結來說】，它對我們的身體和心靈都有好處。

rows.d: used to give a general opinion about everything
rows.s: The food at the night market was a little expensive. _____ _____ _____, we enjoyed our evening there very much.
rows.st: 夜市的食物有點貴。【整體而言】，我們在那裡度過了非常愉快的夜晚。

rows.d: used to give a general opinion about everything
rows.s: The hotel room was small, but it was clean and the staff were friendly. _____, we had a pleasant stay in Hualien.
rows.st: 飯店房間很小，但很乾淨，員工也很友善。【整體來說】，我們在花蓮住得很愉快。

rows.d: used to show a result
rows.s: Our family wants to save money for a trip to Japan. _____, we eat at home more often instead of going to restaurants.
rows.st: 我們家想存錢去日本旅行。【因此】，我們比較常在家吃飯，而不是去餐廳。

rows.d: used to show a result
rows.c: 因此；所以（結果）（正式用語）
rows.s: Kevin practiced the piano for two hours every day. _____, he played beautifully at the school concert.
rows.st: 凱文每天練兩個小時的鋼琴。【因此】，他在學校音樂會上彈得非常好。

rows.d: used to start the last part or main idea
rows.s: Cell phones are useful, but they can also hurt our eyes and sleep. _____ _____, we should use them carefully and not too often.
rows.st: 手機很有用，但也可能傷害我們的眼睛和睡眠。【總結來說】，我們應該小心使用，而且不要太常用。

rows.d: used to give a short review of the main points
rows.s: We need more trash cans, more trees, and less noise in our park. _____ _____ _____, we want a cleaner and quieter park for everyone.
rows.st: 我們的公園需要更多垃圾桶、更多樹木和更少噪音。【總而言之】，我們希望大家有一個更乾淨、更安靜的公園。

rows.d: used to give a short review of the main points
rows.s: Dogs are friendly, smart, and good at protecting the house. _____ _____, they make great pets for many families.
rows.st: 狗狗友善、聰明，又很會看家。【總結】，牠們是許多家庭很棒的寵物。

rows.d: used to show the final result after a long time
rows.s: The students talked about many places for the class trip for a week. _____, they decided to visit the science museum in Taichung.
rows.st: 學生們花了一個星期討論校外教學要去哪些地方。【最終】，他們決定去參觀台中的科學博物館。

rows.d: used to show that one thing happens later than another
rows.s: My little brother always brushes his teeth _____ he eats breakfast. Then he puts on his school uniform and leaves home.
rows.st: 我弟弟總是【在】吃完早餐【之後】刷牙。然後他會穿上制服出門。

rows.d: used to show something happens later
rows.s: We cleaned the classroom together on Friday afternoon. _____, our teacher gave everyone a small piece of cake.
rows.st: 星期五下午我們一起打掃教室。【之後】，老師給了每個人一小塊蛋糕。

rows.d: used to say that something happens after a long time
rows.c: 終於；最後（時間）（正式用語）
rows.s: We waited for the bus in the rain for almost an hour. _____ _____, it arrived, and we all got on quickly.
rows.st: 我們在雨中等公車等了將近一個小時。【終於】，公車來了，我們全都趕快上車。

rows.d: used to talk about one exact moment
rows.s: The game was tied, and there was only one minute left. _____ _____ _____, Jason kicked the ball into the goal.
rows.st: 比賽打成平手，只剩下一分鐘。【就在那時】，傑森把球踢進了球門。

rows.d: used to talk about a time in the past or now
rows.s: My grandparents moved to Taipei in 1980. _____ _____ _____, there was no MRT, so they took the bus everywhere.
rows.st: 我的祖父母在1980年搬到台北。【當時】還沒有捷運，所以他們去哪裡都搭公車。

rows.d: used to talk about now
rows.s: Our school library is closed for repairs this month. _____ _____, students can borrow books from the classroom reading corner.
rows.st: 我們學校的圖書館這個月整修中暫停開放。【目前】，學生可以向教室裡的閱讀角借書。

rows.d: used to show two things happen together
rows.s: My mom was cooking dinner in the kitchen. _____ _____ _____ _____, my dad was helping my sister with her homework.
rows.st: 媽媽在廚房煮晚餐。【同時】，爸爸正在幫妹妹寫功課。

rows.d: used to show that one thing happens earlier than another
rows.s: Please wash your hands carefully _____ you eat lunch. There are many germs on the desks and door handles.
rows.st: 吃午餐【之前】請仔細洗手。桌子和門把上有很多細菌。

rows.d: used to talk about now
rows.s: Ms. Wang is a very busy science teacher. _____, she is teaching three classes and helping with the school science fair.
rows.st: 王老師是一位非常忙碌的自然老師。【目前】，她正在教三個班，還在幫忙學校的科展。

rows.d: used to show something happens in a period of time
rows.s: Many students like to play basketball on the playground _____ the lunch break. Others prefer to read or take a nap.
rows.st: 很多學生喜歡【在】午休時間【期間】到操場打籃球。其他人則比較喜歡看書或午睡。

rows.d: used to talk about a time before now
rows.s: I am not hungry for dinner right now. _____, I ate a big bowl of beef noodles with my friends after school.
rows.st: 我現在不餓，吃不下晚餐。【稍早】，我放學後和朋友吃了一大碗牛肉麵。

rows.d: used to say something happens after a long time
rows.s: We walked up the mountain for three long hours. _____, we reached the top and saw the beautiful view.
rows.st: 我們爬了整整三個小時的山。【終於】，我們抵達山頂，看到了美麗的風景。

rows.d: used to talk about how something was in the past
rows.c: 以前；從前（時間）（正式用語）
rows.s: This coffee shop is very popular with students now. _____, it was a small bookstore owned by an old couple.
rows.st: 這間咖啡店現在很受學生歡迎。【以前】，它是一對老夫婦開的小書店。

rows.d: used to say something happens right away
rows.s: The fire alarm rang loudly in the middle of class. _____, all the students walked out of the building in a line.
rows.st: 上課到一半，火災警報大聲響起。【立刻】，所有學生排成一列走出大樓。

rows.d: used to talk about a time after now
rows.s: Lisa loves animals and often takes care of stray cats. _____ _____ _____, she hopes to become a vet and help sick pets.
rows.st: 麗莎很愛動物，常常照顧流浪貓。【將來】，她希望成為獸醫，幫助生病的寵物。

rows.d: used to talk about the time while you wait for something
rows.s: Dinner will be ready in about twenty minutes. _____ _____ _____, you can set the table and wash your hands.
rows.st: 晚餐大約再二十分鐘就好了。【在這期間】，你可以擺好餐具並去洗手。

rows.d: used to talk about a time before now
rows.s: Most people use smartphones to take photos today. _____ _____ _____, people used film cameras and waited days to see their pictures.
rows.st: 現在大多數人用智慧型手機拍照。【過去】，人們用底片相機，還要等好幾天才能看到照片。

rows.d: used to talk about the situation at the beginning
rows.s: _____, only ten students joined the school English club. Now, more than forty students come to the meetings every week.
rows.st: 【起初】，只有十個學生參加學校的英文社。現在，每週有超過四十個學生來參加聚會。

rows.d: used to talk about a time after now or after something
rows.s: I can't play video games with you right now because I have homework. _____, after I finish it, we can play together.
rows.st: 我現在不能和你玩電動，因為我還有功課。【之後】，等我寫完，我們就可以一起玩。

rows.d: used to show two things happen at the same time
rows.s: Dad was washing the car in front of the house. _____, my brother and I were cleaning our bedrooms upstairs.
rows.st: 爸爸在房子前面洗車。【同時】，我和哥哥在樓上打掃我們的房間。

rows.d: used to talk about the present time
rows.s: Ten years ago, my town had only one small convenience store. _____, there are five stores and a big supermarket.
rows.st: 十年前，我們鎮上只有一家小便利商店。【現在】，有五家便利商店和一間大型超市。

rows.d: used to say something will happen soon
rows.c: 不久；很快（時間）（正式用語）
rows.s: The doctor is busy with another patient right now. She will see you _____, so please take a seat and wait.
rows.st: 醫生現在正在看另一位病人。她【很快】就會為你看診，所以請先坐下等候。

rows.d: used to talk about a time before now
rows.s: Our school has a new computer room this year. _____, all the classes had to share one small, old computer room.
rows.st: 我們學校今年有了新的電腦教室。【先前】，所有班級都得共用一間又小又舊的電腦教室。

rows.d: used to mean 'before'
rows.s: Students must turn off their phones _____ _____ entering the exam room. Phones that ring will cause problems for everyone.
rows.st: 學生【在】進入考場【之前】必須關掉手機。響起的手機會影響到每個人。

rows.d: used to talk about something that happened not long ago
rows.s: My aunt has been very busy these days. _____, she started a small bakery and sells bread to her neighbors every morning.
rows.st: 我阿姨這陣子非常忙。【最近】，她開了一間小麵包店，每天早上賣麵包給鄰居。

rows.d: used to say something will happen soon
rows.s: The train is a little late this morning. It will arrive _____, so please stand behind the yellow line.
rows.st: 今天早上火車有點誤點。它【很快】就會到站，所以請站在黃線後面。

rows.d: used to show two things happen at exactly the same time
rows.s: The two runners ran very fast and crossed the finish line _____. The judges could not decide who won the race.
rows.st: 兩位跑者跑得非常快，【同時】衝過終點線。裁判無法決定誰贏了比賽。

rows.d: used to say something will happen in a short time
rows.s: It is getting dark, and the clouds are very black. It will _____ start to rain, so let's go home now.
rows.st: 天色漸漸暗了，雲也很黑。【很快】就要下雨了，所以我們現在回家吧。

rows.d: used to show something happened after an earlier event
rows.c: 後來；隨後（時間）（正式用語）
rows.s: Ben hurt his leg badly during basketball practice. He _____ missed three games and had to watch from the bench.
rows.st: 班在籃球練習時傷了腿。他【後來】錯過了三場比賽，只能坐在板凳上觀看。

rows.d: used to mean 'at that time in the past'
rows.s: My family lived in a small village in Pingtung in 2015. _____, I was only five and didn't know any English at all.
rows.st: 2015年我們家住在屏東的一個小村莊。【那時】，我才五歲，完全不會英文。

rows.d: used to mean 'after that time'
rows.c: 此後；從那之後（時間）（正式用語）
rows.s: Grandpa stopped drinking soda when he turned sixty. _____, he felt much healthier and walked in the park every morning.
rows.st: 爺爺六十歲時戒掉了汽水。【從那之後】，他覺得身體健康多了，每天早上都去公園散步。

mcq.q: To stay healthy, eat more vegetables and go to bed early. ______, exercise every day.
mcq.st: 為了保持健康，要多吃蔬菜、早點睡覺。最重要的是，要每天運動。

mcq.q: Our school has a big library. ______, it has a new swimming pool.
mcq.st: 我們學校有一間大圖書館。此外，它還有一座新的游泳池。

mcq.q: Some animals can live without water for a long time. ______, a camel can walk in the desert for days without drinking.
mcq.st: 有些動物可以很長一段時間不喝水。舉例來說，駱駝可以在沙漠中走好幾天都不喝水。

mcq.q: Mike practiced basketball every day for five years. ______, he became a famous player.
mcq.st: 麥克五年來每天練習籃球。最後，他成為一位有名的球員。

mcq.q: Mr. Wang said the test would be hard. ______, it was the hardest test of the year.
mcq.st: 王老師說這次考試會很難。的確，那是今年最難的一次考試。

mcq.q: Many people think Tim is shy. ______, he is the most talkative boy in our class.
mcq.st: 很多人認為提姆很害羞。事實上，他是我們班上話最多的男生。

mcq.q: The concert started with a piano solo, ______ a song by the school choir.
mcq.st: 音樂會以鋼琴獨奏開場，接著是學校合唱團演唱的一首歌。

mcq.q: Amy's English has ______ improved since she moved to London.
mcq.st: 自從艾咪搬到倫敦以後，她的英文明顯進步了。

mcq.q: Today I talked about three ways to save water. ______, let's all try to use less water every day.
mcq.st: 今天我談了三種節約用水的方法。總結來說，讓我們每天都試著少用一點水。

mcq.q: Your new bike is ______ mine. They are both red and very fast.
mcq.st: 你的新腳踏車和我的很像。它們都是紅色的，而且騎起來都很快。

mcq.q: It snowed heavily last night. ______, all the schools were closed today.
mcq.st: 昨晚下了大雪。結果，今天所有的學校都停課了。

mcq.q: My brother loves sports, ______ I enjoy reading books.
mcq.st: 我哥哥喜歡運動，而我喜歡看書。

mcq.q: Lily saw a snake for the first time in her life. ______, she screamed and ran away.
mcq.st: 莉莉這輩子第一次看到蛇。她立刻尖叫著跑走了。

mcq.q: You can take the bus to the zoo. ______, you can ride a bike there.
mcq.st: 你可以搭公車去動物園。或者，你也可以騎腳踏車去那裡。

mcq.q: Grandpa got sick from smoking in 2015. ______, he never smoked again.
mcq.st: 爺爺在2015年因為抽菸而生病。從那之後，他再也沒有抽過菸。

mcq.q: The two runners crossed the finish line ______, so nobody knew who won.
mcq.st: 那兩位跑者同時衝過終點線，所以沒有人知道誰贏了。

mcq.q: Jenny can speak Japanese ______ English.
mcq.st: 珍妮會說日文，也會說英文。

mcq.q: The teacher talked about the class rules for an hour. ______, she wants us to be kind and safe.
mcq.st: 老師花了一個小時講班規。基本上，她希望我們友善待人並注意安全。

mcq.q: ______ I finish my homework, I will play basketball with my friends.
mcq.st: 在我寫完功課之後，我會和朋友去打籃球。

mcq.q: We need some fruit for the party. ______, we need two watermelons and ten apples.
mcq.st: 派對需要一些水果。具體來說，我們需要兩顆西瓜和十顆蘋果。

mcq.q: Kate forgot to bring her umbrella. ______, she got wet in the rain.
mcq.st: 凱特忘了帶雨傘。因此，她被雨淋濕了。

mcq.q: Our school trip starts with a visit to the museum, ______ lunch at a small restaurant.
mcq.st: 我們的校外教學先參觀博物館，接著在一間小餐廳吃午餐。

mcq.q: The hotel was clean, the food was good, and the workers were kind. ______, it was a great hotel.
mcq.st: 那間飯店很乾淨，食物很好吃，員工也很親切。整體來說，那是一間很棒的飯店。

mcq.q: We waited for the bus for more than an hour. ______, it came.
mcq.st: 我們等公車等了一個多小時。終於，公車來了。

mcq.q: Peter is allergic to milk. ______, he never eats ice cream.
mcq.st: 彼得對牛奶過敏。因此，他從來不吃冰淇淋。

mcq.q: That's all for today's class. ______, we learned three things: colors, animals, and numbers.
mcq.st: 今天的課就到這裡。總結來說，我們學了三件事：顏色、動物和數字。

mcq.q: Tom's sister loves vegetables. ______ her, Tom never eats them.
mcq.st: 湯姆的姊姊很愛吃蔬菜。跟她不一樣，湯姆從來不吃蔬菜。

mcq.q: Cats like to sleep all day, ______ dogs like to go out and play.
o: it could also be said that
mcq.st: 貓喜歡整天睡覺，而狗喜歡出去玩。

mcq.q: Don't be too hard on Jimmy. ______, he is only five years old.
mcq.st: 不要對吉米太嚴格。畢竟，他才五歲而已。

mcq.q: Sam lost his key. ______, he could not open the door of his house.
mcq.st: 山姆弄丟了鑰匙。因此，他打不開家裡的門。

mcq.q: This building was ______ a school, but now it is a library.
mcq.st: 這棟建築以前是一所學校，但現在是一間圖書館。

mcq.q: The bridge was broken. ______, we had to take a boat across the river.
mcq.st: 橋壞了。因此，我們必須搭船過河。

mcq.q: There are two girls in my family, ______ my sister and me.
mcq.st: 我家有兩個女孩，也就是我姊姊和我。

mcq.q: My mom can cook dinner and talk on the phone ______.
mcq.st: 我媽媽可以一邊煮晚餐一邊講電話。

mcq.q: ______, people wrote letters to their friends. Now they send messages on their phones.
mcq.st: 過去，人們會寫信給朋友。現在他們用手機傳訊息。

mcq.q: My uncle is a cook now. ______, he was a bus driver.
mcq.st: 我叔叔現在是廚師。以前，他是公車司機。

mcq.q: We visited many places ______ the summer vacation.
mcq.st: 暑假期間，我們去了很多地方。

mcq.q: I ate a piece of cake, and it was delicious. Can I have ______ piece?
mcq.st: 我吃了一塊蛋糕，很好吃。我可以再吃一塊嗎？

mcq.q: Students must put their books away ______ the start of the test.
mcq.st: 學生必須在考試開始之前把書收好。

mcq.q: The movie was too long, the story was boring, and the actors were bad. ______, it was a terrible movie.
mcq.st: 那部電影太長，故事很無聊，演員也演得不好。簡言之，那是一部很糟的電影。

mcq.q: It rained all day during our trip to the zoo. ______, we had a great time.
mcq.st: 我們去動物園玩的那天下了一整天的雨。儘管如此，我們還是玩得很開心。

mcq.q: Tom's room is always clean. ______, his brother's room is very messy.
mcq.st: 湯姆的房間總是很乾淨。相比之下，他弟弟的房間非常亂。

mcq.q: This phone is light and cheap. ______, it takes great photos.
mcq.st: 這支手機又輕又便宜。此外，它還能拍出很棒的照片。

mcq.q: I want to join the English speech contest. ______, my English is not perfect, but I practice every day.
mcq.st: 我想參加英文演講比賽。不可否認，我的英文並不完美，但我每天都在練習。

mcq.q: ______ it was raining, Eric still went running.
mcq.st: 雖然在下雨，艾瑞克還是去跑步了。

mcq.q: Here is how to make a paper boat. ______, fold the paper in half, and then fold down the top corners.
mcq.st: 這是摺紙船的方法。首先，把紙對摺，然後把上面的兩個角往下摺。

mcq.q: Our teacher told us to eat fruit, drink water, sleep early, and play sports. ______, she wants us to stay healthy.
mcq.st: 老師要我們吃水果、喝水、早點睡覺和運動。總結來說，她希望我們保持健康。

mcq.q: Swimming is good for your body. ______, it is a lot of fun.
mcq.st: 游泳對身體有益。此外，它也非常好玩。

mcq.q: My dad never drives to work. ______, he takes the MRT every day.
mcq.st: 我爸爸從不開車上班。取而代之的是，他每天搭捷運。

mcq.q: Ben is a vegetarian. ______, he doesn't eat any meat.
mcq.st: Ben 是素食者。換句話說，他完全不吃肉。

mcq.q: Today the park is full of trees and flowers. ______, it was an empty parking lot.
mcq.st: 現在這座公園種滿了樹和花。以前，它是一個空蕩蕩的停車場。

mcq.q: Lucy stayed up late to watch TV last night. ______, she was very sleepy in class this morning.
mcq.st: Lucy 昨晚熬夜看電視。因為這個原因，她今天早上上課時很想睡覺。

mcq.q: There are many ways to get to school. ______, you can walk, ride a bike, or take a bus.
mcq.st: 上學的方法有很多種。例如，你可以走路、騎腳踏車或搭公車。

mcq.q: Mr. Chen teaches math at our school now. ______, he worked at a bank for ten years.
mcq.st: 陳老師現在在我們學校教數學。先前，他在銀行工作了十年。

mcq.q: This bike is too expensive for me. ______, it is too big for me to ride.
mcq.st: 這台腳踏車對我來說太貴了。此外，它也太大，我騎不了。

mcq.q: That is all I want to say about my trip to Japan. ______, thank you all for listening.
mcq.st: 以上就是我想分享的日本之旅。最後，謝謝大家聆聽。

mcq.q: Plants need sunlight to grow. ______, children need good food to grow up healthy.
mcq.st: 植物需要陽光才能生長。同樣地，孩子需要好的食物才能健康長大。

mcq.q: Tom's twin brother loves basketball. ______ his brother, Tom never plays it.
mcq.st: Tom 的雙胞胎哥哥很愛打籃球。和他哥哥不同，Tom 從來不打籃球。

mcq.q: Our school trip had good food, fun games, and great weather. ______, it was a wonderful day.
mcq.st: 我們的校外教學有好吃的食物、好玩的遊戲和很棒的天氣。總而言之，那是很美好的一天。

mcq.q: My brother is good at drawing. ______, my sister draws beautiful pictures.
mcq.st: 我哥哥很會畫畫。同樣地，我姊姊也畫出很漂亮的圖。

mcq.q: Eating healthy food is important for your body. ______, you need to get enough sleep.
mcq.st: 吃健康的食物對身體很重要。同樣重要的是，你需要有充足的睡眠。

mcq.q: Yesterday I finished my homework at seven. ______, I watched TV with my family.
mcq.st: 昨天我七點寫完功課。然後，我和家人一起看電視。
